question: What are the plans available for overseas trips outside Malaysia?
answer: We have Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan that offers comprehensive travel protection for greater peace of mind with complimentary Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass

question: I noticed there are several options under Tokio Marine Explorer International plan that sell through Tokio Marine website. Can I purchase different types of International plans via TNG eWallet?
answer: TNG eWallet only offers Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan for International plan. The other 2 options (Basic and Deluxe plans) are currently not offered on the TNG eWallet platform.

question: Is there any age limit for Tokio Marine Explorer?
answer: For individual and group policies, the eligible age is between 30 days old and 85 years old.

question: Can non-Malaysians buy Tokio Marine Explorer policy?
answer: Yes, Tokio Marine Explorer is available to Malaysians and non-Malaysians departing from Malaysia.

question: How much do I need to pay for Tokio Marine Explorer?
answer: The premium starts from RM23 per trip, subject to applicable government tax and stamp duty. It is a one-off premium for your entire trip. Kindly note that the premium varies depending on your selected plan, your age at the point of purchase, duration of your trip, travel destination and number of persons covered within the same purchase order. The duration for each trip shall not exceed 180 consecutive days from the commencement date of your trip. question: Does Tokio Marine Explorer Single Trip plan cover both Domestic and Overseas travelling in the same policy?
answer: No. You are advised to purchase 2 different policies for Domestic and Overseas Single Trip Plans.

question: I will be riding motorcycle to Thailand and plan to go on road trip there. Am I covered under the Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan policy?
answer: Yes, you are eligible to purchase Tokio Marine Explorer.

question: I will be taking a cruise tour to Alaska upcoming in December, can I purchase Tokio Marine Explore Essential plan for this cruise holiday?
answer: Yes, you are eligible to purchase Tokio Marine Explorer with no additional premium charged.

question: Is riding a hot air balloon covered by Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan?
answer: Yes, it is covered under standard product coverage as riding a hot air ballon is not considered an extreme sport activity.

question: When does the coverage start for each trip?
answer: - For Domestic plan, the coverage starts when you leave your home or place of work in Malaysia. - For International plans, the coverage starts when you leave your home or place of work in Malaysia until the time you return to Malaysia on completion of trip. Coverage for each trip includes 72 hours prior to scheduled departure out of Malaysia and 72 hours upon arrival to Malaysia. The maximum number of days per trip is 180 consecutive days.

question: For those who live is Sabah, it is common to stay few days in Kuala Lumpur before/after travelling in overseas countries. What would be the recommended plans under Tokio Marine Explorer?
answer: It may be covered under one Tokio Marine Explorer International plan. The period of coverage shall start from the scheduled departure date from Kuala Lumpur, until the scheduled return date to Kuala Lumpur. As illustration, a) Scenario 1: 1 Feb: Flight from Sabah to KL 3 Feb: Flight from KL to London 15 Feb: Flight from London to KL 17 Feb: Flight from KL to Sabah The policy effective date should be based on 3 February (i.e. the scheduled departure date out of Malaysia). Except for Travel Cancellations, other covered events happen in Kuala Lumpur between 1 and 3 February will be covered according to the definition of International Trip, which include 72 hours prior to scheduled departure time out of Malaysia. Similarly, the policy expiry date should be based on 15 February (i.e. the schedule arrival date back to Malaysia). Any covered events happen in Kuala Lumpur between 15 and 17 February will be covered according to the definition of International Trip, which include 72 hours after the scheduled arrival time back in Malaysia. b) Scenario 2: 1 Mar: Flight from Sabah to KL 7 Mar: Flight from KL to Thailand 15 Mar: Flight from Thailand to KL 20 Mar: Flight from KL to Sabah The policy effective date should be based on 7 March (i.e. the scheduled departure date out of Malaysia). Except for Travel Cancellation, other covered events happen in KL between 4 and 7 March will be covered according to the definition of International Trip, which include 72 hours prior to scheduled departure time out of Malaysia. The traveller may opt for a separate Domestic coverage to cover travelling in KL from 1 to 3 March. Similarly, the policy expiry date should be based on 15 March (i.e. the schedule arrival date back to Malaysia). Any covered events happen in KL between 17 and 20 March will be covered according to the definition of International Trip, which include 72 hours after the scheduled arrival time back in Malaysia. The traveller may opt for a separate Domestic coverage to cover travelling in KL from 18 to 20 March.

question: For those who live in Johor, it is common to travel to Singapore before travelling to other overseas countries. What would be the recommended plans under Tokio Marine Explorer?
answer: It may be covered under one Tokio Marine Explorer Essential International plan. The period of coverage shall start from the scheduled departure date from Johor, until the scheduled return date to Johor. As illustration: 1 April: Travel from Johor to Singapore by Train 2 April: Travel from Singapore to Japan by Flight 10 April: Travel from Japan to Singapore by Flight 11 April: Travel from Singapore to Johor by Train The policy effective date should be based on 1 April (i.e. the scheduled departure date out of Malaysia). On the other hand, the policy expiry date should be based on 11 April (i.e. the scheduled arrival date back to Malaysia).

question: Does Tokio Marine Explorer cover overseas trips to sanctioned countries such as Russia and North Korea?
answer: Yes, Tokio Marine Explorer covers for all countries provided that it does not fall under General Exclusion 1(c), "... any prohibitive regulations by Customs or other Government Officials or Authorities of any country." Do note that all insurance policies are subject to customer pre-onboarding screening according to Bank Negara Malaysia regulations.

question: What is Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass?
answer: Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass is a service that offers complimentary airport lounge access in the event of flight delay by more than 120 minutes. Complimentary Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass is available for Essential plan policyholders.

question: How does Mastercard® Fight Delay Pass work?
answer: You are required to register your flight with the Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass program at least 24 hours prior to the departure. Once successful registration and if your flight is delayed by 120 minutes or more, you will receive a LoungeKeyTM pass, giving you complimentary access to an airport lounge at the location of your delay.

question: I have purchased Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan and received a passcode. What should I do next?
answer: You may refer to the registration guide provided in the email notification. Once registration is successful, you will receive an email from Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass. If you did not receive the email, please contact Mastercard® Flight Delay Pass customer service at customerservice@flightdelaypass.mastercard.com

question: In January, I have purchased my flight ticket to Japan for April holiday. 3 days prior to scheduled departure I received notification that the flight no. has been changed and rescheduled to night flight which is 12 hours later than the original departure
answer: No, it is consider as rescheduled of flight and not travel delay.

question: How to earn the additional 5% group premium discount?
answer: Customers who purchase Tokio Marine Explorer under group policy will be entitled for additional 5% group premium discount. This is applicable to group of 2 or more person travelling together, including but not limited to, friends, colleagues, classmates, relatives and so on.

question: I have already purchased my Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan policy for the coming trip to Singapore. My friend, who will be travelling together with me to Singapore, would also want to purchase Tokio Marine Explorer. Are we entitled for the 5% group
answer: Not applicable, since you and your friend are buying Tokio Marine Explorer separately as individual policies. For group traveling in the future, do remember to purchase Tokio Marine Explorer as group policy in order to enjoy additional 5% group premium discount.

question: How do I make a claim?
answer: Kindly notify Tokio Marine within 30 days upon return from your trip, along with the supporting documents. The detailed process can be found at tokiomarine.com

question: I suffer from cough and fever. Can I claim for medical and related expenses if I require medical treatment while overseas?
answer: Yes. You may seek reimbursement for medical treatment cost as advised by medical practitioner during your overseas trip. For Domestic plan, Tokio Marine Explorer only covers medical expenses due to accidental injuries.

question: Does Tokio Marine Explorer cover my medical treatment costs in Malaysia for an injury sustained during my overseas trip?
answer: Yes, Tokio Marine Explorer covers follow-up medical treatment costs up to 60 days after the trip ended.

question: I have sustained a hand fracture due to an accidental fall in overseas, but unable to undergo treatment before my scheduled return trip back to Malaysia. Can I submit claim for Medical Expenses if I seek treatment in Malaysia?
answer: Yes, provided you immediately seek treatment within 24 hours after returning to Malaysia.

question: Can I buy Tokio Marine Explorer Essential plan to cover for my upcoming trip to Nepal, which is 4,000 metres above sea level?
answer: Yes, you will be covered by Tokio Marine Explorer policy but Benefits 2, 3, 4 and 6 (stated below) are subject to additional General Exclusion 2(j) "any form of Mountain Sickness arising from travelling at mountains exceeding 3,000 metres above sea level": - Benefit 2: Medical-related Expenses - Benefit 3: Inconvenience Benefits - Benefit 4: Daily Hospital Allowances (up to 30 days) - Benefit 6: Emergency Medical Evacuation & Repatriation

question: Does Tokio Marine Explorer cover communicable diseases?
answer: Yes, Tokio Marine Explorer covers communicable diseases that does not require quarantine by applicable health authority in the covered destination, or by the World Health Organization. Common flu or influenza that do not require quarantine by law, are covered under Tokio Marine Explorer. On the other hand, communicable diseases that require quarantine by law such as Monkey Pox or Nipah Virus, fall under policy exclusion.

question: Does Tokio Marine Explorer cover my trip as a professional tour guide?
answer: No, travelling as a on-duty professional tour guide fall under policy exclusion. However, you can be covered under Tokio Marine Explorer when you go for your personal trips.

question: Can I purchase Tokio Marine Explorer for my 3-month secondment in Thailand?
answer: No, Tokio Marine Explorer policy only covers trip for leisure or business purposes.

question: Can a group of mechanical engineers purchase Tokio Marine Explorer for their site visits in Singapore?
answer: Yes. However, as stated under General Exclusion 2(d), Tokio Marine Explorer does not cover any claims arising from manual work in connection with Your trade, employment and profession.

question: Can I pay extra premium to cover my "pre-existing medical conditions"?
answer: No, Tokio Marine Explorer policy does not offer this option, not even with an additional premium.

question: What is Tokio Marine Travel Assistance?
answer: Tokio Marine Travel Assistance provides 24-hour worldwide medical assistance and travel assistance services, including emergency medical evacuation, emergency medical repatriation, repatriation of mortal remains or overseas burial/cremation, and others. Kindly contact our 24-hour Tokio Marine Travel Assistance hotline at 03-7628 3877 or 03-7841 5770.

question: Can I request for Guaranteed Letter for my follow up medical treatment after return to to Malaysia?
answer: No, follow up treatment is on pay-and-file basis.

question: If I'm affected by flooding in Bangkok and unable to continue my trip to Phuket, what benefit that I can claim under the policy?
answer: You may claim prepaid unutilized expenses such as hotel accommodation, air tickets or ground tour packages that cannot be recoverable from any other source, under travel disruption benefit.

question: I have to cancel my trip due to leg fracture. Can I seek reimbursement under Tokio Marine Explorer?
answer: Yes, you may seek reimbursement for the prepaid expenses e.g. hotel stay and flight ticket, if your trip is unavoidably cancelled before trip starts.

question: In January, I have purchased my flight ticket to Japan for December holiday. On 5th April, I received notification that the flight has been rescheduled to 2 weeks earlier than the original departure date. Can I claim for travel reschedule?
answer: No, only benefits 8.1 and 8.1.1 are effective immediately after policy issuance. Other benefits including Travel Reschedule, will only take effect 72 hours before the scheduled departure out of Malaysia.

question: My flight has been re-routed to Hong Kong due to volcanic eruption in Philippines. What benefits can I claim under policy Tokio Marine Explorer?
answer: Although travel re-routing is not explicitly mentioned in the policy wordings, the scenarios are claimable under either Section 7.1 Travel Delay or Section 7.2 Travel Misconnection. If travel re-routing happens during the flight which results in a late arrival to the original flight destination, you can claim under Section 7.1 Travel Delay. The payout will be determined based on the difference between the original scheduled arrival time and actual arrival time. If you miss the connecting flight due to travel re-route, you can claim for under Section 7.2 Travel Misconnection. The payout will be determined based on the difference between the original scheduled departure time and the actual departure time of the alternative transportation arranged by you.

question: If my luggage is delayed on my return flight from Japan to KLIA, can I claim under Luggage Delay benefit?
answer: No, Tokio Marine Explorer policy does not cover luggage delay upon returning to Malaysia.

question: Can I submit claim for my personal luggage lost during my overseas trip? What if I am unable to provide the proof of purchase?
answer: For International travel plans, you may submit a claim under Section 9.1 Personal Luggage, subject to sublimit of RM 300 per luggage. For those who are unable to provide the proof of purchase, the reimbursement amount will be based on a market value as determined by us, up to RM 200 per luggage.

question: Can I claim for my luggage damaged during my trip to Sabah?
answer: No, Tokio Marine Explorer Domestic plan does not cover lost or damage to personal luggage or personal belongings.

question: What should I do if I wish to appoint a nominee?
answer: Kindly complete a duly signed nomination form to your agents or directly email to letusknow@tokiomarine.com.my.

question: Where can I get further information for anything related to Tokio Marine Explorer plan?
answer: For Product Information: Please visit the product landing page in TNG eWallet app Insurance > TripInsure for more information or you can find more information from Product Disclosure Sheet and Policy Wording. For General Enquiries: Should you require additional information, please contact Tokio Marine Customer Service via hotline 1800-88-0812 during operating hour (Monday - Friday:8.30am - 5.30pm) or e-mail to letusknow@tokiomarine.com.my

question: What is TripInsure?
answer: TripInsure is travel insurance plan that helps protect you against certain unexpected events before or during your trip, such as medical emergencies, trip cancellation, travel delays, baggage loss, personal accident, and other covered incidents. Coverage depends on the insurer, plan selected, destination, travel period, and policy terms and conditions.

question: Why should I buy travel insurance?
answer: Travel insurance can help reduce the financial impact of unexpected travel disruptions, such as overseas medical treatment, lost luggage, flight delays, trip cancellation, or emergency evacuation. It gives you extra peace of mind when travelling locally or overseas.

question: What travel insurance plans are available in TNG eWallet?
answer: You can compare and purchase travel insurance plans from participating insurers, such as AIA SafeTrip (Domestic and International plan) and Tokio Marine Explorer (Domestic and International Essential plan), directly through the TNG eWallet app. The available plans, benefits, premiums, and coverage may vary depending on your trip details and insurer. question: Is TNG eWallet the insurance provider?
answer: No. TNG eWallet provides the digital platform for users to compare and purchase travel insurance. The insurance coverage is underwritten and provided by the respective insurer. Any claims, policy servicing, approvals, and coverage decisions are subject to the insurer's terms and conditions.

question: Can I compare travel insurance plans before purchasing?
answer: Yes. You can compare available travel insurance plans through TripInsure based on the insurance premium amount, coverage benefits, and other key features before deciding which plan to purchase.

question: Who can be covered by TripInsure through TNG eWallet?
answer: You can be covered by TripInsure if you are: - Child: Entry age (last birthday) between 30 days and 17 years old; - Adult: Entry age (last birthday) between 18 and 85 years old; and - Malaysian, or foreigner who is a permanent resident of Malaysia, work permit holder, pass holder or otherwise legally employed and legally residing in Malaysia. Kindly note that the policyholder of a child (who is the Insured Person) must be his/her parent or guardian.

question: Who can purchase TripInsure?
answer: You can purchase TripInsure if you are: - Above aged (last birthday) 18 years old; and - Malaysian, or foreigner who is permanent resident of Malaysia, work permit holder, pass holder or otherwise legally employed and legally residing in Malaysia.

question: How do I get travel assistance during an emergency?
answer: AIA SafeTrip Travel Assistance Service provided by AIA authorized service provider provides the following Travel Assistance Service includes: - International Medical Assistance includes, but not limited to, medical referral and medical appointment arrangement, arrangement of hospital admission guarantee (due to accident and/or food poisoning only), evacuation and repatriation service etc.; and - Travel Assistance includes, but not limited to, visa, passport and inoculation requirements, location of lost items (e.g. luggage, documents, personal items), legal referral, interpreter/translator referral etc Pre-trip assistance Service, Medical Assistance Service (including Cashless Admission for hospital confinement in overseas due to accident and/or food poisoning), Emergency Ticket Service, General Assistance Service, Evacuation and Repatriation Service, Baggage Service and Legal Service. The list is not exhaustive, kindly refer to the policy contract here for the full list of Travel Assistance Service. If you required any of the services above during your trip, you may contact AIA 24-hour Worldwide Travel Assistance Service hotline at +603-2163 4088. Tokio Marine Explorer Tokio Marine Travel Assistance is a 24-hour worldwide helpline offering: emergency medical evacuation, emergency medical repatriation, compassionate care (visit by a relative/friend), repatriation of a dependent child, repatriation of mortal remains / overseas burial, medical monitoring, dispatch of essential medication/equipment, medical practitioner referral, tele-medical consultation, arrangement of a translator, and additional referral services (visa/inoculation info, weather, exchange rates, consulate/embassy details, lost luggage assistance, replacement of travel documents, legal referral, interpreter, bail bond assistance, transfer of emergency funds). question: What payment option(s) are available?
answer: Only payment via TNG eWallet is supported. Please make sure you have sufficient eWallet balance or enable Quick Payment before making payment.

question: If I do not have sufficient eWallet balance, will my payment go through?
answer: No, please ensure your eWallet balance is sufficient or enable Quick Payment before making a payment for your travel insurance through TripInsure.

question: Who should I call if I encounter system or payment failure?
answer: You may proceed to call us at 03-5022 3888 or ask your question via our Chatbot.

question: What will my personal data be used for?
answer: Your personal data will be transferred to our insurance partners for them to process your e-policy / e-certificate based on the provided data given.

question: Are there any hidden charges?
answer: There are no hidden charges. Our pricing is transparent, so you only pay for the best price.

question: What is the promo code in TripInsure?
answer: The promo code is mainly used for TripInsure promotional campaigns by TNG eWallet. Users can enter a promo code into the provided space to enjoy reward if and when there are promotional TripInsure campaigns running.

question: Where can I get the TripInsure promo code?
answer: You can only get the TripInsure promo code from respective TNG eWallet partners that we have partnered with. You may check out our latest promotions at https://www.touchngo.com.my/promotion.

question: What is Post-Departure Cover in TripInsure that offer by AIA SafeTrip?
answer: SafeTrip allows you to buy a policy even after you have started your trip and departed from Malaysia, whereby you must purchase the policy no later than 2359 hour (in Malaysia time) on the next day following your departure from Malaysia. Post-Departure Cover will provide you all benefits under SafeTrip (except Travel Cancellation), this is only applicable for International Plan. Kindly not that the travel starts and end dates as selected and declared by you during your purchase must match with your travel tickets (e.g. airline ticket/ flight itinerary/ boarding pass). The details will be verified upon claim. A waiting period is applicable until 2359 hour (in Malaysia time) on the next day following your purchase of the policy. No benefits are eligible to claim during the waiting period. For example, you commenced your trip to China on 1 July 2025 for the period of 1-5 July 2025. On 2 July 2025, you realise you do not have any travel insurance and decide to buy SafeTrip. Your coverage period will start from the date of purchase, i.e. from 2 July and ends on 5 July 2025. However, a waiting period applies from the actual time of purchase on 2 July until 11:59 p.m. on 3 July. You are only eligible for any benefits under this policy from 12:00 a.m. (in Malaysia time) on 4 July.

question: Is there any group discount if I purchase for more pax?
answer: Yes, there is a 5% group discount for purchase of at least 2 or more Insured Persons under the same order purchase through TNG eWallet, depending on the insurer selection.

question: Where can I get help or more information about BUDI MADANI?
answer: For enquiries about the BUDI MADANI programme, you may contact the official government channels: - Phone: 1300-88-9595 - WhatsApp chatbot: +603-2631 4595 - Website: https://www.budimadani.gov.my/ For issues related to BUDI MADANI in your TNG eWallet, you may contact TNG eWallet Customer Support at +603-5022 3888 or reach us via the in-app chatbot.

question: Is there a purchase limit per transaction?
answer: Yes, a maximum of RM250 per transaction. The litres purchased at the subsidised price will be deducted from the monthly eligibility balance. Once the balance is exhausted, subsequent fuel purchases will be charged at the unsubsidised pump price until eligibility is renewed at the start of the following month.

question: Can BUDI MADANI in TNG eWallet be used at all petrol stations nationwide?
answer: Yes. BUDI MADANI in TNG eWallet can be used at all petrol stations nationwide. It is the only app that others nationwide acceptance across all petrol station brands, giving users the flexibility to refuel at any petrol station that accepts TNG eWallet without being limited to a specific brand or network.

question: What if I fill less than the amount paid via TNG eWallet?
answer: The excess will be returned to your eWallet balance immediately.

question: Does my MyKad need to be scanned if I pay via TNG eWallet?
answer: No. If you've completed your verification (eKYC) process, no additional MyKad scan is needed.

question: Do I need to fill at the same pump/bay as I entered when purchasing fuel via BUDI MADANI in the TNG eWallet?
answer: Yes. You must enter the correct pump/bay number when making your fuel purchase. The petrol station station will scan your TNG eWallet verification note and activate the pump based on the pump number you provided.

question: Can I pay partially via TNG eWallet and partially via cash?
answer: No. At this time, TNG eWallet only allows full payment through the app.

question: Can I switch to cash payment after starting a transaction via TNG eWallet?
answer: No. If you initiate a transaction via TNG eWallet, payment must be completed through that app.

question: Can I use other e-wallets besides TNG eWallet?
answer: You can use other e-wallets when paying at indoor payment terminal (IPT) or outdoor payment terminal (OPT) (after MyKad verification), subject to petrol station acceptance. For in-app checking and purchasing, only TNG eWallet and oil company apps are supported at this time.

question: Why is the pump price different from the price on my receipt?
answer: The pump displays the unsubsidised price set by automatic pricing mechanism (APM). The receipt shows the BUDI MADANI subsidised price. The pump price is what you would pay without the Government subsidy.

question: What is BUDI MADANI?
answer: BUDI MADANI is a government initiative to implement more targeted fuel subsidy distribution for RON95 petrol and diesel, directed specifically at eligible Malaysians and recipient groups.

question: What are the conditions to be eligible for BUDI MADANI?
answer: For BUDI MADANI RON95 (BUDI95) only: - Hold an active Competent Driving Licence (CDL), Probationary Driving Licence (PDL), or Learner's Driving Licence (LDL) for permitted vehicle classes; AND - Hold a chipped MyKad. For both BUDI MADANI RON95 and BUDI MADANI Diesel: - Meet the above driving licence and MyKad requirements; AND - Own an individual private diesel vehicle registered in your name with a valid Motor Vehicle Licence (road tax). No application is required - data will be cross-checked automatically with the JPJ database and reflected in BUDI MADANI on TNG eWallet.

question: How can I check my eligibility for BUDI MADANI?
answer: You can check your eligibility at www.budimadani.gov.my using your MyKad number or on TNG eWallet. Key in BUDI MADANI in the search bar of your eWallet's home screen. This is how the BUDI MADANI page looks like on the app:

question: How can I use BUDI MADANI if I am eligible?
answer: There are two purchase methods when you're at the petrol station: - Using MyKad: Show your MyKad to the cashier, who will insert it into the MyKad reader terminal at the counter or pump. The system will verify your eligibility and approve the subsidy. You pay the subsidised price, subject to your eligibility balance. - Via TNG eWallet: - Once you've parked your car at the petrol station bay, launch your TNG eWallet and tap on the BUDI MADANI on the home screen - Select the station and enter the pump number - If you're only eligible for RON95, that option is preselected for you. If you're eligible for both, select your fuel type (RON95 or diesel) - Enter fuel amount to purchase and tap "Pay now" - Show the QR code to the cashier to activate the pump once payment is confirmed - Pump as usual - Any balance will be refunded to your eWallet immediately

question: Is the monthly BUDI MADANI eligibility for RON95 and diesel given separately?

question: If I don't use up my monthly eligibility, can the balance be carried forward?

question: Can I use BUDI MADANI while driving a foreign-registered vehicle?

question: What is the Rapid Bulanan Pass and what are its benefits?

question: Account Access Temporarily Limited
answer: General To help keep our platform and users safe and to comply with financial regulations, access limits may be applied to certain accounts. These measures are part of our responsibility as a regulated financial service provider. What does "Account Access Temporarily Limited" mean? It means that some features of your account are currently restricted, while other parts of your account may remain accessible. Access limits are applied when an account is flagged under policy-based controls or regulatory requirements. Why do you see this? Your account has been flagged through monitoring systems and compliance checks based on platform usage policies, security controls, and regulatory obligations. As a regulated financial service provider, we are required to monitor account activity to help prevent misuse and protect both users and the financial system. When certain risk indicators are detected, access limits may be applied. For transparency, these controls are guided by the following policies and regulatory requirements. Below are related policies and regulatory requirements: - TNG Digital Terms of Service - Acceptable Use Policy - Risk Management Policy - Fraud Prevention & Safety Policy - Anti-Money Laundering & Regulatory Compliance Policy Note: For regulatory and security reasons, including obligations under Malaysia's Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorism Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities Act 2001 (AMLA) and banking secrecy requirements under the Financial Services Act 2013. The specific details about why an account is flagged cannot be disclosed. What access limits may apply? Depending on policy requirements, you may notice restrictions on the following: - Monthly account usage A temporary cap (RM200-RM500) on how much you can move in or out of your account within a month. - Adding funds (Fund In) Some top-up methods such as debit or credit cards, DuitNow transfers, vouchers, reload PINs, or peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers may be limited. - Using funds (Fund Out) Certain activities like payments, bill payments, or ATM withdrawals may be unavailable. Possible issues that cause This may happen due to general safety reasons such as: - Unusual activity that requires review - Routine security checks - System protection reviews to prevent misuse For security reasons, we're unable to share specific details about these checks. What can you do next? Check your registered email - We've sent important information and next steps to the email linked to your account. - Please also check your Spam or Junk folder. Submit a request for review (Appeal) - If you believe the access limits may not apply to you, you may submit a request for review. - Submit your appeal request through the email link. - If you did not receive an email, you may still access the appeal form here: Appeal for Account Access Temporarily Limited - All requests are assessed in accordance with applicable policies and regulatory requirements - Submitting a request does not guarantee that access limits will be removed. Important note: The outcome of a review depends on policy and regulatory assessments. In some cases, access limits may remain in place even after a request is reviewed.

question: What is Rapid Kembara Pass and what are its benefits?
answer: Rapid Kembara Pass is the unlimited daily travel pass with extra benefits offered by Prasarana Malaysia Berhad.

question: What are the eligibility criteria to purchase Rapid Kembara Pass?
answer: All users are eligible to purchase the Rapid Kembara Pass. Below are the available methods and locations to purchase Rapid Kembara: - Offline via Rapid KL Customer Service Counters located at LRT, MRT, Monorail, and BRT stations. - Offline via selected bus hubs: - Pasar Seni - Chow Kit - Sri Nilam - Puchong Utama - Pearl Point - Greenwood - Seksyen 2, Shah Alam - Online via TNG eWallet: You will need a Enhanced Touch 'n Go card, an NFC-enabled smartphone, and a TNG eWallet account that has been eKYC-verified.

question: What type of passes are offered?
answer: We offer two (2) types of Rapid Kembara Passes: Rapid Kembara 1-Day Pass and the Rapid Kembara 3-Day Pass. These passes are valid for 1 day or 3 days respectively and are activated using an Enhanced Touch 'n Go card.

question: What benefits will I get with the purchase of a Rapid Kembara Pass?
answer: You are entitled to get unlimited rides on Rapid KL LRT, MRT, Monorail, BRT, Rapid KL bus, and MRT feeder bus services for one (1) or three (3) days. Additionally, you can also enjoy discounts and benefits from our participating partners for seven (7) consecutive days from the first day usage (activation) of the pass by presenting the promo card at their participating outlets.

question: How much do Rapid Kembara Day Pass cost?
answer: The prices for the passes are as follows: - Rapid Kembara 1-Day Pass (RKMP1): RM25.00 - Rapid Kembara 3-Day Pass (RKMP3): RM55.00 You must ensure a minimum balance of RM5.00 is available in your Enhanced Touch 'n Go card to enjoy unlimited rides on Rapid KL LRT, MRT, Monorail, BRT, Rapid KL bus and MRT feeder bus services.

question: Who are the participating partners for Rapid Kembara Pass?
answer: You may visit Rapid KL's website at https://myrapid.com.my/our-products/Rapid Kembara-pass/ for the list of participating partners and the benefits offered, or you may simply scan the QR code available at Rapid KL Customer Service Counters for more information.

question: When can I enjoy all the benefits of the Rapid Kembara Pass that I purchased from TNG eWallet?
answer: Once you have purchased your Rapid Kembara pass from the TNG eWallet, you will also receive a Rapid Kembara promo card in the app. Simply show this promo card to any participating partner outlets to enjoy the offers and benefits for seven (7) consecutive days starting from the first day of usage (activation).

question: Are there any differences between buying the Rapid Kembara Pass on the TNG eWallet and from other channels?
answer: The benefits of the Rapid Kembara Pass remain the same whether you purchase it through the TNG eWallet, or via Rapid KL Customer Service Counters. However, when you use the TNG eWallet, you can link your pass directly to an Enhanced Touch 'n Go card, offering greater flexibility and ease of use.

question: Are prices for Rapid Kembara Pass on TNG eWallet different?
answer: No, prices for Rapid Kembara Pass on TNG eWallet are the same as purchasing at Rapid KL Customer Service Counters. There are no additional surcharges for buying from the TNG eWallet.

question: Can I purchase a Rapid Kembara Pass on TNG eWallet and link it to MyKad/non-NFC enabled Touch 'n Go card?
answer: No, all purchases made on Travel Pass in the TNG eWallet can only be linked to an Enhanced Touch 'n Go card.

question: I am a My50 Pass user. Can I purchase the Rapid Kembara Pass using the same Enhanced TNG card?
answer: Yes. You may purchase a Rapid Kembara Pass in advance using the same Enhanced TNG card. However, the Rapid Kembara Pass can only be activated after your My50 Pass has expired. The selected validity date must not overlap with your active My50 Pass.

question: Will I be charged Sales & Service Tax (SST) when I purchase the Rapid Kembara Pass on TNG eWallet?
answer: No. Sales and Service Tax (SST) are not applicable to Rapid Kembara Pass purchases.

question: Can I view passes that I purchased from Rapid KL Customer Service Counters in the Touch 'n Go?
answer: No, only passes purchased directly through the Travel Pass feature in the TNG eWallet will appear in the app.

question: Can I pause or extend my Rapid Kembara Pass if I don't use it?
answer: No. Once activated, the Rapid Kembara Pass cannot be paused, extended, or carried forward. Even if unused, the validity period continues - so it's best to activate it only when you're ready to travel.

question: What happens if my pass is expiring during travel restrictions or emergencies?
answer: All Rapid Kembara Passes follow the standard 1-day or 3-day expiry policy. Unfortunately, extensions are not offered - even in cases of travel disruptions or emergencies. We recommend activating your pass only when you're certain you'll be using it actively.

question: Can I terminate or cancel my Rapid Kembara Pass before it expires?
answer: No. Once activated, the pass is valid for the full 1-day or 3-day period and cannot be cancelled, paused, or refunded - even if unused.

question: Can I combine the Rapid Kembara Pass with other travel promotions or discounts?
answer: No. The Rapid Kembara Pass cannot be combined with other fare promotions, concessions, or discounts.

question: How to purchase Rapid Kembara Pass in TNG eWallet?
answer: - Step 1: Open your TNG eWallet. - Step 2: Complete your e-KYC. - Step 3: Go to 'My Favourites'. - Step 4: Select 'More'. - Step 5: Scroll down to the 'Transport' section. - Step 6: Select 'Travel Pass'. - Step 7: Select 'Rapid Kembara' at the top of 'Travel Pass' page - Step 8: Select your chosen Enhanced Touch 'n Go card to be encoded with Rapid Kembara Pass. If you have not linked your card, you need to add an Enhanced Touch 'n Go card into the app. - Step 9: Scan your card using your phone. Just hold your Enhanced Touch 'n Go card at the back of your phone to scan. - Step 10: Choose your activation date. - Step 11: Confirm details and make your payment by using TNG eWallet balance account. - Step 12: Scan your card once again. This final scan activates your pass based on your chosen date and links it to your card. - Step 13: Click the Promo Card to check your seven (7)-day validity period from the activation date and unlock attractive perks and discounts at our strategic partners' locations.

question: Where do I see my purchased Rapid Kembara Passes?
answer: After completing your purchase, the Rapid Kembara Pass will appear under the "My Passes" section. You can also view your past purchases under "Purchase History". You will be able to see which card the pass is linked to and the active dates. Upcoming passes will also be displayed based on your chosen date.

answer: Yes, you can. The Rapid Kembara Pass covers only your Rapid KL travel. You can still top up and use your Enhanced Touch 'n Go card for other transactions such as tolls, retail purchases, or parking, using the same eWallet account.

question: Can foreign tourists buy the Rapid Kembara Pass?

question: Can I buy Rapid Kembara Pass now and activate it only when I start using it?

answer: You will need to select a different start date. The Travel Pass does not allow you to have two (2) Rapid Kota Passes with overlapping active periods on the same card, even if one of them was purchased at a Rapid KL Customer Service Counter or any Rapid KL bus hub.

question: Can I still buy Rapid Kota Pass offline at one of the Rapid KL Customer Service Counter or selected bus hubs on the same day I purchased Rapid Kota Pass via TNG eWallet?
answer: Yes. As long as you use different Enhanced Touch 'n Go card when you make purchases at Rapid KL Customer Service Counter or selected bus hubs.

question: It says my Enhanced Touch 'n Go card is expiring soon - can I still use it?
answer: Unfortunately, no. If your Enhanced Touch 'n Go card is set to expire within the next 60 days, you won't be able to use it to buy a Pass. Please use another valid Enhanced Touch 'n Go card.

question: I got an error after scanning my card - what should I do?
answer: If something goes wrong after the second card scan: - Try scanning again - if it works, your pass will activate - If it fails, don't worry - you'll be automatically refunded and can try again If you exited the app midway, just open Travel Pass, scan your card again, and check that the pass was properly linked.

question: What should I do if my payment goes through, but the card scan fails?
answer: If your payment is successful but the second card scan fails and your Rapid Kota Pass cannot be activated, don't worry - the system will automatically refund the payment to your eWallet within 3-5 business days. - Before attempting the second scan, please wait at least 60 seconds after the first scan to ensure the system has enough time to process your request. - Once your refund is reflected in your eWallet, you can try the process again. - If the refund does not appear after 5 business days, please contact TNG eWallet Customer Support for further assistance.

question: Can I transfer my Rapid Kota Pass on the TNG eWallet to another Enhanced Touch 'n Go card?
answer: No. Once linked, the Rapid Kota Pass is permanently tied to that Enhanced Touch 'n Go card. It cannot be transferred or shared.

question: Can I transfer my Rapid Kota Pass purchased on the TNG eWallet to someone else?
answer: No. The Rapid Kota Pass purchased on the TNG eWallet is non-transferable and is meant to be used solely by the individual who activated it.

question: Can I continue using the Rapid Kota Pass if I change phones?
answer: Yes. Your Pass is stored on your card, not your phone. As long as you log into your same personal TNG eWallet account, you can use a different phone without issue.

question: What should I do if I can't enter the gate barrier even though I have a valid Rapid Kota Pass?
answer: If you're unable to enter through the gate barrier despite having a valid Rapid Kota Pass, please approach the station counter staff for immediate assistance. They will help verify your Pass and, if the issue is due to a technical error, guide you on the next steps. For further assistance, you may also contact the Touch 'n Go Customer Service Centre via the hotline listed on our official Touch 'n Go website.

question: Will my Rapid Kota Pass still work if I lose my internet connection?
answer: Yes! Once your Rapid Kota Pass is successfully linked to your Enhanced Touch 'n Go card via Travel Pass, you don't need to stay connected to the internet to use it at the gates.

question: Can I use my Touch 'n Go Charm for Rapid Kota Pass?
answer: Yes! Rapid Kota Pass Passes can also be linked to Touch 'n Go Charms that have Enhanced NFC capabilities - functionally the same as an Enhanced Touch 'n Go card, just with more style.

question: What is Savings Tracker?
answer: Savings Tracker is a feature that shows how much you have saved monthly by using the My50 Pass in TNG eWallet. It helps you to track your savings from My50 Pass compared to paying individual fares.

question: Who can use the Savings Tracker?
answer: The feature is available only to users who have purchased a My50 Pass via the Travel Pass in TNG eWallet.

question: What will I see in the Savings Tracker?
answer: If you have an active My50 Pass, you'll see: - Total monthly fare cost for your active My50 Pass so far - Number of monthly rides taken using your active My50 Pass so far - Estimated number of rides to break even (vs paying regular fares) - Current monthly savings (shown only once your savings exceed the My50 Pass price) If your My50 Pass has expired, we'll show your most recent pass savings for up to 90 days after expiry.

question: How often is the data updated?
answer: Your savings data is updated daily, based on your rides from the previous day.

question: Does it include all passes?
answer: No. The Savings Tracker is currently only available for My50 Pass.

question: Are Rapid KL bus rides included?
answer: Yes, Savings Tracker covers bus rides for MRT feeder bus and BRT.

question: What if my data is missing or delayed?
answer: We will update your savings as soon as we receive the required data from our transit partner.

question: Can I see a detailed breakdown of my rides?
answer: No. The Savings Tracker focuses on a simple summary to help you quickly see your savings and plan the next purchase of your My50 Pass.

question: If I have purchased a My50 Pass in advance, will I still be able to view my current/previous pass savings?
answer: Yes, your most recent My50 Pass savings will remain available for viewing even after its expiry, for up to 90 days. After 90 days, the savings will no longer be displayed.

question: What does "Fare savings start after n rides" mean?
answer: This refers to the estimated number of rides you need to take for your My50 Pass to break even compared to paying regular fares. Any additional rides beyond this threshold represent savings.

question: Why is there no breakdown of my savings by month?
answer: The Savings Tracker currently shows savings only for your most recent My50 Pass, not broken down by month. We're always working to improve the experience, and a monthly breakdown may be added in future updates.

question: Why does my savings look lower than expected?
answer: Your savings may appear lower than expected because they are calculated based on fare data provided by our transit partner, who verifies ridership and fare data before sharing to ensure accuracy. As part of this process, there may occasionally be a short delay in data updates. Rest assured, once the verified data is received, your savings will be reflected accurately.

question: Why does my Savings Tracker show zero values?
answer: If you just purchased a My50 Pass or haven't taken any rides yet, savings will show as zero.

question: Does the Savings Tracker support multiple languages?
answer: Yes, it is available in English and Bahasa Melayu.

question: Why do I see a year-end summary banner?
answer: The year-end summary banner gives you a quick snapshot of your total savings for the previous year, so you can see how much you've saved overall.

question: Why don't I see the Savings Tracker for my advance purchased My50 Pass?
answer: Savings Tracker only works for active My50 Passes. Once your advanced purchased pass become active, Savings Tracker will be updated automatically.

question: What is BizCash on TNG eWallet?
answer: BizCash is a business loan feature on TNG eWallet that allows eligible merchants to apply for loan/financing digitally, anytime. The application process is simple and seamless, with quick approvals and clear next steps. BizCash is offered in partnership with participating banks and are applied for directly within the TNG eWallet.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: What banks are available for TNG eWallet's BizCash?
answer: Currently, BizCash offers business loan products from CIMB Bank Berhad. Below is a breakdown of the loan details: Features CIMB SME Quick Biz Loan amount RM10,000 - RM150,000* Tenure 1 year - 5 years Interest rate (FIR) % p.a. 6.42% - 11.05% Income document required Latest 6 months business bank statement Disbursement To CIMB Business Current Account only *Subject to CIMB's approving criteria
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Are the business loans via BizCash on TNG eWallet Shariah-compliant or conventional?
answer: The CIMB SME Quick Biz Financing available on BizCash is a conventional business loan. We are also working on introducing Islamic financing options for businesses through TNG eWallet. These products will be fully Shariah-compliant, allowing us to provide you with the best financing for your business.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: What is the eligibility criteria to apply for BizCash?
answer: To be eligible for BizCash, you must: - Be a Malaysian citizen aged between 21 and 65 - Be a TNG eWallet merchant with a registered SSM (Sole Proprietorship ONLY) business - Have an annual revenue of RM50,000 or more If you're a verified TNG eWallet merchant who meets these criteria but are still not eligible, it could be due to additional requirements from our partner banks, such as their own approval criteria or mandatory regulatory requirements.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: What are the terms and conditions for BizCash?
answer: The terms and conditions for BizCash can be found at BizCash | Touch 'n Go Please take a moment to read them to make sure you understand the details before applying.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Will applying for BizCash affect my CCRIS record negatively?
answer: When you apply for a business loan through TNG eWallet, the loan comes from one of our trusted partner banks, with BizCash providing a seamless and hassle-free application platform. As with any loan, it will appear in your CCRIS record, but it will only impact your CCRIS negatively if you miss or default on repayments.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Why can't I tap on the calculate button on TNG eWallet's BizCash?
answer: You may have reached the daily limit for financing calculations. Please try again the next day.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Is there a minimum annual revenue requirement to be eligible for a BizCash loan?
answer: Yes, the minimum annual revenue required is RM50,000. Your daily settlements through your TNG eWallet merchant account are also considered when assessing eligibility. To improve your chances of qualifying for a higher loan amount, we encourage you to process more payments through your TNG eWallet merchant account.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Can the approved BizCash loan be disbursed into my TNG eWallet account?
answer: No, loan disbursements are only made to CIMB Business Current Account. If you don't have one yet, a CIMB Business Current Account will be automatically created for you after your loan submission. For more details, see "Applying for BizCash", item 6.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Why can't I find the BizCash icon on TNG eWallet?
answer: BizCash is currently available only for TNG eWallet merchants registered with SSM as a Sole Proprietorship. You can search for BizCash loan directly from your eWallet in 2 ways: From the Dashboard: - Under My Business, tap the Dashboard icon - Select the BizCash icon from Business Tools From the Home screen: - Tap the BizCash icon, or search for BizCash under My Favourites
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: Can I apply for more than one BizCash loan via TNG eWallet?
answer: Yes, you can apply for multiple loans under BizCash, as long as you meet the eligibility criteria set by our partner banks. This allows you to access additional funds when needed.
category: General Information: BizCash on Touch 'n Go eWallet ("TNG eWallet")

question: How do I apply for a business loan through BizCash on TNG eWallet?
answer: You can apply for BizCash loan directly from your eWallet in 2 ways: From the Dashboard: - Under My Business, tap the Dashboard icon - Select the BizCash icon from Business Tools From the Home screen: - Tap the BizCash icon, or search for BizCash under My Favourites Next, fill in the necessary fields with your requested loan amount, tenure, and annual revenue, and then tap "Calculate." You'll instantly receive a loan offer based on the information provided.

question: What do I need to do before applying for a loan through BizCash on TNG eWallet?
answer: Before applying, make sure you have: - Completed your user TNG eWallet account verification (eKYC) - Completed merchant onboarding on TNG eWallet - Prepared the relevant income documents such as your latest 6 months business bank statements

question: How long does it take for my BizCash loan to be approved?
answer: You'll receive an update on your eligibility within 1 to 7 working days after submitting your income documents. Approval timelines may vary depending on the bank assessing your application. Once approved, you'll receive a notification, and you can also check your loan status in the 'My applications' screen.

question: I entered the wrong annual revenue, loan/financing amount or tenure for BizCash. Can I change this?
answer: Yes, you can update your annual revenue, loan amount, or tenure at any time before submitting your application. Just tap the back button at the top left, update the required fields, then tap "Calculate Now" to continue.

question: How are the interest rates calculated for BizCash loans on TNG eWallet?
answer: Interest rates for BizCash loans are determined based on your business' financial profile, such as your business credit record and repayment history.. The flat interest rate (FIR) ranges from 6.42% to 11.05% per annum. The effective interest rate (EIR) is approximately 11.88% to 18.88% per annum. The final interest rate will be clearly shown before you accept the loan.

question: Why do I need to resubmit my bank statements for BizCash even though I've submitted them before?
answer: You may be asked to resubmit your bank statements for a few reasons: - Your previously submitted documents have expired - The documents provided were unclear or incomplete - Additional review is needed to ensure you receive a suitable loan offer amount

question: Where will my BizCash loan be disbursed?
answer: Once approved, your BizCash loan will be disbursed to a CIMB Business Current Account. - If you already have a CIMB Business Current Account, you can choose which account the loan will be disbursed to. - If you don't have a CIMB Business Current Account, CIMB will automatically open a CIMB (Business Current Account) for you upon loan acceptance. Additionally, CIMB will also automatically open a CIMB OCTO Biz for you to facilitate your transactions via the internet banking channel. First time login details and the instruction guide will be sent to your registered email address.

question: Are there any legal fees or processing fees for an approved BizCash loan?
answer: Yes, there is a one-off legal fee and stamp duty charge. These costs will be deducted from your CIMB Business Current Account after the loan has been disbursed. Bank Legal cost* Stamp duty* CIMB RM270 0.5% of the loan amount *All fees and stamp duty are subject to change from time to time, based on the bank's terms and conditions.

question: Where can I find more information about CIMB SME Quick Biz Financing?
answer: You may find out more about the product, including its terms and conditions on CIMB Bank's official website.

question: Can I apply for a BizCash loan under my personal name?
answer: No, BizCash loans are only to registered business entities. Please ensure you are a TNG eWallet merchant registered with SSM before applying. You can find out how to apply as a TNG eWallet merchant here.

question: How do I accept a BizCash loan offer once it's approved?
answer: Once your application is approve, you'll receive a notification via your TNG eWallet. To accept the offer: - Review the loan details and accept the Terms & Conditions on the offer screen. - Enter your 6-digit TNG eWallet PIN. Note: Please ensure notifications for TNG eWallet are enabled on your device.

question: Do I need to sign a letter of offer for a BizCash loan?
answer: No physical signature is required. Once your loan is approved, you'll receive a notification via your eWallet. The entire process is digital and hassle-free.

question: How long does it take for a BizCash loan to be approved?
answer: You'll receive an update on your eligibility within 1 to 7 working days after submitting your income documents. Approval timelines may vary depending on the bank assessing your application. Once approved, you'll be notified via your eWallet. You can also check your loan status in the 'My applications' screen.

question: If my BizCash application is rejected, can I apply again?
answer: Yes, you can reapply, but your new application will be assessed based on the partner bank's underwriting requirements at the time of submission.

question: Why does my BizCash application status show "Disbursed," but I haven't received my loan disbursement?
answer: If your loan status shows "Disbursed" but you haven't received the money, kindly contact the bank directly for assistance. Call: CIMB Business Call Centre at 1300888828 (Local) or +603 2297 3000 (Overseas) for assistance. Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm Saturday from 8am to 5pm (excluding public holidays)

question: Can I decline a BizCash loan offer?
answer: Yes, you can decline the loan offer. Follow the steps below: - Tap "Accept Offer" to open the acceptance info screen. - Tap the X button at the top right corner. - A drawer will appear. Select "I want to decline the offer now" and tap Submit.

question: Can I make BizCash loan repayments through TNG eWallet?
answer: Loan repayments through TNG eWallet are currently not available. You'll need to make loan repayments via CIMB Bank Berhad or any banking app using online instant transfer to the loan account number provided. Alternatively, you can make repayments at any CIMB Bank Berhad branch or cash deposit machine.

question: Where can I find my BizCash loan account number?
answer: Go to BizCash in your eWallet and tap "My applications " Your loan account number will be displayed there. Alternatively, you can find your loan account number in the Letter Offer provided to you via email from CIMB Bank Berhad.

question: Are there any charges for late repayment on my BizCash account?
answer: Yes. Like other business loans from banks, if any instalment and/or sum is not paid by the due date for payment thereof then an additional interest at the rate of 1.0% per annum will be levied on such instalment and/or sum from the due date to the date of actual payment in full. It's best to stay on track with your repayments to avoid additional charges.

question: Are there any charges for early settlement if I decide to pay off my BizCash loan?
answer: To inquire about charges for early settlement. Please contact your loan- issuing bank directly. Call: 📞 CIMB Business Call Centre: 1300888828 (Local) or 603 2297 3000 (Overseas) Email: mybusinesscare@cimb.com Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm Saturday from 8am to 5pm (excluding public holidays) Email: mybusinesscare@cimb.com

question: I have settled my loan with BizCash. How do I get a settlement letter?
answer: To request for a settlement letter, please contact your loan-issuing bank directly. Call: CIMB Business Call Centre: 1300888828 (Local) or 603 2297 3000 (Overseas)

question: Where can I see my outstanding BizCash loan amount and why isn't my loan status updated?
answer: We're working on making your outstanding loan amount available under "My applications" in BizCash. In the meantime, you may need to contact CIMB Bank Berhad for the most up-to-date status. 📞 CIMB Business Call Centre: 1300888828 (Local) or 603 2297 3000 (Overseas) Email: mybusinesscare@cimb.com Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm Saturday from 8am to 5pm (excluding public holidays)

question: How can I view and manage my BizCash loan?
answer: Your loan details are available under "My applications" in BizCash for 30 days after accepting the loan. After that, the details will no longer be accessible. For further information regarding your loan, you may contact CIMB Bank Berhad: CIMB Business Call Centre: 1300888828 (Local) or 603 2297 3000 (Overseas) Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm Saturday from 8am to 5pm (excluding public holidays) Email: mybusinesscare@cimb.com

question: Why can't I find my previous loan under "My applications" in BizCash?
answer: Accepted loans are displayed under "My applications" in BizCash for 30 days after acceptance, thereafter the details will no longer be accessible. For further information regarding your loans, you may reach out to CIMB Bank Berhad: 📞 CIMB Business Call Centre: 1300888828 (Local) or 603 2297 3000 (Overseas) Email: mybusinesscare@cimb.com Monday to Friday from 8.00am to 7.00pm Saturday from 8.00am to 5.00pm (excluding public holidays)

question: Who should I contact if I need help with my BizCash application on TNG eWallet?
answer: If you're experiencing issues: - with your eWallet's 6-digit PIN, or - submitting your BizCash application, You can reach out to us via our Chatbot from your eWallet between 7am and 10pm daily, including public holidays.

question: Who should I contact if I need help with my BizCash application from CIMB Bank Berhad?
answer: If you have questions about: - CIMB SME Quick Biz Offer, - issues with disbursement to your CIMB Business Current Account, - interest calculations, instalment amounts, - loan restructuring, or - settlement matters including settlement letters, please email your queries to mybusinesscare@cimb.com. Alternatively, you can call: CIMB Business Call Centre at 1300888828 (Local) or +603 2297 3000 (Overseas). Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm, Saturday from 8am to 5pm (excluding public holidays)

question: Is my personal and business information safe when applying for a loan on BizCash?
answer: Yes. We take data security very seriously. All personal and business information submitted during your BizCash application is encrypted and stored according to industry-leading security standards. We follow strict privacy protocols to ensure your data remains safe and secure.

question: How can I be sure that BizCash is a trusted service?
answer: BizCash offers business loan products from trusted banks like CIMB Bank Berhad, which are regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia and are members of PIDM. We comply with all relevant regulatory standards and guidelines, so you can trust that our operations are fully regulated and secure.

question: What measures are in place to prevent fraud and identity theft for BizCash applicants?
answer: Applying for a BizCash loan through your eWallet requires multi-factor authentication (MFA), including a 6-digit PIN and face verification. Face verification is also required when submitting your loan application. Our advanced fraud detection systems continuously monitor for any suspicious activity. If anything unusual is detected, we will notify you immediately and take the necessary steps to protect your account.

question: When withdrawing cash at an ATM using the TNG eWallet visa card, which account option should I choose?
answer: You should choose the "Savings Account" option to proceed with your withdrawal.

question: Why can't I top up my TNG eWallet using my credit or debit card?
answer: Some international credit or debit cards are not supported due to issuer, network, or regulatory restrictions. This varies by country and bank and unfortunately TNG eWallet is unable to override these limitations.

question: Does this mean I cannot use the TNG eWallet?
answer: No. You can still use the TNG eWallet and enjoy cashless payments in Malaysia. If card top-up is unavailable, you may use alternative top-up methods listed below.

question: What alternative top-up methods are available to me?
answer: If card top-up is not supported, you can top up via: - TNG eWallet Reload Pin - DuitNow (DN) Transfer from another Touch 'n Go eWallet user Both options allow you to add funds and continue using the eWallet normally.

question: What is a TNG Reload Pin and where can I buy it?
answer: A Reload Pin is a prepaid voucher with a unique code that you can redeem in the app. You can purchase Reload Pins from: - Convenience stores (e.g. 7-Eleven, MyNews) - Petrol stations - Authorised retailers in Malaysia

question: How do I top up using a Reload Pin?
answer: - Open the TNG eWallet app - Tap Top Up - Select Reload Pin - Enter the 10-digit Reload Pin code - Confirm to complete the top up

question: What is a DuitNow (DN) Transfer?
answer: DuitNow Transfer allows another TNG eWallet user to send money directly to your wallet using your registered mobile number. This is useful if: - A friend or family member in Malaysia can help you top up - You receive money from another user

question: Will my wallet limits or usage be affected if I use these alternative methods?
answer: No. Your wallet balance, spending limits, and usage remain the same regardless of the top-up method used.

question: Can I still pay at shops, restaurants, and tourist attractions?
answer: Yes. Once your wallet is topped up, you can use it for: - Retail and F&B payments - Tourist attractions - Online and offline merchants that accept TNG eWallet

question: Will credit/debit card top-up be supported in the future?
answer: We are continuously working with payment partners and networks to expand top-up options. Availability may improve over time depending on country and card issuer support.

question: Where can I get help if I still have issues?
answer: If you need assistance, please contact: - In-app Help Centre - Customer Care via the TNG eWallet app Our team will be happy to assist you.

question: What is Great Tenang Madani?
answer: Great Tenang Madani is a yearly renewable group term assurance that provides the life assured coverage for death, total and permanent disability, personal accident, covered events and funeral expense. This product also provides daily hospitalisation income benefit in the event of hospitalisation of the life assured. This plan is underwritten by Great Eastern Life Assurance (Malaysia) Berhad.

question: What are the benefits under this plan?
answer: Please refer to the Schedule of Benefits as set out below: Sum Assured (RM) Benefits(RM) Death or Total and Permanent Disability Personal Accident (additional Sum Assured) Covered Event Funeral Expense Hospitalisation Income Benefit (amount of benefit per day) 20,000 20,000 20,000 20,000 5,000 20 Please refer to the master policy contract for more information.

question: How do I become eligible for this coverage?
answer: This product is offered to the eligible members and their legal spouse who have fulfilled the eligibility requirements as follows: - entry age next birthday between eighteen (18) years next birthday to fifty-nine (59) years next birthday; - holds a Malaysian citizenship or permanent residency in Malaysia; and - successfully completed the purchase for this coverage.

question: Who is eligible for the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher?
answer: You may visit www.myptv.my to check if you are eligible for the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher.

question: How can I purchase Great Tenang Madani?
answer: You must fulfil the eligibility requirements and complete the purchase for this coverage via the Perlindungan Tenang partner platform.

question: Do I need to undergo any medical check-up before I am covered?
answer: No medical check-up is required from you. You will only need to answer four (4) health questionnaires during the enrolment process, and successful application is subject to acceptance by the Company.

question: Can I cancel the Great Tenang Madani coverage?
answer: You may cancel your coverage within fifteen (15) days from the date you have received the certificate of assurance by submitting your cancellation request to the Company. You will be entitled to a full refund of premium provided that no claim has been admitted under your coverage. If you are paying your premium using the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher and wish to cancel your coverage within fifteen (15) days, the Company will not refund the premium paid using the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher, however you can use the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher to purchase other Perlindungan Tenang products. You will not be entitled to a refund of premium for cancellation after the fifteen (15) days free look period and you will continue to be covered for the remainder of the coverage period.

question: For general enquiries and policy related enquiries, what are the contact details?
answer: For general or policy related enquiries about the product, you may refer to the Perlindungan Tenang partner platform or refer to the Company website at https://www.greateasternlife.com/my/en/corporate-solutions.html.

question: If I have a problem checking my eligibility or have queries on the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher programme, who should I contact?
answer: You may visit www.myptv.my or contact Life Insurance Association of Malaysia ("LIAM"): Phone : 03-26916628 / 6168 / 8068 Email : liaminfo@liam.org.my

question: How will my personal data be processed?
answer: Upon your agreement to be covered under this plan, your information will be sent through a secured channel to Great Eastern Life Assurance (Malaysia) Berhad for further processing in accordance with the regulation of Personal Data Protection Act 2010. For more information on our Personal Data Protection Notice, kindly visit: https://www.greateasternlife.com/my/en/personal-data-protection-notices.html.

question: Can I make changes to my risk commencement date after I have purchased the coverage?
answer: No, you are not allowed to amend your risk commencement date once you have purchased the coverage under the plan.

question: What is the coverage period?
answer: The coverage period is for a period of twelve (12) months. The coverage period will be renewed automatically at certificate anniversary, up to age fifty-nine (59) years next birthday, provided that full premium payment is received by the Company.

question: When will my coverage commence?
answer: Your coverage will commence and end in accordance with the date as stated in the certificate of assurance which will be issued to you upon successful purchase.

question: Will I be informed once my coverage has commenced?
answer: You will receive an e-mail notification from the Perlindungan Tenang partner once your purchase of the coverage is successful and full premium payment is received by the Company.

question: Will I be allowed to have more than one (1) Great Tenang Madani coverage at any one time?
answer: Each life assured is only allowed to purchase one (1) assurance at a time under this plan. In the event that the life assured is covered under more than one (1) assurance under this plan, the Company will consider the life assured to be insured under the assurance first issued.

question: How much premium do I have to pay?
answer: You are required to pay the premium in accordance with the sum assured that you selected: Sum Assured: RM20,000 Attained Age Next Birthday Monthly Premium(RM) Yearly Premium(RM) 18 - 29 6.50 78.00 30 - 39 9.00 108.00 40 - 49 19.50 234.00 50 - 59 43.50 522.00 Premiums will be charged according to your attained age next birthday at renewal. The premium rates are not guaranteed and may be revised from time to time. Upward revision of premiums, if any, will be done on your certificate anniversary and the Company will notify you in writing at least ninety (90) days before the revision takes place.

question: How can I pay for the premium for this Great Tenang Madani coverage?
answer: You may pay your premium via auto-debit from your eWallet. Alternatively, upon application of the coverage and subject to Perlindungan Tenang Voucher eligibility and availability, the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher worth RM30 will be part of your initial premium. You must pay the remaining premium required for this coverage. The Company will redeem the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher on your behalf. If the Perlindungan Tenang Voucher has been redeemed for other Perlindungan Tenang product, you must pay the full premium for this coverage. For Perlindungan Tenang partner with e-wallet service, you may pay the premium via auto-debit from your e-wallet account through the Perlindungan Tenang partner platform.

question: Are there additional charges/fees for this coverage?
answer: The premium payable is inclusive of twenty-five percent (25%) commission fee.

question: What are the benefits provided under this coverage?
