question: What is Personal Medical Case Management (PMCM) service?
answer: Personal Medical Case Management (PMCM) service is a value-added service programme, in collaboration with our service provider Teladoc Health, Inc., offered to you under Med Insure. PMCM service offers comprehensive information, additional remote medical consultation and additional opinions from specialists and physicians, guidance, assistance in reaching the right diagnosis and support in the process of deciding upon the best medical treatment, and to coordinate quality medical care by leading medical experts in leading medical centers. The PMCM service does not prescribe any treatment but it will assist you to reach the right diagnosis and most appropriate treatment plan. Refer here for more details. You are eligible for the PMCM service provided that:- - You are diagnosed with a medical condition covered by us; and - You have consulted with at least a specialist in a field related to the medical condition.

question: Who is Teladoc Health?
answer: Teladoc Health, Inc. (Teladoc Health) is a global virtual care leader in telehealth services with over 20 years in business serving millions of customers in Asia and around the world.

question: What are the covered medical conditions under the PMCM service?
answer: The list of covered medical conditions under the PMCM service is as follows: - Medical conditions without a diagnosis. The customer must have had previous medical inquiries and consultations with at least one specialist in a field related to the medical problem; - Cancer; - Neurological diseases; - Ear, nose and throat (ENT) diseases; - Ocular diseases / ophthalmology conditions; - Cardiovascular diseases; - Respiratory diseases; - Gastroenterological diseases; - Liver diseases; - Kidney diseases; - Urological conditions; - Endocrine diseases; - Orthopaedic conditions; - Haematological diseases; - Metabolic diseases; - Rheumatology / Immunological diseases; - Infectious diseases, including HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) / AIDS (Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome); - Snoring surgery and sleep apnoea; - Cosmetic / Aesthetic surgery which are medically necessary; - Fertility-related conditions or procedures; - Obstetric conditions; - Sexual diseases / sexually transmitted diseases; - Paediatrics conditions; - Obesity; - Recovery / rehabilitation phase for stroke; - Recovery / rehabilitation phase for severe burns; - Medical conditions in the fields of dentistry; - Combined pathologies; and - All medical conditions other than those listed in exclusion. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents; - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or - Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc.

question: How does PMCM differ from second medical opinion?
answer: Most second opinion services review medical reports and information to provide an independent diagnosis and recommended treatment plan. Following the second opinion, a patient is often left with questions, as well as the need to find the best doctor and hospital to administer the treatment. With Personal Medical Case Management, the customer is never alone. For this service, the case management team, led by the Physician Case Manager, supports the customer throughout their medical journey, from diagnosis to recovery.

question: Who is Physician Case Manager(s)?
answer: Physician Case Manager is a licensed doctor who is active and practicing clinically with an average clinical experience of more than 10 years. Physician Case Manager is well trained in virtual patient communication and familiar with local health system and culture. Physician Case Manager does speak local language.

question: Who will benefit from PMCM service?
answer: Customers diagnosed with serious medical condition who: - Wish to seek a second opinion regarding their diagnosis and treatment options - Want to better understand or validate a complex medical condition - Are diagnosed with a critical illness and want to learn about treatment alternatives - Need to make a critical medical decision and would like support - Require ongoing support and medical advice to better manage their condition

question: Is there any waiting period for the PMCM service?
answer: A waiting period of 30 days is applicable starting from the issue date or the commencement date / reinstatement date of the certificate of insurance, whichever is the later. During this waiting period, you will not be eligible for the benefits under PMCM service. Waiting period is applied only when you are first covered and shall not be applicable after the first year of coverage. However, if there is a break in continuity of the insurance coverage after the first year of coverage, the waiting period shall apply again.

question: What is the end-to-end process of this PMCM service?
answer: - Submit your request to Teladoc Health via portal, email or careline. - Once Teladoc Health receive your submission, they will check your eligibility. - If you submit your request through email or careline, Teladoc Health will provide you an enrolment and consent form to submit. - A personal Physician Case Manager who speaks in your preferred language will be assigned to you and guide you through the entire PMCM process. You will receive the call from your Physician Case Manager within 24 hours. - Your Physician Case Manager will contact you within 24 hours to understand and review your medical issues and medical history. - Your Physician Case Manager will collect your medical history and test reports through email or courier service and produce a complete clinical summary. - Teladoc Health's Medical Committee selects top experts specialised in your condition to review your case, and additional clinical resources are assigned based on complexity and urgency. - Within 10 working days, you will receive a detailed and personalised report with opinions and recommendations compiled by your Physician Case Manager. Additional 2-3 working days are required for translated reports. - Your personal Physician Case Manager will provide you a full explanation of your report and clarify the treatment plan for your condition. - Teladoc Health's Medical Committee identifies 2 treating physician/ leading experts in their field that specialize in your medical issue. Your Physician Case Manager will explain how and why these doctors were chosen, and help you decide with whom, where and what treatment you wish to receive. - After choosing your treating doctor, Teladoc Health will help organize your first appointment and help with travel arrangement if needed. - Your Physician Case Manager will ensure your treating doctor is fully briefed on your medical history so your care can start immediately. - Your Physician Case Manager follows your case during your treatment, to ensure you have received the right treatment and have recovered as planned. Follow-up ceases only upon your request.

question: How do I submit a request for PMCM service?
answer: You may submit a request for PMCM service via: - Portal: agmyap.teladochealthasia.com - Email: aiamy_casemgt@teladochealthasia.com - Careline: +603 3099 7919 (Monday to Sunday, 9am-9pm, excluding public holidays)

question: How will my medical information and reports be obtained?
answer: When you choose to use the PMCM service, you will be required to provide your consent and agree to the terms of the PMCM service, as well as submit all relevant medical information and reports at hand. This approval will also allow Teladoc Health to obtain any missing medical reports from various sources. AIA General Berhad and Teladoc Health recognise the importance and sensitivity of such personal data and will only share information that is required to accurately analyse the customer's condition and enable appropriate recommendations to be made.

question: Do I need to pay an additional fee to activate the PMCM service?
answer: No, you do not need to pay any additional fee to activate the PMCM service.

question: Will I be referred for treatment abroad?
answer: Teladoc Health's assessment of treatment is based on medical necessity. Generally, you will be referred to available treatment locally, but you may be recommended to obtain consultation or treatment abroad in the rare instances where there is a lack of local expertise in relevant fields. Please note that if you decide to proceed with the treatment plan as recommended by Teladoc Health, the cost of medical treatment is not covered under your certificate of insurance of Med Insure.

question: What if the treating doctor disagrees with Teladoc Health's treatment recommendation?
answer: In such a situation, with your permission, Teladoc Health will discuss your case with the treating doctor and collectively agree upon the best course of action for you. However, the decision on how to proceed with the suggested treatment plan is on you.

question: What happens in the case of a wrong medical recommendation?
answer: Teladoc Health provides a Personal Medical Case Management service to empower patients to make informed decisions and support the patients in their medical care journey. Through this service, Teladoc Health helps customers to get accurate diagnosis and select the best course of treatment, however, Teladoc Health does not treat patients directly, nor prescribe medications. The patient makes the treatment decision in consultation with the treating doctor. With that, Teladoc Health does not take on the responsibility for wrong medication recommendation or medical malpractice. AIA General Berhad is not involved in the recommendations that are provided. The intent is for Teladoc Health to provide an independent and neutral opinion.

question: What are the other important terms and conditions of the PMCM service?
answer: - AIA General Berhad reserves the right to withdraw or revise this programme at any time by giving 30 days prior written notice to the Master Policyholder and Insured Person. - This PMCM service for Insured Person shall be terminated upon the earliest occurrence of any of the following events: - upon the expiry date of the certificate of insurance; or - if the certificate of insurance becomes lapsed, becomes terminated or is cancelled; or - AIA General Berhad withdraws the programme completely in accordance with point 1 above. - If the Insured Person decides to proceed with the treatment plan as recommended by Teladoc Health, the cost of medical treatment is not covered under the Med Insure certificate of insurance.

question: Why is my certificate lapsed?
answer: A grace period of 31 days from the due date will be allowed for payment of each subsequent premium. The certificate of insurance will remain in force during the grace period. answer: No, each person is only eligible to be covered under one (1) in-force and active certificate of insurance for CI Insure at any point of time. In the event that the Insured Person is covered under multiple certificates of the same insurance plan, AIA will only pay for the claim under one certificate.

question: Can the certificate of insurance be renewed at the end of the coverage period?
answer: CI Insure is a non-guaranteed yearly renewable plan up to 70 years old. If you would like to renew your coverage automatically, kindly tick the "Auto Renewal & Auto Debit" checkbox when you purchase CI Insure. However, please note that your coverage(s) may be renewed on the anniversary date of the certificate of insurance at AIA's option.

question: The insurance covers an Insured Person up to 70 years old. What happens if the person attains age 71 during the coverage period? Does the coverage terminate immediately?
answer: No, the coverage will remain in force until expiry of the certificate of insurance. However, this person will not be eligible to buy CI Insure or entitled for renewal after the current certificate of insurance expires.

question: What is Personal Medical Case Management (PMCM) service?
answer: Personal Medical Case Management (PMCM) service is a value-added service programme, in collaboration with our service provider Teladoc Health, Inc., offered to you under CI Insure. PMCM service offers comprehensive information, additional remote medical consultation and additional opinions from specialists and physicians, guidance, assistance in reaching the right diagnosis and support in the process of deciding upon the best medical treatment, and to coordinate quality medical care by leading medical experts in leading medical centers. The PMCM service does not prescribe any treatment but it will assist you to reach the right diagnosis and most appropriate treatment plan. Refer here for more details. You are eligible for the PMCM service provided that:- - You are diagnosed with a medical condition covered by us; and You have consulted with at least a specialist in a field related to the medical condition.

question: Who is Teladoc Health?
answer: Teladoc Health, Inc. (Teladoc Health) is a global virtual care leader in telehealth services with over 20 years in business serving millions of customers in Asia and around the world.

question: What are the covered medical conditions under the PMCM service?
answer: The list of covered medical conditions under the PMCM service is as follows: - Medical conditions without a diagnosis. The customer must have had previous medical inquiries and consultations with at least one specialist in a field related to the medical problem; - Cancer; - Neurological diseases; - Ear, nose and throat (ENT) diseases; - Ocular diseases / ophthalmology conditions; - Cardiovascular diseases; - Respiratory diseases; - Gastroenterological diseases; - Liver diseases; - Kidney diseases; - Urological conditions; - Endocrine diseases; - Orthopaedic conditions; - Haematological diseases; - Metabolic diseases; - Rheumatology / Immunological diseases; - Infectious diseases, including HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) / AIDS (Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome); - Snoring surgery and sleep apnoea; - Cosmetic / Aesthetic surgery which are medically necessary; - Fertility-related conditions or procedures; - Obstetric conditions; - Sexual diseases / sexually transmitted diseases; - Paediatrics conditions; - Obesity; - Recovery / rehabilitation phase for stroke; - Recovery / rehabilitation phase for severe burns; - Medical conditions in the fields of dentistry; - Combined pathologies; and - All medical conditions other than those listed in exclusion. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents; - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission; - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc.

question: How does PMCM differ from second medical opinion?
answer: Most second opinion services review medical reports and information to provide an independent diagnosis and recommended treatment plan. Following the second opinion, a patient is often left with questions, as well as the need to find the best doctor and hospital to administer the treatment. With Personal Medical Case Management, the customer is never alone. For this service, the case management team, led by the Physician Case Manager, supports the customer throughout their medical journey, from diagnosis to recovery.

question: Who is Physician Case Manager(s)?
answer: Physician Case Manager is a licensed doctor who is active and practicing clinically with an average clinical experience of more than 10 years. Physician Case Manager is well trained in virtual patient communication and familiar with local health system and culture. Physician Case Manager does speak local language.

question: Who will benefit from PMCM service?
answer: Customers diagnosed with serious medical condition who: - Wish to seek a second opinion regarding their diagnosis and treatment options - Want to better understand or validate a complex medical condition - Are diagnosed with a critical illness and want to learn about treatment alternatives - Need to make a critical medical decision and would like support - Require ongoing support and medical advice to better manage their condition

question: Is there any waiting period for the PMCM service?
answer: A waiting period of 30 days is applicable starting from the issue date or the commencement date / reinstatement date of the certificate of insurance, whichever is the later. During this waiting period, you will not be eligible for the benefits under PMCM service. Waiting period is applied only when you are first covered and shall not be applicable after the first year of coverage. However, if there is a break in continuity of the insurance coverage after the first year of coverage, the waiting period shall apply again.

question: What is the end-to-end process of this PMCM service?
answer: - Submit your request to Teladoc Health via portal, email or careline. - Once Teladoc Health receive your submission, they will check your eligibility. - If you submit your request through email or careline, Teladoc Health will provide you an enrolment and consent form to submit. - A personal Physician Case Manager who speaks in your preferred language will be assigned to you and guide you through the entire PMCM process. You will receive the call from your Physician Case Manager within 24 hours. - Your Physician Case Manager will contact you within 24 hours to understand and review your medical issues and medical history. - Your Physician Case Manager will collect your medical history and test reports through email or courier service and produce a complete clinical summary. - Teladoc Health's Medical Committee selects top experts specialised in your condition to review your case, and additional clinical resources are assigned based on complexity and urgency. - Within 10 working days, you will receive a detailed and personalised report with opinions and recommendations compiled by your Physician Case Manager. Additional 2-3 working days are required for translated reports. - Your personal Physician Case Manager will provide you a full explanation of your report and clarify the treatment plan for your condition. - Teladoc Health's Medical Committee identifies 2 treating physician/ leading experts in their field that specialize in your medical issue. - Your Physician Case Manager will explain how and why these doctors were chosen, and help you decide with whom, where and what treatment you wish to receive. - After choosing your treating doctor, Teladoc Health will help organize your first appointment and help with travel arrangement if needed. - Your Physician Case Manager will ensure your treating doctor is fully briefed on your medical history so your care can start immediately. - Your Physician Case Manager follows your case during your treatment, to ensure you have received the right treatment and have recovered as planned. Follow-up ceases only upon your request.

question: How do I submit a request for PMCM service?
answer: You may submit a request for PMCM service via: - Portal: agmyap.teladochealthasia.com - Email: aiamy_casemgt@teladochealthasia.com - Careline: +603 3099 7919 (Monday to Sunday, 9am-9pm, excluding public holidays)

question: How will my medical information and reports be obtained?
answer: When you choose to use the PMCM service, you will be required to provide your consent and agree to the terms of the PMCM service, as well as submit all relevant medical information and reports at hand. This approval will also allow Teladoc Health to obtain any missing medical reports from various sources. AIA General Berhad and Teladoc Health recognise the importance and sensitivity of such personal data and will only share information that is required to accurately analyse the customer's condition and enable appropriate recommendations to be made.

question: Do I need to pay an additional fee to activate the PMCM service?
answer: No, you do not need to pay any additional fee to activate the PMCM service.

question: Will I be referred for treatment abroad?
answer: Teladoc Health's assessment of treatment is based on medical necessity. Generally, you will be referred to available treatment locally, but you may be recommended to obtain consultation or treatment abroad in the rare instances where there is a lack of local expertise in relevant fields. Please note that if you decide to proceed with the treatment plan as recommended by Teladoc Health, the cost of medical treatment is not covered under your certificate of insurance of CI Insure.

question: What if the treating doctor disagrees with Teladoc Health's treatment recommendation?
answer: In such a situation, with your permission, Teladoc Health will discuss your case with the treating doctor and collectively agree upon the best course of action for you. However, the decision on how to proceed with the suggested treatment plan is on you.

question: What happens in the case of a wrong medical recommendation?
answer: Teladoc Health provides a Personal Medical Case Management service to empower patients to make informed decisions and support the patients in their medical care journey. Through this service, Teladoc Health helps customers to get accurate diagnosis and select the best course of treatment, however, Teladoc Health does not treat patients directly, nor prescribe medications. The patient makes the treatment decision in consultation with the treating doctor. With that, Teladoc Health does not take on the responsibility for wrong medication recommendation or medical malpractice. AIA General Berhad is not involved in the recommendations that are provided. The intent is for Teladoc Health to provide an independent and neutral opinion.

question: What are the other important terms and conditions of the PMCM service?
answer: - AIA General Berhad reserves the right to withdraw or revise this programme at any time by giving 30 days prior written notice to the Master Policyholder and Insured Person. - This PMCM service for Insured Person shall be terminated upon the earliest occurrence of any of the following events: - upon the expiry date of the certificate of insurance; or - if the certificate of insurance becomes lapsed, becomes terminated or is cancelled; or - AIA General Berhad withdraws the programme completely in accordance with point 1 above. If the Insured Person decides to proceed with the treatment plan as recommended by Teladoc Health, the cost of medical treatment is not covered under the CI Insure certificate of insurance.

question: How do I make a claim for Critical Illness plan?
answer: - You need to notify us by submitting your claim within 60 days from the date of diagnosis. - Obtain the claim submission webpage link either in the email you received your e-certificate or Touch 'n Go eWallet > Insurance > 'My Policies'. - Fill in the Attending Physician's Statement (APS) form of respective critical illness, where applicable. - Complete the claim submission webpage and provides the APS and supporting documents required. - Submit your claim to AIA via the claim submission webpage. Payments for benefits will be made by AIA directly. Payment for all benefits will be paid to the Insured Person. - You may obtain the claim form either in the email you received your e-certificate or Touch 'n Go eWallet 'My Policies'. - You may obtain the Attending Physician's Statement (APS) for Heart Attack or Serious Coronary Artery Disease, Cancer, Stroke and Kidney Failure as provided in these links.

question: What is CI Insure?
answer: CI Insure is a non-guaranteed yearly renewable critical illness insurance product which provides coverage for 5 main Advanced Stage Critical Illnesses, Lifestyle Assistance Allowance, and Personal Medical Case Management (PMCM) Service upon diagnosis of covered critical illnesses. This product is structured on a group policy basis, where TNG Digital Sdn. Bhd. (TNGD) is the Master Policyholder. Any TNGD's users who sign up for this product are the Insured Person(s). This product is underwritten by AIA General Berhad and can only be purchased through Touch 'n Go eWallet.

question: When can I make Cash Out request(s)

question: Is there a minimum and maximum Cash Out amount?

question: How long does it take for the Cash Out to be paid to my TNG eWallet?

question: What does it mean when the Cash Out transaction status is shown as unsuccessful?

question: Where can I view my daily earnings?

question: When will the daily earnings be credited to me?

question: Why can't I see earnings after 1 day?
answer: - Cash in is still in progress - Your total GO+ balance is less than RM10.00.

question: How is GO+ projected return calculated?
answer: Projected returns are driven by the rate of returns of its underlying investments, net of all expenses. The math on the projected rate of returns is quite straightforward: GO+ daily earnings are the daily returns from the underlying fund, minus fees charged by the underlying fund managers. The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for the fund includes the Management Fee charged by the Fund Manager, as well as other expenses incurred by the Fund (e.g., custody, marketing, compliance, shareholder services); as the TER includes fixed costs, it may vary slightly depending on the size of the fund.

question: Can I view my Cash In and Cash Out transactions?

question: Can I view all my Cash In and Cash Out transactions for a specified period?
answer: Yes. You can view your Cash In and Cash Out transaction history for up to 90 days.

question: What are the details displayed in Transaction History?
answer: Your transaction history will include details of your Cash In, Cash Out, Daily Earnings and Payment transactions.

question: What is Total Balance and how is it derived?
answer: Total balance means your total cash in amount and daily earnings, less total cash out amount.

question: What is Total Earning and how is it calculated?
answer: Total earnings is the sum of your daily earnings accumulated from the day of your initial Cash In.

question: What is Daily Return Rate?
answer: Daily return rate is the net gain or loss of the Principal e-Cash fund for the day.

question: Is my money safe with TNG eWallet?

Together, these measures ensure that your money stays protected and your transactions remain secure, giving you peace of mind every time you use TNG eWallet.

question: [Chargeback] Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute cases filed with other Financial Institutions
answer: Question Answer 1. What is credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute? Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute is initiated when a cardholder raises a dispute with their payment provider (e.g. a bank) regarding a transaction made through TNG eWallet platform Cardholders may dispute the charges if they believe the transaction was unauthorised or fraudulent. 2. Why are account or card feature restrictions implemented during the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute? To protect all users and the integrity of TNG eWallet platform we will implement temporary account or specific feature restrictions while we thoroughly investigate the dispute, deterring additional disputes and adhering to industry regulations. 3. How long does the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute process take? We aim to resolve each dispute efficiently while ensuring a thorough investigation. Resolution times may vary depending on factors such as the complexity of the case. However, the cardholder may reach out to the payment provider to urge for the investigation outcome. 4. Can I still access my funds during the account restriction period? It depends on the type of restriction: - If there is a complete eWallet account restriction, you will not be able to access your eWallet account. - If only certain features are restricted, reloading using debit/prepaid/credit card is disabled. However, you can still reload your eWallet using alternative methods such as a reload PIN or DuitNow transfer. 5. Why do I need to pay for the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute amount? If the investigation reveals that the disputed transaction was not due to the fault of the merchant, the user is responsible for reimbursing the disputed or charged-back amounts to TNG eWallet .

question: What is the claims process for a non-AIA panel hospital?
answer: In the event you seek treatment from a non-AIA panel hospital, you will have to pay the medical charges in full. Once this is done, you may submit your claim to AIA with all the supporting documents provided by the hospital.

question: How do I make a claim for Medical plan?
answer: For Insure360 (Medical), cashless facility is available to AIA panel and platinum hospitals, whereas you will need to pay first and reimburse from AIA after discharge if you seek medical treatment in a non-AIA panel hospital. Cashless Facility (applicable to AIA panel and platinum hospitals) During Admission: - Present your identity card to the hospital admission officer to request a Guarantee Letter (GL) from AIA. - Check the GL decision via SMS before admission. - Once GL is approved, you will need to pay a hospital deposit if required, depending on the hospital protocols. - You may proceed to admit and seek medical treatment. During Discharge: - The hospital will provide the final billing and complete discharge documents to AIA for final GL. - Once final GL is approved and issued, you will need to pay the deductible amount and any other ineligible expenses (if applicable), then you can discharge from the hospital. Reimbursement Claim (applicable to non-AIA panel hospitals) - You need to notify us by submitting your claim within 30 days from the date of discharge. - Obtain the claim submission webpage link either in the email you received your e-certificate or Touch 'n Go eWallet > Insurance > 'My Policies'. - Complete the claim submission webpage and provide the supporting documents required. - Submit your claim to AIA via the claim submission page. Payments for benefits will be made by AIA directly. Payment for all benefits under reimbursement claim will be paid to the Insured Person.

question: What are the documents required to support a Medical claim?

You can submit the completed claim form together with the necessary documents at any AIA Customer Centres.

question: What is the maximum cut-off time for me to submit a reimbursement claim?

question: How long do I have to wait to get my reimbursement claim?
answer: Upon full submission of your claim documents to AIA, it will take 7 working days for claim approval. Once the claim is approved, payment will be made to your DuitNow account within 24 hours.

question: Can I submit a medical report from another country?
answer: Yes, you may submit any medical reports. However, AIA reserve the right to request further medical reports from locally registered medical practitioner if necessary.

question: What happens if I passed away during the coverage period?
answer: If you passed away during the coverage period, no benefit will be payable as Insure360 (Medical) do not cover death.

question: What does Advanced Stage Critical Illness Benefit cover?
answer: AIA shall pay you 100% of the sum insured for this benefit in a lump sum if you are diagnosed with a covered critical illness within the coverage year and survive for at least 15 days from the diagnosis. The lump sum payment is payable once only. Thereafter, your certificate of insurance shall terminate.

question: What does Lifestyle Assistance Allowance Benefit cover?
answer: Lifestyle Assistance Allowance Benefit provides a monthly cash allowance for home nursing care, hospice care, palliative care and home cleaning services in the event of any inconveniences upon diagnosis of the covered critical illnesses, provided that you survive for at least 15 days from the diagnosis. You are allowed to claim for this benefit within 365 days following the approval date of the Advanced Stage Critical Illness Benefit. This benefit is payable up to a maximum of 3 consecutive months and is payable for one critical illness diagnosis only per coverage year. This benefit shall automatically cease in the following month upon your death if you die before the end of the 3 consecutive months payout.

question: What are home nursing care, hospice care, palliative care and home cleaning services?
answer: - Home nursing care: home-based nursing care provided to Insured Person diagnosed with covered critical illness who requires professional support by licensed nurses to enable recovery and rehabilitation at home. - Hospice care: a specialised care by a registered medical practitioner, physician or licensed nurses that focuses on end-of-life care to the Insured Person diagnosed with covered critical illness. - Palliative care: a specialised care by a registered medical practitioner, physician or licensed nurses that focuses on providing relief from pain and other distressing symptoms suffered by Insured Person associated with the diagnosis of covered critical illness. - Home cleaning services: cleaning services provided by a registered service provider to the place of residence of the Insured Person diagnosed with covered critical illness.

question: What are the major exclusions under Insure360 (Critical Illness)?
answer: Insure360 (Critical Illness) does not cover: - Any illness or surgery other than a diagnosis of a critical illness covered under the policy; - Critical illness of which the signs and symptoms is manifested prior to or within the waiting period; - Any critical illness diagnosed due, directly or indirectly, to a congenital defect or disease which has manifested or was diagnosed before the Insured Person attains seventeen (17) years of age last birthday; - Any pre-existing conditions prior to the issue date or effective date of reinstatement of the certificate of insurance, whichever is later; - Critical illness in the presence of any AIDS or HIV. AIA reserve the right to require the Insured Person to undergo a blood test for HIV as a condition precedent to any acceptance of any claim. - Any of the covered critical illness which is caused by suicide or intentional self-injury; - Any of the covered critical illness resulting directly from alcohol or drugs abuse; - If the Insured Person did not survive for at least fifteen (15) days after the diagnosis of a covered critical illness. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents; - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission; - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or - Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc. Refer to the Policy Wording here for the full exclusions under the Critical Illness plan.

question: How am I eligible to claim Lifestyle Assistance Allowance?
answer: Lifestyle Assistance Allowance is payable for one covered critical illness only during the coverage period. If you have engaged for home nursing care, hospice care, palliative care and/or home cleaning services upon your critical illness diagnosis and survive for at least 15 days after the diagnosis, AIA will pay this allowance to you for each month of care services engagement up to 3 consecutive months. For instance, - Your claim on Lifestyle Assistance Allowance is submitted on 1 Jan 2023, approved and paid by AIA on 15 January 2023. - For subsequent 2 months, you will need to submit the claim on Lifestyle Assistance Allowance in February and March 2023, if you are still engaging the care services. - No claim will be accepted by AIA for April 2023 until expiry date of the certificate of insurance.

question: What is 'Confinement'?

question: What is 'Annual Limit'?
answer: Annual Limit is the maximum amount which AIA will pay in a year for your certificate of insurance for Insure360 (Medical).

question: What is 'Any One Disability'?
answer: 'Any One Disability' means that if 2 or more confinements are due to the same or related disability, or to any complications arising from it, such confinements shall be regarded as 1 confinement if each of them is not separated by more than 90 days from the paid or payable confinement which immediately occurred before this. This rule shall be observed in determining the limit of the benefits.

question: What is 'Disability'?
answer: 'Disability' shall mean a sickness, disease, illness, or the entire covered injuries arising out of a single or continuous series of causes.

question: What is 'Reasonable and Customary Charges'?
answer: 'Reasonable And Customary Charges' shall mean charges for medical care which is medically necessary shall be considered reasonable and customary to the extent that it does not exceed the general level of charges being made by others of similar standing within Malaysia. Such charges when incurred, taking into consideration similar or comparable treatment, services or supplies to individual of the same gender and of comparable age of similar sickness, disease or injury and in accordance with accepted medical standards and practice could not have been omitted without adversely affecting your medical condition.

question: What is 'Medically Necessary'?
answer: 'Medically Necessary' shall mean a medical service which is: a) consistent with the diagnosis and customary medical treatment for a covered disability; and b) in accordance with standards of good medical practice, consistent with current standard of professional medical care, and proven medical benefits; and c) not for the convenience of you or the physician, and unable to be reasonably rendered out of hospital (if admitted as an in-patient); and d) not of an experimental, investigational or research nature, preventive or screening nature; and e) for which the charges are fair and considered reasonable and customary charges for the disability.

question: What is 'Standard Single or Basic Single Room'?
answer: 'Standard Single or Basic Single Room' shall mean a room for single occupancy with single bed and adjoining bathroom in a hospital, which is not a suite, VIP, deluxe room or similarly classed room of a hospital.

question: Is there any limit of my admission days and hospital room and board under Insure360 (Medical)?
answer: There is no limit of admission days that you can utilise under Insure360 (Medical). For hospital room and board, the amount of benefit payable shall not be more than the rate of standard single or basic single room of the hospital and your Annual Limit.

answer: - Pre-existing condition; - Any medical or physical abnormalities existing at the time of birth, as well as neo-natal physical abnormalities developing within six (6) months from the time of birth. - Any disability caused by self-destruction, intentional self-inflicted injuries, willful exposure to danger or any attempt of self-destruction while sane or insane; - Any disability caused by war, declared or undeclared, strikes, riots, civil war, revolution or any warlike operations; - Service in the armed forces in time of declared or undeclared war or while under orders for warlike operations or restoration of public order; - Any violation or attempted violation of the law or resistance to arrest; - Pregnancy, miscarriage or childbirth; - Mental or nervous disorders, treatment of alcoholism, or drug abuse or any other complications arising from it or any drug accident not prescribed by a doctor; - Elective/plastic/cosmetic surgery, circumcision (except circumcision due to infection), eye examination/elective surgery for visual impairments due to nearsightedness, farsightedness or astigmatism or radial keratotomy; all corrective glasses, contact lenses and intraocular lens (except monofocal intraocular lenses in cataract surgery) or the use or acquisition of external prosthetic appliances or devices and prescriptions; - Any form of dental care or surgery including the replacement of natural teeth, placement of denture and prosthetic services such as bridges and crowns or their replacement; - Hospitalisation primarily for investigatory purposes, diagnosis, x-ray examination, general physical or medical examinations, not incidental to treatment or diagnosis of a covered disability or any treatment which is not medically necessary and any preventive treatments, preventive medicines or examinations carried out by a physician, vitamins/food supplements and treatments specifically for weight reduction or gain; - Any treatment or investigation which is not medically necessary, or convalescence, custodial or rest care; - Any specified illness, medical or physical conditions arising within the waiting period for covered injury; - Ionizing radiation or contamination by radioactivity from any nuclear fuel or nuclear waste from process of nuclear fission or from any nuclear weapon material; or - Expenses incurred for donation of any body parts or organ by the Insured Person and acquisition of the organ including all costs incurred by the donor during organ transplant and its complications. AIA will only reimburse the reasonable and customary charges incurred on major organ/bone marrow transplant surgery for the Insured Person being the recipient, limited to once per lifetime; or - Overseas treatment if Insured Person resides or travels outside Malaysia (excluding Singapore and Brunei) for more than 90 consecutive days. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents; - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission; - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or - Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc. Refer to the Policy Wording here for the full exclusions under the Medical plan.

question: There is an exclusion on "Pre-Existing Condition". What does this mean?
answer: This means that Insure360 (Medical) does not cover any sicknesses, diseases, illnesses, injuries or conditions prior to the issue date or the effective date of reinstatement of the certificate of insurance, whichever is later, and that you have reasonable knowledge of this pre-existing condition. Pre-existing condition is referring to the condition(s) only when you are first covered and shall not be applicable after the first year of coverage. However, if there is a break in continuity of the insurance coverage after the first year of coverage, the pre-existing condition shall apply again.

question: How do I make a claim for Medical plan?
answer: For Insure360 (Medical), cashless facility is available to AIA panel and platinum hospitals, whereas you will need to pay first and reimburse from AIA after discharge if you seek medical treatment in a non-AIA panel hospital. Cashless Facility (applicable to AIA panel and platinum hospitals) During Admission: - Present your identity card to the hospital admission officer to request a Guarantee Letter (GL) from AIA. - Check the GL decision via SMS before admission. - Once GL is approved, you will need to pay a hospital deposit if required, depending on the hospital protocols. - You may proceed to admit and seek medical treatment. During Discharge: - The hospital will provide the final billing and complete discharge documents to AIA for final GL. - Once final GL is approved and issued, you will need to pay the deductible amount and any other ineligible expenses (if applicable), then you can discharge from the hospital. Reimbursement Claim (applicable to non-AIA panel hospitals) - You need to notify us by submitting your claim within 30 days from the date of discharge. - Obtain the claim submission webpage link either in the email you received your e-certificate or Touch 'n Go eWallet > Insurance > 'My Policies'. - Complete the claim submission webpage and provide the supporting documents required. - Submit your claim to AIA via the claim submission page. Payments for benefits will be made by AIA directly. Payment for all benefits under reimbursement claim will be paid to the Insured Person.

You can submit the completed claim form together with the necessary documents at any AIA Customer Centres.

question: What does Lifestyle Assistance Allowance Benefit cover?

question: What are home nursing care, hospice care, palliative care and home cleaning services?

question: What is DeviceCare?
answer: DeviceCare, offered by our partner SWAP, includes a device protection program called SWAP Protect. SWAP Protect is a device protection program designed to offer coverage against specific types of damage that may not be covered by the manufacturer's warranty. This includes incidents such as screen cracks, accidental physical and liquid damage.

question: What are the eligible devices that can subscribe to DeviceCare?
answer: While most major brands and models are eligible for subscription to a Swap DeviceCare program, the device must undergo diagnostic tests to successfully complete the enrollment process.

question: What are the type of risks that are covered under DeviceCare?
answer: DeviceCare covers: - Screen Crack - Accidental Damage, including Liquid Damage - Extended Warranty

question: How do I subscribe to DeviceCare?
answer: - For existing devices: You'll first need to run a diagnostic program on your phone. Subscription will only be offered if your device passes the diagnostic test. - For new devices: Subscription must be initiated within 30 days of purchase. During signup, you'll need to confirm the purchase date and declare the device as new. No diagnostic test is required. Please note: - We may request your purchase receipt when you file a claim. - Any inaccuracies in your declaration may result in claim rejection.

question: Who can sign up for DeviceCare?
answer: a) eWallet users with verified accounts. b) Selected devices that are purchased in Malaysia.

question: Am I allowed to subscribe DeviceCare for another device?
answer: Currently, you can only subscribe to the DeviceCare program for a single device.

question: How do I cancel my subscription for DeviceCare?
answer: You may cancel your DeviceCare subscription via the Touch 'n Go eWallet app. To do that, go to Touch 'n Go eWallet app, select DeviceCare. Under My Protection, select Manage and Unsubscribe.

question: My device is damaged after I cancelled my DeviceCare subscription. Is my device still covered under the protection policy?
answer: Your device remains protected under the DeviceCare program until the next billing cycle.

question: Can I reactivate my DeviceCare subscription once I have successfully canceled my subscription?
answer: If your account is not terminated by DeviceCare, you can re-enroll with the same IMEI (same device) under the condition that no claims have been made within the last 12-month period. This applies to re-enrollment and does not involve upgrading or downgrading the plan.

question: Am I allowed to Upgrade or Downgrade my Plans?
answer: Yes, you have the flexibility to upgrade or downgrade your selected plans at any point through the DeviceCare program on the Touch 'n Go eWallet app. To do that, go to DeviceCare on your Touch 'n GO eWallet app. Under My Protection, select Manage and you may select a plan under "Switch Subscription Plan"

question: Will I get a refund should I decide to downgrade my Plan?
answer: The downgrading of plans is effective immediately and there will be no refunds provided as the charges are not prorated.

question: How do I file for a claim if my screen is cracked or if my phone is damaged?
answer: To file a Service Request, kindly contact SWAP hotline at 03-7940 2800 from Monday to Friday, operating between 9am to 6.00pm.

question: What are the Plans available under DeviceCare?
answer: You can subscribe to either the SWAP Protect Plus plan or the Basic plan. Each plan is available with a monthly or 6‐month subscription interval.

question: Are there any other fees aside from the subscription fee?
answer: A Service Request Fee applies to each approved Service Request. The Service Request Fees for Service Request for each failure resulting from Screen Crack or Accidental Damage are stated in the Terms and Conditions. You will be informed when you submit your Service Request of the applicable Service Request Fee. SWAP will collect from you the Service Request Fee prior to providing Replacement Equipment. However, it is recommended to review the terms and conditions to ensure you have a comprehensive understanding of the program's coverage and any potential charges that may apply under specific circumstances.

question: What will happen to my DeviceCare if I forget to top up my Touch 'n GO eWallet during the billing cycle?
answer: We will make three deduction attempts before moving forward with the subscription's termination. The first attempt will occur on the due date of the billing cycle, followed by a second attempt on the subsequent day, and lastly, a third attempt two days after the initial one. Should these deduction attempts prove unsuccessful, the subscription will be terminated.

question: What is the difference between termination and cancelation of subscription?
answer: Cancellation: Initiated by the user when they no longer require the service. The user may re‐subscribe later if they wish. Termination: Initiated by SWAP after three failed payment deductions. Once terminated, the user cannot re‐subscribe to any plan using the same IMEI of the affected device.

question: Am I allowed to re-subscribe once my account has been terminated by SWAP?
answer: Upon termination of account, you will no longer be eligible to sign up for coverage again.

question: Will I get a notification before my payment is due?
answer: No, there will be no reminder sent prior to payment due date however should there be a failed payment attempt, you will receive a "Payment Failed" email on the due date of your payment, 2nd day and also on the 4th day.

question: How do I determine my billing cycle?
answer: Under the 6-month plan, charges will be applied every 6 months from the initial subscription date. In contrast, for the monthly subscription, charges will occur on the same date as the initial subscription, repeating monthly.

question: Once I cancel my subscription how long will this take effect?
answer: The cancellation takes place immediately upon initiation, however the coverage will still be active until the end of current billing cycle.

question: How can I check on my balance of the Service Request limit?
answer: To check you balance, kindly contact SWAP hotline at 03 7940 2800.

question: How many Service Request can I make?
answer: Please refer to the table below: SWAP PROTECT BASIC SWAP PROTECT PLUS Service Request Limit(s) Unlimited same-unit-repair, or 1-time exchange if cannot be repaired [per 12 months starting from commencement date] Limited to: Unlimited same-unit-repair, or 3-times exchange for accidental/liquid damage claim [per 12 months starting from commencement date] Service Request limit(s) examples SR #1: Any time after the commencement date SR #2: 12 months after the commencement date SR #1: Any time after the commencement date SR #2: Any time after the approval date of SR #1 SR #3: Any time after the approval date of SR #2 SR #4: 12 months after the commencement date

question: In the case where a replacement is provided by SWAP, will I be getting a new device?
answer: The Qualified Device will be exchanged with a wireless device of similar type and quality, possessing comparable features and capabilities to the Replacement Device. It should be noted that there is no guarantee, representation, or warranty that the Replacement Device will be an exact match or offer identical functionalities or color as the original item. Our discretion allows for the possibility that the Replacement Device might be remanufactured or refurbished. If you receive a remanufactured or refurbished Replacement Device, it will closely resemble your Qualified Device in terms of functionalities and features. It is important to understand that the Replacement Device will solely consist of the wireless device itself and will not include any associated equipment accessories.

question: What could be the outcome if I provided incorrect information about my device?
answer: Your Service Request may potentially be rejected due to inaccuracies in the information provided. Additionally, these inaccuracies could result in a delay in processing the service request as discrepancies are addressed.

question: What is a Passkey and what do I use it for?
answer: Passkey is a new secure login method created by the FIDO Alliance and World Wide Web Consortium which will allow you to securely login to TNG eWallet without the need of a password and instead, uses biometric authentication (e.g.: Touch ID).

question: What do I need to create a Passkey?
answer: You will first require a device that supports the following operating systems in order to use Passkeys: iOS: 16 and above

question: Creating a Passkey
answer: - Log-in to TNG eWallet on your mobile device using your existing credentials (6-digit PIN) - If your device supports Passkey, you will see the option to 'Create a Passkey'. - Complete the steps following the instructions on your mobile device. - At the end, you will be prompted to use your device biometrics for verification to complete the setup of Passkeys. Alternatively, you may choose to create a Passkey via your Profile Settings by navigating to Profile Settings > Security Authentication > Login > Passkey > click Create a Passkey. Complete the steps following the instructions on your mobile device to finish creating your Passkey. *Do ensure that your iCloud Keychain setting is turned on

question: Removing a Passkey
answer: Removal of Passkeys on TNG eWallet is very simple. Head on over to Profile Settings > Security Authentication > Login > Passkey > click Remove Passkey However, if you wish to remove the Passkey saved on your account/device, below are the following methods: - User needs to go to their iPhone settings > Passwords. - Search for the TNGD service/identifier and delete the related passkey.

question: Login with Passkey
answer: - To login, select Passkey at the Login Method page. - Ensure that you have selected your correct iOS account. - Complete the steps following the instructions on your mobile device. - Begin using your TNG eWallet app.

question: What if my Passkey fails during login?
answer: You will receive an error message and can choose another method of logging in (6-digit PIN)

question: What should I do if I lose my device?
answer: On a device that you can access, log in to your TnGD app via 6-digit PIN and remove your Passkey in Settings (Refer to "Removing a Passkey" section). Alternatively, feel free to reach contact us via Chatbot.

question: What is a Passkey and what do I use it for?
answer: Passkey is a new secure login method created by the FIDO Alliance and World Wide Web Consortium which will allow you to securely login to TnGD app without the need of a password and instead, uses biometric authentication such as fingerprint

question: What do I need to create a Passkey?
answer: You will first require a device that supports the following operating systems in order to use Passkeys: Android: 9 to 13

question: Creating a Passkey
answer: - Log-in to TNG eWallet on your mobile device using your existing credentials 6-digit PIN - If your device supports Passkey, you will see the option to 'Create a Passkey'. - Complete the steps following the instructions on your mobile device. - At the end, you will be prompted to use your device biometrics for verification to complete the setup of Passkeys. Alternatively, you may choose to create a Passkey via your Profile Settings by navigating to Profile Settings > Security Authentication > Login > Passkey > click Create a Passkey. Complete the steps following the instructions on your mobile device to finish creating your Passkey.

question: Removing a Passkey
answer: Removal of Passkeys on TNG eWallet is very simple. Head on over to Profile Settings > Security Authentication > Login > Passkey > click Remove Passkey However, if you wish to remove the Passkey saved on your account/device, below are the following methods: - User needs to access their Google account. - Select security. - Under 'Signing into Google', tap Passkeys. - Select the Passkey to remove and tap 'X'.

question: Login with Passkey
answer: - To login, select Passkey at the Login Method page. - Ensure that you have selected your correct Android account. - Complete the steps following the instructions on your mobile device. - Begin using your TNG eWallet.

question: What if my Passkey fails during login?
answer: You will receive an error message and can choose another method of logging in 6-digit PIN

question: What should I do if I lose my device?
answer: On a device that you can access, log in to your TnGD app via 6-digit PIN and remove your Passkey in Settings (Refer to "Removing a Passkey" section). Alternatively, feel free to reach contact us via Chatbot.

question: What is e-Mas?
answer: e-Mas is the gold investment platform in TNG eWallet, available through GOfinance hub, that allows users to buy and sell digital gold. It significantly enhances financial inclusion by offering a low entry barrier of just RM10, with no transaction fees or hidden costs. The user-friendly design and seamless experience make it accessible for everyone to start investing effortlessly. This end-to-end digital solution ensures a secure and convenient way to invest and monitor gold holdings in real-time, making gold investment simple and accessible for all. e-Mas is one of the many financial services available in GOfinance, making it a comprehensive financial hub within TNG eWallet.

question: What is Cashback Packet?
answer: Cashback Packet is a cashback reward given to customers by merchants upon completion of purchase and payment with TNG eWallet. It contains a randomised amount of cashback for users to claim via their eWallet.

question: What is MyCyberShield?
answer: MyCyberShield makes protecting your personal data simple. With MyCyberShield users are able to monitor and get alerts for breaches of their personal data such as email addresses, usernames, bank account numbers, credit cards, mobile number, NRIC, and passport. MyCyberShield can detect breaches of up to two types of monitored items of your choosing.

question: How do I subscribe to MyCyberShield?
answer: There are three entry point to find MyCyberShield under PrivacySafe icon. Either: - Use the search bar feature on top of the homepage > type PrivacySafe - Click 'More' under My Favourites > type PrivacySafe - Click 'More' under My Favourites > scroll to the bottom to find Special Services Then click PrivacySafe icon and it will redirect to MyCyberShield. You can subscribe to any of the three plans offered or try it for free for 5 days.

question: Do I have to pay after my 5-day trial is over?
answer: No, you will not be charged and MyCyberShield will simply stop monitoring your selected items after the free trial is over.

question: How much is the subscription?
answer: There are three types of subscriptions: - 3 months for RM9.99 - 6 months for RM18.99 - 12 months for RM36.99

question: Can I subscribe to MyCyberShield for one month?
answer: No, the minimum subscription period is three months.

question: What is the difference between the free trial and the paid subscription?
answer: Paid subscribers are allowed to monitor up to two items for every category, i.e., credit card, bank account number etc. Free trial allows you to monitor only one email. Paid subscription also comes with the CyberHelp feature which enable users to call an advisor 24/7 to seek personalized assistance in the event of a data breach.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: To cancel your subscription, switch off automatic payments in the subscription settings.

question: What happens if I want to cancel my subscription?
answer: Your subscription will continue until the end of the subscription. You will not get a refund if you cancel your subscription early.

question: Will I get updated on the data breaches?
answer: You will receive a push notification on your TNG eWallet app if there are any new breaches.

question: What to do if there is a data breach?
answer: You can find advice on what to do next in your MyCyberShield dashboard by tapping on the listed breaches. Refer to "What Should I Do Now" for the necessary steps. Alternatively, you can click on CyberHelp, and an advisor will assist you with the breaches.

question: How often can I edit and delete the monitored items?
answer: You are only allowed to update your monitored items once over the duration of your subscription period.

question: What is SOS Top Up About?
answer: SOS Top Up is a service which enables you to get prepaid credit in advance and pay for it later.

question: Who is eligible to use the service?
answer: To use SOS Top Up, you must at least meet the following requirements: - eWallet customer for at least 3 months - Reloaded your eWallet balance 3 times over a period of 3 months - Purchased a prepaid top up with us at least 3 times in the last 3 months - Have made other transactions multiple times using online and offline in each of the last 3 months

question: Are there any charges to use the service?
answer: A service fee of 20% is applicable which will be charged upon expiration of the pay back period. The total amount to be repaid will be displayed transparently before you confirm the transaction.

question: When does the repayment period begin?
answer: The repayment begins 14 days from the date you successfully complete your SOS Top Up transaction.

question: Are the late payment fees applicable?
answer: No additional fees are charged for late repayment.

question: Can I make another SOS Top Up if the previous one has not been repaid?
answer: No, you may only make another SOS Top Up once the outstanding amount has been repaid in full.

question: What happens if my eWallet balance has insufficient funds?
answer: In the event when there are insufficient funds at the end of the repayment period, auto debit will recur at predetermined intervals until the loan is repaid.

question: Will auto debit still work if I've made a partial payment?
answer: Yes, but your eWallet balance will only be debited for the outstanding amount. For example, if you've received RM10 credit and repaid RM6, only RM4 will be auto debited at the end of the repayment period.

question: Will my prepaid validity days be extended when I receive the SOS Airtime?
answer: Your validity will be extended based on your respective telco's prevailing validity period based on the amount of credit granted.

question: How do I request for SOS Top Up?
answer: There are three entry points to find SOS Top Up feature. Either - Type SOS Top Up in the search bar feature on the top of the homepage > Click on SOS Top Up from the results. - Click 'More' icon under My Favourites > Click 'SOS Top Up' icon on the Featured Banner. - Click 'More' icon under My Favourites > Scroll to Mobile Service under Bills & Utilities > Click 'SOS Top Up' icon Then you can enter your respective details, agreed to our Terms and Conditions and click 'Top up now'.

question: How many times can I request for SOS Top Up?
answer: You can request as many times as you require, as long as you pay back the outstanding balance and service fee.

question: How will I know that SOS Top up has been deducted from my eWallet balance?
answer: You will receive a push notification and will be eligible to request for a new SOS Top up.

question: Why am I only receiving RM5, but my friend gets offered RM10?
answer: The amount will vary based on our scoring of you as a customer, the amount granted is based on their eligibility determined by your general transaction behaviour and prepaid purchase frequency.

question: Why am I no longer eligible to use this service anymore?
answer: Other than requirement for tenure and reload frequency, eligibility to use SOS Top Up service is based other criteria which may be redefined periodically. Continue to reload via our prepaid function and transact on your favourite stores offline and online with your Touch n' Go eWallet to be eligible to use SOS Top Up in future.

question: I purchase home contents coverage only, can I request for cancellation note?
answer: Cancellation note is not applicable for Home Contents plan.

question: Can I increase/ decrease my sum insured during renewal?
answer: Yes, you are allowed to update your sum insured for building and/or home contents of your policy during renewal. Do ensure that your coverage is adequate. - You may review your building sum insured by getting the estimated rebuilding cost from the Building Cost Calculator (BCC) by Persatuan Insurans Am Malaysia (PIAM) at the following link: http://www.piam.org.my/consumer/industry/building-cost-calculator-bcc/ - Or you may review your home contents sum insured by ensuring it covers the total amount of your home contents. If you would like to update your sum insured, you may contact our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via WhatsApp at 019 629 9660 or e-mail my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, excluding public holidays).

question: Can I add or remove my add-ons coverages during renewal?
answer: Yes, you are allowed to update your add-on coverages for building and/or home contents of your policy during renewal. If you would like to update your add-on coverages, you may contact our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via WhatsApp at 019 629 9660 or e-mail my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, excluding public holidays).

question: Can I claim for loss or damage arising from theft (including forcible and non-forcible break-ins)?
answer: No, SafeHome policy does not cover loss or damage due to theft, burglary, robbery or the like.

question: Can I claim for loss or damage due to tempest or storm (including loss/ damage to electrical installations such as auto gates, CCTV/alarm systems, etc.)?
answer: No, SafeHome policy does not cover loss or damage due to storm or tempest (e.g. hurricane, tornado, cyclone, typhoon, windstorm).

question: If I purchased SafeHome policy covering my home contents, how do I submit a claim if I don't have a previous receipt?
answer: You may submit other proof of ownership such as bank statement, credit card statement, photographs taken before the loss, warranty card, packaging box, etc. For damaged items, we would require the year of purchase, brand and model of the affected item.

question: How does auto renewal work?
answer: If you have opted in for auto renewal, AIA will automatically charge renewal premium from your Touch 'n Go eWallet 60 days before your current policy expires, provided that there is sufficient balance in your eWallet. Once charging is successful, you will be notified via email and you will receive renewed policy after your current policy expires. In the event that your renewal premium is failed to be charged from your Touch 'n Go eWallet due to insufficient balance, AIA will continuously charge renewal premium from your eWallet every day until it is successful by the expiration date of your current policy. Once you reloaded your eWallet with sufficient amount, AIA will then charge the renewal premium within 24 hours. However, if the charging of renewal premium remains failed on the expiration date of your current policy, your policy will not be renewed and you will need to repurchase a new policy from Touch 'n Go eWallet again.

question: What happens if my eWallet does not have sufficient balance which caused failed charging?
answer: If you have opted in for auto renewal, renewal premium will be charged from your Touch 'n Go eWallet continuously every day starting from 60 days before your current policy expires until it is successful by the expiration date of your current policy. Once you reloaded your eWallet with sufficient amount, AIA will then charge the renewal premium within 24 hours. However, if the charging of renewal premium remains failed on the expiration date of your current policy, your policy will not be renewed and you will need to repurchase a new policy from Touch 'n Go eWallet again.

question: What will I receive before my policy expires?
answer: You will receive an email 60 days before your policy expires, with a renewal notice stating your renewal policy summary and renewal premium based on the same coverage amount and add-ons coverages as your current policy. However, in the event that of a claim from your current policy, AIA reserves the right not to renew your policy by giving 30 days prior notice from your policy expiry date, and the renewal premium charged will be fully refunded to you. You are encouraged to seek for alternative fire insurance coverage for your property.

question: I received an email with renewal notice and a link. What is the link for?
answer: If you have not opted in for auto renewal when you purchased your SafeHome policy, or if you have not provided authorization to us to auto debit the renewal premium from your eWallet, you can click on the link in the email to give your consent. Thereafter, auto renewal will be performed when your policy expires. We strongly encourage you to auto renew your policy for continuous protection.

question: How do I pay my renewal premium?
answer: If you have opted in for auto renewal, renewal premium will be automatically charged from your Touch 'n Go eWallet 60 days before your policy expires. If the charging is unsuccessful due to insufficient balance, you will need to reload your eWallet with sufficient amount and AIA will charge the premium within 24 hours from your Touch 'n Go eWallet, before your current policy expires. If the charging of renewal premium remains failed on the expiration date of your current policy, your policy will not be renewed and you will need to repurchase a new policy from Touch 'n Go eWallet again.

question: Can I renew my policy without selecting auto renewal?
answer: Yes, you can repurchase a new policy from Touch 'n Go eWallet again before your current policy expires. You will need to select the effective date of coverage with the date of 1 day after the expiration date of your current policy, e.g. if your current policy expiring on 20 June 2023, you will need to select your next effective date of coverage as 21 June 2023.

question: What will I receive after renewal premium is successfully charged?
answer: You will be notified via email once renewal premium is successfully charged from your Touch 'n Go eWallet. Your renewed policy will only be sent to you once your current policy expires.

question: Does waiting period apply in the next policy period (renewal)?
answer: Waiting period of fourteen (14) days is only applicable for Flood Damage coverage (if Flood Damage add-on coverage is selected). Waiting period is only applicable when the policy is first covered with Flood Damage add-on coverage and shall not be applicable in the subsequent policy period. However, if there is a break in continuity of the Flood Damage add-on coverage after the first year of coverage, the waiting period shall apply again. The waiting period on Flood Damage coverage is illustrated in the three scenarios below: - Scenario 1: - Policy coverage period of 1st May 2023 to 30th April 2024 (refers to "1st year"). The policy is with Flood Damage add-on coverage selected, so the waiting period applies for 1st year. - Policy is then renewed on 1st May 2024, coverage until 30th April 2025 (refers to "2nd year"). The renewed policy is attached with Flood Damage add-on coverage as well. Given that the coverage period with Flood Damage add-on is continuous, i.e. there is no gap in coverage between the 1st year and 2nd year policy, hence waiting period does not apply for 2nd year. - Should there be any claim arising from flood happening between 1st May 2024 and 31st April 2025, AIA will be liable for the claim since the flood happens within the policy coverage period and waiting period does not apply. - Scenario 2: - Policy coverage period of 1st May 2023 to 30th April 2024 (refers to "1st year"). The policy is with Flood Damage add-on coverage selected, so the waiting period applies for 1st year. - Policy is then renewed on 1st May 2024, coverage until 30th April 2025 (refers to "2nd year"). The renewed policy is not attached with Flood Damage add-on coverage. Policy is renewed next year on 1st May 2025, coverage until 30th April 2026 (refers to "3rd year"). The renewed policy is attached with Flood Damage add-on coverage again. Given that there is a break in continuity of the coverage period for Flood Damage add-on, i.e. there is no flood coverage in 2nd year, hence waiting period applies for 3rd year. - Should there be any claim arising from flood happening between 1st May 2025 and 14th May 2025, AIA will NOT be liable for flood claim since the flood happens within the waiting period. - Scenario 3: - Policy coverage period of 1st May 2023 to 30th April 2024 (refers to "1st year"). The policy is with Flood Damage add-on coverage selected, so the waiting period applies for 1st year. - Policy is then renewed on 2nd May 2024, coverage until 1st May 2025 (refers to 2nd year"). The renewed policy is attached with Flood Damage add-on coverage. Given that there is a break in continuity of the coverage period for Flood Damage add-on, i.e. there is a one-day gap between the 1st year and 2nd year policy, hence waiting period applies for 2nd year. - Should there be any claim arising from flood happening between 2nd May 2024 and 15th May 2024, AIA will NOT be liable for flood claim since the flood happens within the waiting period.

question: What is my coverage amount and add-on coverages during renewal?
answer: Your coverage amount and/or add-on coverages for your building and/or home contents will remain the same during renewal. If you would like to update your coverage amount or add-on coverages, you may contact our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via e-mail at my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, excluding public holidays).

question: Why my SafeHome policy is not renewed?
answer: Your SafeHome policy is not renewed due to the one of the following reasons: - Renewal premium is failed to be charged from your Touch 'n Go eWallet due to insufficient balance until the day your current policy expires, hence you will need to repurchase a new policy from Touch 'n Go eWallet again; or - You have a claim under your previous SafeHome policy, hence you are not eligible for renewal. Any premium being charged for the renewed policy will be fully refunded to you; or - You have failed our renewal underwriting guidelines, hence you are not eligible for renewal.

question: Why is my Auto Payment being disabled?
answer: WalletSafe is enhanced with new and better coverages in two plan options, i.e. Basic Plan and Pro Plan on 20 July 2023. The WalletSafe coverage offered before 20 July 2023 is no longer available for purchase after 20 July 2023, but your WalletSafe cover purchased before 20 July 2023 will be run-off until your certificate expiry date, or you could switch to the new plan to enjoy better coverage. With the launch of the new WalletSafe plans, TNG eWallet has disabled Auto Payment for all Insureds who have purchased WalletSafe with Auto Payment function turned on prior to 20 July 2023.
category: Customer who purchased WalletSafe before 20 July 2023

question: How do I enable Auto Payment again for my WalletSafe certificate?
answer: If you would like to enable Auto Payment again, you may go to WalletSafe page in TNG eWallet app by switching to the new plan. Kindly note that the premium of your existing WalletSafe certificate is not refundable upon switching to the new plan.
category: Customer who purchased WalletSafe before 20 July 2023

question: Can I keep the same coverage as my existing WalletSafe certificate without switching to the new plan in the next coverage period?
answer: Unfortunately no, the WalletSafe coverage offered before 20 July 2023 is no longer available for purchase after 20 July 2023. Your WalletSafe cover purchased before 20 July 2023 will be run-off until your certificate expiry date, or you could switch to the new plan to enjoy better coverage.
