question: What is 'Scan QR in/out Parking'?
answer: 'Scan QR in/out Parking' was launched to enable a seamless payment experience at the parking site using TNG eWallet. There is no longer any need for parking tickets. Users will need to scan the QR code at the parking entry and exit.

question: How does the 'Scan QR in/out Parking' work?
answer: 'Scan QR in/out Parking' feature is designed to simplify your experience to pay your parking fees and it works in 3 simple steps: Entry: When you enter the parking sites by using TNG eWallet 'Pay' function, the parking reader will scan your QR code. Exit: When you exit the parking sites by repeating the same entry process, we calculate the duration of your parking. If the parking duration is payable, we process the payment. Payment: We use the fare and deduct the amount from your eWallet balance and send you a notification of your payment.

question: Do I need to pay any additional fees for using 'Scan QR in/out Parking'?
answer: No, we do not levy any additional charges. All charges are levied based on the fare calculation provided by the parking site operators.

question: How is 'Scan QR in/out Parking' better than using tickets for parking?
answer: Parking ticket issued during your entry needs to be paid at the autopay machines and creates an unwanted step in your journey. These autopay machines need you to tender change and are crowded during busy days. Scan QR in/out Parking is focused on removing such unwanted and time-consuming steps so that you can travel with ease.

question: What if my mobile phone ran out of battery? How can I exit?
answer: You can approach the mall's carpark management and provide them with your TNG eWallet account mobile number. They will be able to check your rates in the system to reissue you a parking ticket to exit.

question: What if my mobile phone has no internet connection? How can I exit?
answer: You don't need to have an internet connection to use the 'Pay' function in TNG eWallet. TNG eWallet will be able to generate the QR code without an internet connection.

question: Is there any minimum balance to be maintained during entry?
answer: No minimum balance is required to use 'Scan QR in/out Parking'. However, we recommend that you maintain enough balance to ensure that the payment can be processed successfully.

question: What happens if my eWallet balance is insufficient at the time of exit from the parking site?
answer: When you exit the parking site, we will check your latest eWallet balance to process the payment. In case your eWallet balance is insufficient, the barrier gate will not open. Kindly ensure you have enough balance before exiting the parking site.

question: What is TapSecure on TNG eWallet?
answer: TapSecure is one of the security features in your TNG eWallet that helps keep your money and account safe. It's an extra layer of protection for certain transactions. When this happens, you'll need to approve the transaction from the phone that's linked to your eWallet. This helps make sure that only you can approve payments, even if someone else has your account details. TapSecure is just one of the many security steps we use to keep your eWallet safe from fraud and unauthorised use.

question: How does TapSecure protect my TNG eWallet account?
answer: TapSecure only works on the device you've linked to your TNG eWallet account, meaning no one else can approve transactions from another phone. This added layer of security ensures that only you can authorise actions on your account, keeping your funds safe and secure.

question: What does it mean to link your phone for TapSecure authorisation?
answer: Linking your phone or device means setting it as the main device for your TNG eWallet. This allows you to approve certain transactions with just one tap through TapSecure, directly on the app. It's an added layer of security that helps protect your account. Even if someone else knows your login details, they won't be able to approve transactions unless they're using your linked phone. If you're on a phone that hasn't been linked, you'll be asked to do so before you can continue. The process is quick. Just follow the on-screen steps and complete a few security checks. Forgot your 6-digit PIN? You can reset it by tapping the red box shown below.

question: How many devices can I link to my TNG eWallet account?
answer: You can only link one device per TNG eWallet account. This ensures that all transactions can only be approved by you from your main device for added security.

question: What if I need to change devices? What happens to TapSecure for my TNG eWallet account?
answer: Once you've removed the TNG eWallet app from your old device, download the app on your new device and link it to your account. The app will guide you through setting up TapSecure again, so you can continue approving transactions securely as usual. To set it up manually, go to "Settings" and select "Link To This Device".

question: What if I need to reinstall the TNG eWallet app on my device?
answer: If you delete and reinstall the TNG eWallet app, you'll need to link your device to your account again. The app will guide you through the steps automatically. To do it manually, go to "Settings" and select "Link To This Device".

question: How do I approve transactions with TapSecure on TNG eWallet?
answer: For certain transactions, you'll be required to confirm and authorise the payment via TapSecure. This applies to payments made through shopping apps installed on your device or on online platforms that accept TNG eWallet. For app-based transactions, you'll be redirected to the "TapSecure Approval" screen, showing the transaction type and amount. Simply tap "Yes" to approve or "No" to reject. For online transactions, you'll receive a notification. Tap on it to open the "TapSecure Approval" screen, review the transaction details, then tap "Yes" or "No". Alternatively, you can go to your Profile page, scroll down to the Payment section, then tap on "TapSecure Approval" to view and respond to any pending requests.

question: I sold or gave away my phone without deactivating or uninstalling TNG eWallet. What should I do if TapSecure is still active?
answer: Don't worry. Just download TNG eWallet on your new device and follow the steps to link it to your account. Once your new device is linked, the app on your previous device will automatically be unlinked and can no longer be used to approve transactions. If you don't have access to a new device yet, please reach out to our Careline here.

question: What is 'Estimated Market Value'?
answer: The Estimated Market Value is a feature that shows the indicative market value range of the vehicle that is linked to its respective RFID Tag subject to the vehicle condition, mileage and other determining factors.

question: Why do I not see the Estimated Market Value for my vehicle?
answer: The Estimated Market Value will only be shown if the vehicle's make (brand), model and year have been registered via the RFID Tag. Vehicles that have not registered any one of this information may not have the Estimated Market Value shown. You are only able to register/submit this vehicle information when activating your RFID tag.

question: How else can I check the Estimated Market Value of my vehicle since it does not show?
answer: Users can simply click on 'Book FREE Inspection' and get a quote from our partner.

question: What is "Money Packet"?
answer: "Money Packet" is a new feature that allows you to have fun by transferring a pool of money to family and friends to claim. The total amount of Money Packet will be randomly distributed by the system. It is a great way of gifting using TNG eWallet.

question: What is the difference between "Money Packet" and "Transfer"?
answer: "Money Packet" enables you to send money to more than one person whereas "Transfer" only allows one person to receive only.

question: Who can create a Money Packet?
answer: Any TNG eWallet users who completed account verification (eKYC) are eligible to create the Money Packet and share the Money Packet. Please refer to article How do I verify my Touch 'n Go eWallet account? for more information.

question: How to create and share a Money Packet?
answer: Once you have successfully verified your account, you will be able to create Money Packet. Watch the video on how to create and share the Money Packet.

question: Which Wallet balances will be deducted for creating Money Packet?
answer: Your eWallet balance will be prioritized for this transfer. If your eWallet balance is insufficient, your GO+ balance will be used to perform the transfer. If both balances are insufficient, you need to reload your Wallet and make sure sufficient balance in either eWallet or GO+ to create the Money Packet.

question: How long is the Money Packet QR code / link valid?
answer: Each Money Packet created by the Sender are valid for the next twenty-four (24) hours upon time of creation.

question: I have created a few Money Packets. How do I check the progress of my Money Packets?
answer: Each of your Money Packet will have a status displayed as in the following table and what it means: Status Description Pending Created but not ready for sharing In progress Active and on-going Cancelled Cancelled before ended automatically and the remaining money to be refunded Fully claimed Has been fully claimed by the Receivers and no remaining balance to be refunded Ended Ended after 24-hours validity and the remaining money to be refunded

question: Where can I check back all my Money Packets' status and transaction?
answer: You can find the past and current Money Packet activities under the 'Activity' section. Tap on the Money Packet activities to check its status and all the successful transfers transaction under the 'Leaderboard' section.

question: How many people can I share in ONE (1) Money Packet?
answer: Each Money Packet can be distributed between 2 - 100 unique users.

question: What is the number of Money Packets can I create?
answer: You can create up to ten (10) Money Packets at a single time, including the status 'Pending' and 'In-progress'.

question: What is the maximum amount of Money Packet can I create?
answer: You can create up to a total amount of RM1,000.00 (One Thousand Malaysian Ringgit) in one (1) Money Packet, subject to your eligible monthly/yearly transaction limit.

question: Can I cancel an 'In-progress' Money Packet within the 24-hours?
answer: Yes, you can always cancel your Money Packet before it expired or fully claimed.

question: How to cancel an 'In-progress' Money Packet?
answer: - Tap on the 'In-progress' Money Packet under the 'History' section. - Click on 'Cancel Money Packet' at the bottom of page - Confirm Money Packet cancellation

question: How do I get back the balance when there is a money balance unclaimed in cancelled / expired Money Packet?
answer: If there is any unclaimed or remaining fund balance in the expired Money Packet, it will be refunded automatically to the Sender's TNG eWallet account within another twenty-four (24) hours.

question: Why can't I create a Money Packet?
answer: It could be due to several reasons. Please ensure that you fulfil the following criteria in order to create a Money Packet successfully. - Completed account verification (eKYC) - Not more than ten (10) 'In-progress' or 'Pending' Money Packets at the same time - Sufficient balance in either eWallet or GO+ wallet - The Money Packet amount will not hit monthly transaction limit - Install TNG eWallet app with 1.7.90 version and above

question: I have shared my Money Packet with three (3) of my friends. Can his sister claim the Money Packet that I created?
answer: Yes, anyone who has your Money Packet link or QR code will be able to claim your Money Packet.

question: I realised that my friend shared my Money Packet with his friend(s) but I do not wish other people to claim my Money Packet. What can I do?
answer: You can cancel your Money Packet anytime.

question: Who can receive a Money Packet?
answer: All Touch 'n Go eWallet users can receive a Money Packet after the account was eKYC.

question: How to receive the Money Packet sent to me?
answer: Once you have received a valid Money Packet QR code or link, you can use the "Scan" function in Touch 'n Go eWallet app to scan the QR code or click on the link, and tap on "Open Now" to receive money. Watch the video on how to receive the Money Packet correctly.

question: How many times can I receive the money from each received Money Packet?
answer: You are only able to receive the money ONCE from each Money Packet.

question: Where can I look back the transaction history of money received from Money Packet?
answer: You can find all money received transactions on the Money Packet page under the 'Activity' section.

question: Can I claim my own created Money Packet?
answer: No, you will not able to claim from your own Money Packet.

question: What will be the amount I receive?
answer: The total amount of Money Packet sent will be randomised by the system to each Receiver who shall be able to receive at least RM0.01.

question: Why I didn't receive the money from Money Packet after open it?
answer: Please ensure that you fulfil the following criteria to receive the money successfully. - Receive money once only from one (1) Money Packet - The receiving money amount doesn't make you exceed the Wallet balance limit - Money Packet is still in "In progress" status - Not receiving own Money Packet - Install TNG eWallet app with 1.7.90 version and above

question: If I do not have an account with TNG eWallet, how do I receive the Money Packet?
answer: You just need to download the TNG eWallet app. Upon successful account eKYC, open the Money Packet sent to you and the money will be credited into your account immediately.

question: What type of motorcycle insurance / takaful is provided? What types of cover can I choose?
answer: - Third Party: covers the third party's loss (injuries / death / loss or damages to their property) caused by your vehicle only. - Comprehensive: covers the above plus the damages to the policyholder's motorcycle up to its market value. And, covers the loss or damages to your vehicle due to accidental fire or theft. We do not provide 'Third Party, Fire and Theft' coverage currently.

question: How do I determine the sum insured for my motorcycle?
answer: Sum Insured is the maximum amount of money you will be able to claim from your insurer. In other word, the sum Insured should equal to the amount of money to replace your vehicle or market value of your vehicle so you will not have to cover for the difference.

question: How will my motorcycle insurance premium be calculated?
answer: Many different factors will be taken into consideration, depending on the insurers. Some of the factors are market value of the vehicle, vehicle type, location, age, gender and previous bike riding history.

question: Will the coverage be extended to someone else riding my motorcycle?

question: What is No Claim Discount (NCD)?

question: What is an excess?
answer: Excess is the first amount you are required to pay towards a claim you make on your vehicle. The claims excess is determined by the insurance/takaful provider based on factors such as your risk profile or vehicle details. A compulsory excess may apply depending on the circumstances defined in your policy or certificate.

question: What payment option(s) are available?

question: My motorcycle variant doesn't match, what can I do?
answer: If your motorcycle variant is not listed, you should contact our insurer / takaful partner directly to renew with the correct motorcycle variant. Alternatively, you may also proceed to renew your motorcycle insurance / takaful first, then contact our insurer / takaful partner to perform endorsement on the motorcycle variant. Additional premium / contribution might be incurred if your sum insured / sum covered is higher for your motorcycle variant.

question: Why can't I get my quotation?
answer: It could be one of the following reasons: - Your motorcycle plate number and / or NRIC were wrongly keyed in. - Your vehicle model is not covered by our insurance/takaful partners. - Your vehicle sum insured/ covered exceeded the maximum sum Insured. - Your vehicle sum insured/ covered is less than the minimum sum Insured. - Your vehicle's age limit exceeds our partner's acceptance limit. - Your next policy/certificate renewal date is more than 60 days. - Your insurance policy/takaful certificate has expired.

question: How do I acquire more information about insurance / takaful products listed?

question: Are there any hidden charges?
answer: No. Everything will be displayed in the 'Payment Summary' page.

question: Who should I call if I encounter system or payment failure?
answer: Please reach out to us via Live Chat on the TNG eWallet apps, click here

question: How do I receive my policy / certificate documents after I renew my motorcycle insurance / takaful?
answer: You will receive the e-policy / e-certificate document via email from our insurance / takaful partner / agent via e-mail within 24 hours from the date of successful purchase.

question: Can I purchase motorcycle insurance / takaful and road tax for others?
answer: Yes, you can. So long as you have the following information: Motorcycle Plate Number, NRIC / Passport No. and Postcode. Their e-policy / e-certificate will go to the email inputted in 'Owner's detail' page when you help them renew their insurance.

question: What is the Touch 'n Go eWallet Visa Card ("Visa Card")?
answer: The Visa Card is a prepaid card that is linked to your TNG eWallet balance. It can be used worldwide and online for the payment of goods and services, wherever a Visa card is accepted. In addition, you can withdraw cash from any ATM that is enabled on the Visa Plus network. Look out for these logos to know where you can use your Visa Card:

question: How can I apply for a Visa Card?
answer: You can only apply for the card through the TNG eWallet app: as long as you are 12 years old, successfully completed your eKYC and are currently residing in Malaysia. Please note that each user is entitled to only one (1) card at a time. Step 1: Tap on "Visa Card" Step 2: Then on "Get Card Now" Step 3: Enter your preferred name, confirm delivery address and tap "Pay Now" when ready Step 4: Your card's on its way. Track delivery status here

question: What is the difference between Touch 'n Go eWallet Visa Card and the Touch 'n Go Card?
answer: The Touch 'n Go eWallet Visa Prepaid Card and the Touch 'n Go Card are two (2) different products, with the following key differences: Touch 'n Go eWallet Visa Card Touch 'n Go Card Everyday Card Travel Card Card design Card issuer Touch 'n Go eWallet Touch 'n Go Card scheme These are Visa cards that can be used worldwide and online, wherever a Visa card is accepted. These cards can only be used at selected Touch 'n Go touchpoints. Card balance eWallet balance On card (separate from eWallet balance, unless linked via PayDirect for tolls and parking) Toll payments Yes (Selected tolls) Yes Mass transit Yes (Selected trains) Yes Parking Yes Yes Where to apply? Application can only be done via the Touch 'n Go eWallet app, look out for the Visa logo on the homepage or in your profile page. There are multiple places where you can purchase the card: Via Touch 'n Go eWallet app, look out for the TNG card logo on the homepage. On the Lazada eshop, at selected petrol kiosks and resellers.

question: Are there fees and charges for the card?
answer: Visa Everyday Card Visa Travel Card Card Application Fee RM15 (includes delivery fee of RM5) RM20 (includes delivery fee of RM5) Annual Fee RM8.00 (waived for the first year) Example If you applied for your Visa card on 1 January 2023, the annual fee will be charged on 1 January 2024, 1 year after your application.

question: I have incorrectly entered or would like to change the delivery address for my Visa Card
answer: You can update your delivery address before the card is dispatched or while it is still out for delivery. However, once the card has already been delivered to the wrong address, the delivery address can no longer be changed. For assistance, please contact us through the Chatbot in the TNG eWallet app. Our operating hours are Monday to Sunday, 7:00 AM - 10:00 PM, including public holidays.

question: How do I track the delivery status of my card?
answer: You can track the delivery status of your Visa Card using the tracking URL found in the Card section of the TNG eWallet app. Delivery usually takes up to 10 working days from the date you applied for the card. If delivery is unsuccessful, our logistics partner will attempt to deliver the card up to three times. If all attempts fail, the card will be returned to us. To request redelivery, please contact us through Chatbot in the TNG eWallet app. Our operating hours are from Mondays to Sundays, 7.00AM to 10.00PM (including public holidays).

question: How do I activate my physical card?
answer: Upon receiving your Visa Card, there will be a QR and 4-digit code printed within the letter which you may use to activate your physical card. You may refer to the steps below: The QR and 4-digit activation code does not have an expiry date and can only be used once to activate your physical Visa Card.

question: I'm having trouble activating my card, what should I do?
answer: If you're having trouble activating your card: - Ensure that you have followed the steps listed in the 'How do I activate my physical card?' article. - If both activation methods fail (QR / 4-digit code), or if you have lost/misplaced your welcome letter, kindly contact us via Chatbot in the TNG eWallet app for further assistance. 🕒 Our Chatbot is available from Monday - Sunday, from 7:00AM - 10:00PM (including public holidays)

question: When can I start using my card?
answer: Once you have successfully applied for the card, you will be provided with a virtual card which you can start using immediately for online transactions, whilst you wait for the delivery of your physical card. Card details for online payments can be found on the card dashboard, in the TNG eWallet app.

question: I entered my 6-digit card PIN incorrectly too many times and now my card is locked.
answer: If you enter the wrong PIN too many times, your Visa Card will be automatically locked for security reasons. You can unlock your card from the Card Dashboard in the TNG eWallet app. For detailed steps, refer to the FAQ "What should I do if my card is lost/stolen" in the Security section. After unlocking your card, we strongly recommend that you immediately change your 6‐digit card PIN. Please note: - The Visa Card PIN and the TNG eWallet PIN are different. - For more details, see the FAQ "What is the difference between my TNG eWallet PIN and Visa Card PIN?" If you need further assistance, please contact us via Chatbot in the TNG eWallet app. Our operating hours are Monday to Sunday, 7:00 AM - 10:00 PM, including public holidays.

question: How can I control the security of my card?
answer: The card dashboard, which can be found in the TNG eWallet app, allows you to control the security of your card and requires your TNG eWallet PIN to access. You can enable or disable certain use cases, set your contactless Paywave limit and temporarily lock your card. The full list of security functions of the card is shown below: You are advised to not share your card security information to others and always keep your TNG eWallet app up-to-date with the latest version.

question: What should I do if my card is lost/stolen?
answer: If your Visa Card is lost or stolen, immediately lock your card to safeguard the funds in your eWallet account. In the meantime, please make police report at your nearest police station for our reference. Alternatively, you may reach out to us via Chatbot within the TNG eWallet app or contact our Careline at 03-50223888 to terminate your card immediately. You may refer to the steps to lock/unlock your Visa Card here.

question: I do not have access to my TNG eWallet app, what do I do?
answer: No worries, without login to account you may still reach out to us via Chatbot within TNG eWallet. Our operating hours are Monday to Sunday, 7.00 am to 10.00 pm (including public holidays).

question: After activating, I need to set a 6-digit card PIN. What is this?
answer: This is a security PIN that you need to enter for all PIN-enabled offline transactions. This is different from your eWallet 6-digit PIN and you should ensure that you do not use the same PIN code. If at any time you want to change your card PIN, you can do so on the card dashboard in the TNG eWallet app.

question: How do I replace my card?
answer: You can replace the card via the card dashboard on the TNG eWallet app, subject to fees and charges where applicable. Do note that once you request a card replacement, your current card will be deactivated and you will not be able to use it for payments. You can refer to the replacement guide below:

question: Will my virtual card details change if I apply for a replacement card?
answer: Yes. Once you've confirmed that you want to replace your card, both your virtual and physical card will be deactivated and your old card details will not be able to be used. You will be provided with a new set of card details for your newly replaced card.

question: How do I cancel/terminate my Card?
answer: To terminate your TNG Visa Card, please reach out to us via the Chatbot on the TNG eWallet apps. To note that for cards cancelled after 1 year application anniversary date, the 2nd year annual fee will still be charged.

question: What is the Touch 'n Go Charm?
answer: A Touch 'n Go Charm is a contactless stored-value charm, that enables you to reload from your Touch 'n Go eWallet. The charm functions in the same way as enhanced Touch 'n Go Card. The charm can be used for cashless payments across all sectors; toll highways, public transportation services (except for Rapid Kuantan transit), and over 700 parking sites in Peninsular Malaysia. All you need to do is to ensure you have sufficient balance and scan your charm at the TNG reader.

question: Does the Touch 'n Go Charm come with any stored value?
answer: All Touch 'n Go Charm are sold without stored value.

question: Does my Touch 'n Go Charm have a warranty period?
answer: TNGSB will guarantee the functionality of the Touch 'n Go Charm from any faulty/malfunction for a period of thirty (30) days from the date of purchase. It is mandatory to keep your receipt as proof of your purchase in the event you were to claim for charm replacement during the warranty period.

question: How do I check the expiry date of my Touch 'n Go Charm?
answer: Your Touch 'n Go Charm's expiry date can be found via the following methods: - Printed on the back of the charm - Printed in the receipt received after reloading the charm - Listed in the Touch n' Go eWallet after you have linked your charm in the eWallet - Listed in the TNGSB Portal after you have registered your charms The TNG Charm has a lifespan of seven (7) years, or any other period as stipulated by Touch 'n Go Sdn Bhd (TNGSB).

question: There is a difference between the date printed on the Touch 'n Go Charm, Touch n' Go eWallet and the date listed on the TNGSB portal for the charm expiry. Which date should I refer to?
answer: It is advised for users to follow the expiry date stated on the Touch n' Go eWallet as the most accurate representation of your charm's expiry. If your charm is not linked to the Touch n' Go eWallet, you could also refer to the expiry date listed on the TNGSB Portal. TNGSB aims to honour the expiry dates obtained from any of these platforms.

question: Will my Touch 'n Go Charm become inactive if I were to not use it for an extended period of time?
answer: The TNG Charm does not have any form of dormancy imposed to it. Hence, you may use it freely throughout the 7 years of the charm's lifetime. The charm will be inactive upon expiry after the 7th year. Do note that if your charm is terminated prior to the expiry date, it will become inactive. Termination may arise from the following actions: - Charm termination in the event of lost charm; - Charm termination due to customer's request

question: Are there any Service and Activation Fees for the Touch 'n Go Charm?
answer: You will not be charged fees of any form for the lack of usage of your charms over an extended period throughout the 7 years of charm lifetime.

question: What will happen to the balance in my charm if I do not use the Touch 'n Go Charm throughout 7 years from last transaction date?
answer: Regardless of charm expiry, the remainder funds in your charm shall be classified as Unclaimed Money and be treated by TNGSB in accordance with the requirements stated in the Unclaimed Moneys Act 1965 after 7 years from the last transaction date. TNGSB will return your unused funds to the Registrar of Unclaimed Money, of the Accountant General's Department of Malaysia. Please visit the Official Portal of the Accountant General's Department for further information.

question: Use at Transit / Toll Readers
answer: Place the charm flat on the reader as shown on the image below, ensure that the charm is placed in the centre of the reader. Observe the display and sound from the devices for clear indication that the transaction is successfully completed before entering or exiting the area. Avoid placing any item near the charm or between the reader and the charm that may interfere with the transaction. If the reader is unable to detect the charm, simply move the charm around the reader's area and avoid the metal keychain from being in contact with the reader.

question: For Top-ups (Touch 'n Go Kiosk)
answer: Ensure that the transaction is successfully completed as reflected on the machine's display before removing the charm from reader. Avoid placing any item near the charm or between the reader and the charm that may interfere with the transaction. If the reader is unable to detect the charm, simply move the charm around the reader's area and avoid the metal keychain from being in contact with the reader.

question: Where can I purchase the Touch 'n Go Charm?
answer: You can purchase the TNG Charm from the TNG eWallet (eShop), Lazada eShop. Prior to purchasing the TNG Charm, please ensure that your device is Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled if you would like to utilize the Touch 'n Go eWallet reload feature.

question: How much does the Touch 'n Go Charm cost?
answer: The TNG Charm (Christmas Edition) along with Near Field Communication (NFC) capability costs RM30.00 each.

question: How many Touch 'n Go Charm can a user purchase?
answer: You can purchase up to maximum of 2 TNG Charm within the TNG eWallet Lazada eShop. Please note that you are only able to register up to maximum 15 TNG card/charm in each TNG eWallet account. You have the option to delink the card/charm if you have maxed out the available slots for charm/card registration in the TNG eWallet app. To delink your old card/charm: 1. Click on the "More Options" icon on the top right corner of the specific card/charm from the card/charm list carousel. 2. click "Remove Card" icon and confirm your selection. 3. You should then add your TNG Charm and proceed to use it.

question: What should I do if the Touch 'n Go Charm is faulty after receiving?
answer: We take utmost care for the quality and performance of each charm before it is dispatched to you. In the unlikely situation that your TNG Charm is faulty due to manufacturing error and is within 30 days from the day of charm purchase, the product is covered under Touch 'n Go's warranty. Hence, you will qualify for a complimentary charm replacement given that you are able to provide proof of purchase. In the event the replacement of the faulty charm is not sufficed with the receipt or proof of purchase, customer shall proceed to purchase a new charm at their own expense. If you have reloaded your faulty charm, please submit a refund request via e-Refund or on our e-Customer Service here to obtain the balance from your old charm. You can contact Touch 'n Go customer support team via the following channels and upon investigation and subject to validity, a replacement charm will be dispatched to you to the same address at zero cost. Live Chat Touch 'n Go Corporate Website or Visit https://www.touchngo.com.my/ and Click "Chat with us" icon at bottom right 8.00 am to 8.00 pm Monday - Friday (including public holidays) Email careline@touchngo.com.my Careline +603 2714 8888 8.00 am to 8.00 pm Monday - Friday (including public holidays) Facebook www.facebook.com/MyTouchnGo Twitter www.twitter.com/MyTouchnGo TNG Charm Information & Transactions https://tngportal.touchngo.com.my/ Refund for TNG Charm https://www.touchngo.com.my/erefund/ **Refund will be refunded within 30 days Walk in TNG Service & Sales Centre - Bangsar South Address: Ground Floor, Tower 6, Avenue 5, The Horizon Bangsar South. Business Hour: 9am to 5pm, Mondays to Fridays

question: What are the prerequisites I should have to maximise the full potential of the Touch 'n Go Charm?
answer: To be able to enjoy the full benefits of the Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled TNG Charm, please ensure that you meet the following prerequisites: - Users' Touch 'n Go eWallet account needs to be eKYC verified. - Users need to have an NFC compatible device with minimum Operating Software requirement of iOS 13 (Apple) and Android 4.4 (Android & other models). Users need to ensure their device meets the minimum OS and it is installed in their devices to ensure the reload via eWallet works as per designed. Some model of phones purchased from different countries may cause issues to the NFC functionality. Please check with your mobile device's manufacturer prior to attempting to use the TNG Charm with your mobile device. - User to update their Touch 'n Go eWallet to app version 1.7.72 and above to enjoy all the supplementary in-app feature. Note that some devices may require you to enable the NFC function prior to using it in the Touch 'n Go eWallet. Please check with your manufacturer on your devices NFC compatibility prior to purchasing the TNG Charm.

question: What is Near Field Communication (NFC)?
answer: Near Field Communication or NFC is a method of wirelessly transmitting data using radio waves. The TNG Charm uses NFC to wirelessly transmit reload data from the payment terminals i.e., your mobile device's NFC readers that have been activated for use.

question: How do I check if my mobile device has Near Field Communication (NFC) capability?
answer: If you are using an iPhone, iPhone 7 and above have built-in NFC chip. Hence, all the iPhones released in recent years have NFC capability. NFC is automatically enabled on iPhones. If you are an Android user, majority of new Android devices have an NFC chip in the phone. Your phone's NFC chip needs to be activated before using the NFC. Go to settings and in the "search settings" bar, type "NFC". Tap on the NFC toggle to activate it and follow the steps outlined in your mobile device. If you need further assistance, please call your mobile device manufacturer's careline or refer to their FAQ online.

question: How do I check if my mobile device's Operating Software meets the minimum requirement to run Near Field Communication (NFC) and the updated Touch 'n Go eWallet app?
answer: Users need to have an NFC compatible device with minimum Operating Software requirement of iOS 13 (Apple) and Android 4.4 (Android & other models). Users need to ensure their device meets the minimum OS and it is installed in their devices prior to attempting to reload via eWallet. For iPhone users, you can validate your iOS version of your device by doing the following: Step 1: Locate and select the "Settings" app. Step 2: Once in the "Settings" app, tap "General". Step 3: Proceed to tap "About" and note the "Software Version". Step 4: If your iOS version has not been updated, tap "Software Update" under "General" and check for available updates to install. Click "Download and Install" to proceed. For Android users, you can validate your OS version of your device by doing the following: Step 1: Locate and select the "Settings" app. Step 2: Once in the "Settings" app, tap "About Phone" or "About Device" Step 3: Proceed to tap "Android Version" and note your version information displayed Step 4: If your OS version has not been updated, check the "Software Update" page for instructions to complete the OS update Some brand/ model of phones purchased from different countries may cause issues to the NFC functionality/ NFC is not supported. Please check with your mobile device's manufacturer prior to attempting to use the TNG Charm with your mobile device.

question: How close does the Touch 'n Go Charm must be to my mobile device for the Near Field Communication (NFC) to work?
answer: The TNG Charm must be scanned directly at the back of your mobile device for the Near Field Communication (NFC) to work. For iPhones, scan the charm at the top part of the phone's back beside the camera, whereas for Android and other brands, scan at the middle of the phone's back. This process may require some trial and error depending on your device. For best user experience, please check with your device manufacturer on the NFC reader's placement on your device prior to using the TNG Charm with your device. Please ensure that you're scanning the charm on the back of your device for longer than 5 seconds.

question: Do I need to register my Touch 'n Go Charm in the TNG eWallet and TNGSB Portal?
answer: To enjoy the features in the Touch 'n Go Charm such as reloading via TNG eWallet, you are required to register your charm in the TNG eWallet (app version 1.7.72 and above) and complete the Electronic Know Your Customer (eKYC). Please prepare your identification document of choice (NRIC/ Passport Number/ Army registration) prior to completing the eKYC process. Unregistered charm will only be able to do reloads via physical reload points. You are encouraged to register your charm at TNGSB Portal to enjoy a hassle-free refund process, transaction history tracking and ensuring your data is updated in TNGSB's system. For refund purposes, you are required to register your charm(s) online at TNGSB Portal and proceed to claim for refund via the e-Refund portal. Unregistered charms are not entitled for refund.

question: How do I link the Touch 'n Go Charm I have purchased into TNG eWallet?
answer: To be able to enjoy the full benefits of the Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled charms, please ensure you meet the following prerequisites: - Users' TNG eWallet account needs to be eKYC verified - Users need to have an NFC compatible device with minimum Operating Software requirement of iOS 13 (Apple) and Android 4.4 (Android & other models). Users need to ensure their device meets the minimum OS and it is installed in their devices to ensure the reload via eWallet works as per designed. Some model of phones purchased from different countries may cause issues to the NFC functionality. Please check with your mobile device's manufacturer prior to attempting to use the Touch 'n Go Charm with your mobile device - Users need to update their TNG eWallet to app version 1.7.72 or above to enjoy all the supplementary in-app features Once you have ensured you meet all the prerequisites, you can link your Touch 'n Go Charm following the below steps: Step 1: Tap on TNG Card icon on the home screen. Step 2: Click on Add Card button or '+' button on top right. Step 2a: Verify your TNG eWallet account if you have not done so by completing the eKYC. If your phone has NFC capability: Step 3: Click on the Scan Now or button. Step 4: Place your Touch 'n Go Charm behind your phone and ensure proper surface contact. For iPhones, scan on the top part of phone's back beside the camera, whereas for Android, scan at the middle of the phone's back. This process may require some trial and error depending on your device. Step 5: Once successful, your 10-digit Serial Number will be automatically populated. Verify the 10-digit Serial Number populated in-app is as per printed on your charm. Step 6: Fill in the Preferred Card Name field. If you were to omit the field, a system default name will be assigned to your linked charm. Step 7: Click on Add button and you are ready to use your Touch 'n Go Charm. Step 8: Enter your 6-digit TNG eWallet PIN. Note you can only link up to 15 Touch 'n Go Charm/card in your TNG eWallet. If your phone is NOT NFC enabled (note that you would not be able to do reload via eWallet if your phone has NFC capability disabled or lacks NFC capability) Step 3: Manually key in your 10-digit Charm Serial Number. Step 4: Fill in the Preferred Card Name field. If you were to omit the field, a system default name will be assigned to your linked charm. Step 5: Click on Add button and you are ready to use your TNG Charm. Step 6: Enter your 6-digit TNG eWallet PIN. Note you can only link up to 15 TNG Charm/cards in your TNG eWallet.

question: Apakah akan terjadi jikalau telefon bimbit saya tidak mempunyai ciri "Near Field Communication" (NFC)?
answer: Anda masih boleh menggunakan Touch 'n Go Charm seperti biasa untuk pembayaran di pembaca charm TNG fizikal. Walau bagaimanapun, anda tidak akan dapat menikmati ciri tambah nilai melalui Touch 'n Go eWallet.

question: How do I locate the 10-digit Serial Number on the Touch 'n Go Charm for registration?
answer: The 10-digit serial number can be found at the back of your TNG Charm. Please refer to the image below. The exact placement of the serial number may vary depending on the charm design.

question: Does PayDirect feature apply when I link my Touch 'n Go Charm on the TNG eWallet?
answer: Linking your charm is required to reload the Touch 'n Go Charm via the TNG eWallet. After linking any charms to the TNG eWallet, you will be a PayDirect user automatically. Read all about PayDirect and its cool features here.

question: Getting started with reloading the Touch 'n Go Charm
answer: Each TNG Charm starts with a zero MYR balance. You can opt to reload your TNG Charm via Touch n' Go eWallet (app version 1.7.72 and above) or at any reload touchpoints across Peninsular Malaysia. Click here for the full list of locations to reload. You can reload the charms using the following methods: i) Via Touch n' Go eWallet: Simply follow the instructions on your Touch n' Go eWallet to reload your charm at the convenience of your fingertips. Step 1: Tap on the TNG Card icon on the home screen Step 2: Select which Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled charm that you would like to reload. The NFC icon on the charm list in the Touch 'n Go eWallet screen will be highlighted in blue if charm is NFC enabled. Click the Reload button Step 3: Have your NFC enabled charm nearby to scan at the back of the mobile device upon prompted. Place your TNG Charm behind your phone and ensure proper surface contact. For iPhones, scan on the top part of phone's back beside the camera, whereas for Android, scan at the middle of the phone's back. This process may require some trial and error depending on your device. For best user experience, please check with your device manufacturer on the NFC reader's placement on your device Step 4: Enter your preferred amount to be reloaded when prompted. Each reload transaction via eWallet is capped at RM500 Step 5: Authorise the payment by entering your 6-digit Touch n' Go eWallet PIN Step 6: You will be prompted to scan your charm at the back of the mobile device again Step 7: If the reload is successful, you will see a Reload Successful screen. For unhappy scenarios, if the reload has failed, you will be prompted with a Reload Unsuccessful screen whereas, if the reload is in progress, you will be prompted with a Hold On, reload is Pending! Screen Step 8: To verify the charm balance post completing the reload, please proceed with checking charm balance by tapping on the NFC icon on the card/charm list Note: Ensure that your mobile device is NFC enabled and the feature is turned on in your Settings. NFC is automatically enabled for iOS users ii) Physical Charm reload via existing SSK/Terminals/ATM Machines or partner merchants similar to usual TNG card reload. Please ensure you have sufficient balance in your TNG Charm and prior to using it at any TNG Charm reader to enjoy a seamless experience.

question: How much can I reload into my Touch 'n Go Charm?
answer: You can reload your TNG Charm with a minimum of RM10 and a maximum of RM500 per transaction. At any point in time, your TNG Charm limit is set at a maximum of RM1,500. You can watch learn how to reload your eWallet here.

question: Can I transfer the charm balance from my existing Touch 'n Go Charm to my TNG Charm and vice versa?
answer: This function is NOT available at the moment via Touch 'n Go eWallet . Users will need to raise a refund request for their existing charms via the e-Refund Portal. Upon verification from the team, the refund will be processed to your preferred account (Touch n' Go eWallet, Malaysian Bank Account or Foreign Bank Account). Note that, once a charm is refunded by the TNG team, it will be terminated.

question: How often is the balance of my linked Touch 'n Go Charm updated in the TNG eWallet?
answer: All successful Touch 'n Go Charm reloads are immediate, however your transaction history will be updated after 24 hours from the time of the actual transaction. Although, if you'd like to verify the real time balance of your Touch 'n Go Charm, please complete the "Check Card Balance" in your TNG eWallet (app version 1.7.72 and above) app. Refer here to learn more about how you can complete the "Check Card Balance".

question: What do I do if my Touch 'n Go Charm was not reloaded successfully via TNG eWallet but the fund has been deducted from my TNG eWallet?
answer: If you have attempted to reload via TNG eWallet and your reload was unsuccessful, the fund deducted from your TNG eWallet account will be automatically refunded. For any other refund matters that may arise due to technical glitches, we endeavour to refund the users' fund within 5 working days. In the event you do not receive your funds after the stipulated duration, you can get in touch with Touch 'n Go customer support team via the number listed below. Prior to calling in, please complete the "Check Card Balance" in your TNG eWallet app (app version 1.7.72 and above) by referring here. You are encouraged to reattempt to reload or use your charm at any reader to verify if the amount reloaded has been transferred to the charm. Careline: Please reach out to us via Live Chat on the TNG eWallet apps, click here. Operation hour is between 7.00 am to 10.00 pm Monday - Sunday Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/touchngoewallet/

question: I have RM2 in my Touch 'n Go eWallet and RM1 in my Touch 'n Go Charm. If the toll fare is RM3, can I pass through the toll?
answer: No, because the balance in the Touch 'n Go Charm and the Touch 'n Go eWallet are separate and not interchangeable. Toll fare deductions can only be done from one source of fund at a time and thus, you will not be able to pass through the toll if you have an insufficient balance in either mode of payment you choose to use. You would either need to reload your Touch 'n Go eWallet or charm. For a seamless drive, we highly recommend that users consider - Always keeping some balance in your Touch 'n Go Charm - Turning on the Paydirect feature in your Touch 'n Go eWallet

question: What is Auto Payment for WalletSafe?
answer: Auto Payment allows you to set up future recurring transactions at a pre-set timing and amount to a designated biller of your choice. Once you have activated "Auto Payment" for WalletSafe, TNG eWallet will automatically deduct the premium amount from your eWallet 15 days before your existing certificate expires until the premium is charged successfully to renew your WalletSafe certificate. The renewed WalletSafe certificate will be issued and effective after your existing certificate expires given that premium is charged successfully, ensuring your continuous protection.

question: I have not enabled my Auto Payment on WalletSafe. How can I enable it?
answer: If you are an existing WalletSafe customer, you can go to WalletSafe landing page and click on the "Enable Auto Payment" button or click on the banner under the Auto Payment Status to enable the Auto Payment. You are required to enter your 6-digit PIN to complete the process. If you are a new WalletSafe customer, you can opt in for Auto Payment during the purchase of WalletSafe by turning on the Auto Payment toggle and complete the payment.

question: Can I disable the Auto Payment function for WalletSafe?
answer: Yes, you can. Any changes should be made before the next scheduled payment due date. If changes made after, Auto Payment will continue and only disable for the next subsequent deduction of premium. To disable Auto Payment function, go to Profile Page > select Auto Payment > select WalletSafe > click on "Remove" button.

question: Why is my Auto Payment for WalletSafe unsuccessful?
answer: Your Auto Payment for WalletSafe may be unsuccessful due to the following reasons :- - You do not have sufficient balance in your eWallet or GO+ when the Auto Payment takes place; or - You do not meet WalletSafe eligibility criteria. For more information, please contact TNG eWallet by contacting us via Chatbot, here.

question: What happens if my eWallet or GO+ balance is insufficient during the Auto Payment process?
answer: Unfortunately, the transaction is unable to process if your eWallet or GO+ balance is insufficient during the Auto Payment process and your WalletSafe certificate will not be renewed. However, you can still purchase a new WalletSafe certificate after reloading sufficient amount of money to your eWallet or GO+ account, where you may enable Auto Payment again during your purchase process. After enabling Auto Payment, you are encouraged to also enable Quick Payment, where the amount will be deducted from your saved card in the event your eWallet balance runs low. To understand more about 'Quick Payment', you may refer to here or contact TNG eWallet careline

question: Will I receive notification if the Auto Payment processing fails due to insufficient balance?
answer: Yes, you will receive a notification on your failed Auto Payment, and your WalletSafe Auto Payment function will be disabled at the same time as well. You can activate Auto Payment again during the purchase of WalletSafe by turning on the Auto Payment toggle and complete the payment.

question: Will I receive any reminder or notification before the Auto Payment takes place?
answer: Yes, a reminder will be sent to you 7 days and 5 days in advanced before the expiry of the existing WalletSafe certificate, whereby the Auto Payment is scheduled to take place 15 days before your expiry.

question: What is auto payment?
answer: Auto payment feature allows you to set up future recurring transactions at a pre-set timing and amount to a designated biller of your choice.

question: Why can't I see billers under recent/saved bills?
answer: You can only see billers under recent/saved bills after you've made the first bill payment successfully.

question: What do recent/saved bills do?
answer: This section helps you to complete subsequent bill payment(s) faster and easier. It saves the biller details after the first payment and allows you to opt for auto payment.

question: How do I edit the biller name of my past payment?
answer: Go to the specific biller to which you've made a payment previously. You should see your payment record. Click the "Edit" button on the top right of the screen and proceed to edit the nickname of the biller.

question: How do I pay to a new account when I have past payment records?
answer: Click on the biller, and you should see the "New account" selection below your past payment records. Click on "New account" and you will be able to proceed with the payment.

question: What does the Bills module do?
answer: It allows you to pay various bills, ranging from Postpaid, Utilities, Broadband, Entertainment, Loans, and Local Council.

question: What is Dormant Account?
answer: A dormant account refers to Touch 'n Go eWallet accounts that did not perform any transactions or logins for a consecutive period of 365 days.

question: Can I cancel my policy?
answer: Yes, you may cancel your policy by contacting AIA Online Customer Service via e-mail at my.aiaonline@aia.com. However, please note that: - For cancellation within 60 days from the policy inception, you are entitled to a full refund of the premium; - For cancellation after 60 days from the policy inception, you are entitled to a partial refund of the premium; - All refunds are conditioned upon no claims being made on the policy.

question: What do I need to do if there are changes to my personal details?
answer: It is important that you inform us of any change in your personal details. You may request to update your personal details by contacting our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via e-mail at my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, excluding public holidays).

question: Can I still request for a cancellation note from AIA if I did not opt for it during my application?
answer: Yes, you may request for a cancellation note by contacting our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via WhatsApp at 019 629 9660 or e-mail my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, Mon to Fri excluding public holidays). However, it is recommended that you opt for it during your application to ease your cancellation process with your mortgagee.

question: Can I request to include add-on coverages midterm after my SafeHome policy is issued?
answer: No, you are not allowed to include any add-on coverages (insured perils) midterm after your policy is issued. However, you are allowed to do so during your policy renewal. Kindly ensure that you have selected the desired add-on coverages during your application before you make payment.

question: Can I request to increase/ decrease my sum insured midterm after my SafeHome policy is issued?
answer: Yes, you can. Kindly contact our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via WhatsApp at 019 629 9660 or e-mail my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, Mon to Fri excluding public holidays) for assistance.

question: How do I make a claim for SafeHome?
answer: You need to complete the claim submission webpage and provide required supporting claim documents. You can obtain the link from the e-mail where you received your e-policy upon your purchase via TNG eWallet application. You are also required to give full cooperation to the adjusters or investigators appointed by AIA in assessing your claim.

question: What are the documents required to support a claim?
answer: For any claims, you are required to provide a copy of policyholder's identity card (front and back) and police report. - For Fire Coverage claim, it shall also include photo(s) on the damage, repairer/technical report on the cause of damage, repair bill/ quotation, and adjuster report (if any). If the insured home content is damage, the claim needs to be supported by the proof of purchase (e.g. softcopy of receipts, bank statements, and etc.) of the insured home content. - For Cash Relief claim, it shall also include photo(s) on the damage. - For Medical Coverage claim, it shall also include medical report, original medical bills & receipts, a copy of the loss party's identity card (front & back) and proof of relationship between policyholder and the loss party. Note: The list is not exhaustive. Kindly refer to the claim submission webpage for the list of documents required on your claim.

question: When do I have to notify AIA of a claim?
answer: All claims are advised to be submitted to AIA immediately and no later than 15 days from the date of event giving rise to a claim under this SafeHome policy.

question: How long do I have to wait to get my claim?
answer: Upon full submission of your claim documents to AIA, it will take at least 7 working days for claim approval. Once the claim is approved, payment will be made within 7 working days.

question: What is an adjuster and what do they do?
answer: An adjuster is an independent party appointed by the insurance company to investigate property damage or personal injury to determine the claims payout amount. They may interview the claimant and witnesses, inspect the property, gather information, and conduct additional research.

question: What is excess?
answer: Excess is the amount you need to bear for a claim before AIA indemnify you. The applicable excess amount and policy conditions are stated in the policy wording.

question: Where can I get further information?

For General Enquiries: Should you require additional information, please contact our dedicated AIA Online Customer Service via WhatsApp at 019 629 9660 or e-mail my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, Mon to Fri excluding public holidays).

question: With my property insured under a mortgage, is it true that it is compulsory for me to purchase insurance coverage from the bank's panel of insurers otherwise they might not approve my loan?
answer: No, as a consumer, you have the right to arrange your own insurance. You may refer to the excerpt from BNM Prohibited Business Conduct below. "As provided under the Product Transparency and Disclosure Guidelines, while the FSP may provide quotations for the insurance or takaful offered by the FSP's panel, the financial consumer must be allowed to use the service of non-panel insurers or takaful operators if they choose to do so." (FSP refers to Financial Service Providers)
category: Withdrawal of Fire Insurance with The Bank/ Mortgagee

question: The bank claimed that I am underinsured and wants me to get insured with their panel of insurers that will offer sufficient coverage based on loan value. What should I do?
answer: Your current loan value might not be the rebuilding cost of the same building. In the event of loss, claim settlement will be based on the rebuilding cost of the same building. Hence, you'll need to ensure you have an adequate sum insured based on the rebuilding cost.
category: Withdrawal of Fire Insurance with The Bank/ Mortgagee

question: What is a cancellation note and how will I receive it?
answer: Cancellation note is a note prepared by AIA to ease your communication with your mortgagee (bank) for the cancellation of your existing fire insurance policy with the mortgagee. It consists of all required policy details of your new policy with AIA such as benefits, coverage, sum insured and a summary description of your intention to cancel the existing policy. A cancellation note will be provided to you upon request during your application. If you opted for cancellation note during your application, you will receive it via email within the same day. If you do not receive it, you may contact our AIA Online Customer Service via WhatsApp at 019 629 9660 or e-mail my.aiaonline@aia.com during the operating hours (8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. on Mon to Thu, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. on Fri, excluding public holidays).
category: Withdrawal of Fire Insurance with The Bank/ Mortgagee

question: My home insurance policy from the bank will be expired soon. When should I purchase/ renew the insurance from AIA SafeHome?

question: What kind of documents do I need to send to the bank in order to cancel my home insurance policy with the bank?

question: I have informed the bank regarding my SafeHome policy with AIA, but the bank has arranged another policy for me and my account has been charged. How can I cancel the insurance policy with the bank?

question: Who can purchase SafeHome?
answer: You can purchase SafeHome if you are: - a Malaysian, or a foreigner who is a permanent resident of Malaysia, work permit holder, pass holder or otherwise is legally employed and legally residing in Malaysia; and - Your property insured is located within Malaysia.

question: What is SafeHome?
answer: SafeHome is an affordable fire insurance product specially designed to provide coverage for your residential building and/or home contents against loss or damage caused by fire and lightning, with add-on coverage against flood, burst pipes, or other perils as selected by you. It also provides cash relief and medical coverage in the event of any mishaps resulting from insured perils. This product is underwritten by AIA General Berhad and can only be purchased through Touch 'n Go eWallet.

question: Why should I verify my email address?

question: How to verify your email address?

Step 3: Confirm your email address, then tap "Send a verification email" to start the verification process. Step 4: You will receive an email from TNG eWallet. question: What if someone verifies their email address on my account?

Step 4: Input active email address. Step 5: Click Save. ⚠️User would need to verify the email address afterwards to receive contact from TNG eWallet.

question: Why didn't I receive the email verification email?
answer: 1. Ensure you have clicked the 'Send a verification email' button to trigger the verification email to your inbox. 2. Please check your Spam/ Junk mail.

question: Why did I receive an error trying to verify my email address?
answer: Here are the possible reasons an error may occur: 1. The email verification has exceeded 48 hours. 2. The email address has been verified by other account.

question: I did not receive the email after requesting for a resend

question: What if I need to change my account email, will it ask to be verified?
answer: Yes, changing an account email will prompt the verification again.

question: Can I verify more than one email?
answer: No, one account can only have one verified email address.

question: Why is it important for you to verify your email address?
answer: This is to allow better communication of us to reach out to you and notify you for any changes made on your account. Addition, email verification gives us the opportunity to know you better and ensure that there is no duplication of account

question: Why I am unable to reload eWallet via TNG eWallet Reload PIN?
answer: The function to reload eWallet using TNG eWallet Reload PIN and/or Credit Card may have been disabled due to breach of the User Terms and Conditions. Using your TNG eWallet to perform money laundering activity by purchasing TNG eWallet reload PIN in bulk with cash to reload and cash out to bank is not the intended use of TNG eWallet. This activity is prohibited as stated in the TNG eWallet User Terms and Conditions. Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback OR dispute cases filed with other Financial Institutions TNG eWallet implements temporary account or specific feature restrictions while we thoroughly investigate the dispute, deterring additional disputes and adhere to industry regulations. There are 2 different types of restrictions: - If there is a complete eWallet account restriction, you will not be able to access the eWallet account. - If only certain features are restricted, reloading using debit/prepaid/credit cards is disabled. However, you can still reload the eWallet using alternative methods such as a reload pin or DuitNow transfer.

question: Getting started with reloading the enhanced Touch 'n Go (TNG) card
answer: Each enhanced TNG card starts with a zero MYR balance. You can opt to reload your Touch n' Go card via TNG eWallet (app version 1.7.72 and above) or at any reload touchpoints across Peninsular Malaysia. Click here for the full list of locations to reload. You can reload the cards using the following methods: i) Via TNG eWallet: Simply follow the instructions on your TNG eWallet to reload your card at the convenience of your fingertips. Step 1: Tap on 'Transportation" icon Step 2: Click "TNG Card" section Step 3: Select which Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled card that you would like to reload. The NFC icon on the card list in the TNG eWallet screen will be highlighted in blue if card is NFC enabled. Click the Reload button Step 4: Have your NFC enabled card nearby to scan at the back of the mobile device upon prompted. Place your enhanced TNG card behind your phone and ensure proper surface contact. For iPhones, scan on the top part of phone's back beside the camera, whereas for Android, scan at the middle of the phone's back. This process may require some trial and error depending on your device. For best user experience, please check with your device manufacturer on the NFC reader's placement on your device Step 5: Enter your preferred amount to be reloaded when prompted. Each reload transaction via eWallet is capped at RM500 Step 6: Authorise the payment by entering your 6-digit TNG eWallet PIN Step 7: You will be prompted to scan your card at the back of the mobile device again Step 8: If the reload is successful, you will see a Reload Successful screen. For unhappy scenarios, if the reload has failed, you will be prompted with a Reload Unsuccessful screen whereas, if the reload is in progress, you will be prompted with a Hold On, reload is Pending! Screen Step 9: To verify the card balance post completing the reload, please proceed with checking card balance by tapping on the NFC icon on the card list Note: Ensure that your mobile device is NFC enabled and the feature is turned on in your Settings. NFC is automatically enabled for iOS users ii) Physical reload via existing SSK/Terminals/ATM Machines or partner merchants similar to usual Touch n' Go card reload Please ensure you have sufficient balance in your TNG card and prior to using it at any TNG card reader to enjoy a seamless experience.

question: Do I need to register my enhanced Touch 'n Go (TNG) card in the Touch 'n Go eWallet and MYTouchnGo Portal?

Please prepare your identification document of choice (NRIC/ Passport Number/ Army registration) prior to completing the eKYC process. Unregistered card will only be able to do reloads via physical reload points. You are encouraged to register your card at MYTouchnGo portal to enjoy a hassle-free refund process, transaction history tracking and ensuring your data is updated in TNGSB's system. For refund purposes, you are required to register your card(s) online at MYTouchnGo portal and proceed to claim for refund via the e-Refund portal. Unregistered cards are not entitled for refund.

question: What is the enhanced Touch 'n Go (TNG) card?

question: What is the difference between Total Assets and eWallet Balance?
answer: eWallet Balance refers to the sum of transferable eWallet Balance and non-transferable eWallet Balance. eWallet Balance = Transferable eWallet Balance + Non-transferable eWallet Balance If you are a GO+ user, total assets are the sum of eWallet Balance and GO+ Balance. Total Assets = eWallet Balance + GO+ Balance If you are not a GO+ user, your eWallet will only display the eWallet Balance.

question: What are the prerequisites I should have to maximise the full potential of the enhanced Touch 'n Go (TNG) card?

Users need to ensure their device meets the minimum OS and it is installed in their devices to ensure the reload via eWallet works as per designed. Some model of phones purchased from different countries may cause issues to the NFC functionality. question: Why can't I reload with my credit/debit card?
answer: Your wallet reload may be unsuccessful due to the following reason :- 1. Error message 'Service Not Available' - This could be due to an issue with the network connectivity or a system downtime - Please try to unbind and rebind your bank card 2. Your remaining balance exceeded eWallet size - Consider to use up your balance or upgrade your eWallet account by doing account verification. - If you have not verify your account, please do so to upgrade your eWallet size. Refer to article How do I verify my account? for more info - If you have verified your account, you may upgrade eWallet size exceeding RM5000. Please refer to article How do I upgrade from one tier to another? for more info 3. You have entered the wrong card details (Bank card number / expiry date /CVC) - Please try again with correct card details 4. You've entered an incorrect OTP - Please resend OTP and try again 5. Your bank card has expired - Please proceed with another bank card or valid bank card 6. The bank card you're using is not supported. Please refer to the list of supported cards below: Card Issuing Country Card Network Card Type Malaysia - MasterCard - Visa - Amex - Credit - Debit - Prepaid Singapore Other countries - MasterCard - Visa 7. Payment authorization request was declined by your issuing bank - Please contact your card issuing bank for clarification - Please try to add different bank card with the following requirement: - Your card is authorized for eCommerce transactions - Your card is authorized for 3D-secure transactions (3DS) - OTP 8. Same bank card used for multiple eWallet account - Credit card payment on Touch 'n Go eWallet is subject to transaction processing rules imposed by card schemes (e.g. MasterCard, Visa, etc.) Credit cards with activities suspected to be in violation of these transaction processing rules will not be allowed to make a payment on Touch 'n Go eWallet. For more information, please refer to User's Terms and Conditions - Please reach out to us via Chatbot on the TNG eWallet apps. 9. Device Issue Kindly do self troubleshoot to check line connectivity as per below : a) Launch internet browser, type www.google.com and tap Go. b) If the page fails to load, you may have internet connectivity issues If no internet connection issue, i) Ensure device is not jailbroken or rooted. Please refer to article Why is the Touch 'n Go eWallet app not supported on jailbroken / rooted devices? for more info. ii) Uninstall and re-install App iii) Update app to the latest version iv) Clear Cache/Data/Storage if possible for your device If all the above does not resolve your issue, please contact us via Chatbot. Please provide relevant screenshot to support our investigation. 10. High Traffic In some occasion during high traffic, please allow up to 24 hours for reload amount to be reflected. 11. Card Not Present Issue Sometimes, your bank may decline online transactions without a One-Time Password (OTP), especially for cards linked to your eWallet. This happens when the bank doesn't allow such transactions by default. Solution: To avoid transaction failures, we recommend contacting your bank and asking them to enable "Card Not Present" transactions for the debit card linked to your eWallet. This will ensure smoother and successful online payments. Tip: For hassle-free reloading, you may reload with DuitNow Transfer from any of the 30 integrated banks in Malaysia to your eWallet account. You can also set it as a favourite for reoccurring transactions in the future. Watch the video here. question: How is the Auto Debit Agreement Formed?
answer: Auto Debit allows merchants to automatically deduct payments from your account based on an agreed schedule, such as subscriptions or recurring bills. By activating Auto Debit, you give consent for these deductions after linking your payment account and accepting the terms, including the billing amount, frequency, and cancellation policy. During setup, some merchants may make a small verification charge (for example, RM0.10) to confirm that your account is valid and that you have authorized future deductions. Not all merchants require this step - some will only charge when the first payment is due. This verification confirms that your payment account is valid and active, and that you have given explicit permission for future automatic deductions. Once you approve this small transaction, it serves as confirmation that the Auto Debit agreement is legally binding between you and the merchant. After Auto Debit is activated, payments will be deducted automatically according to the agreed schedule. You will receive a notification each time a payment is successfully made, and the transaction will appear in your history as confirmation. If your balance is insufficient, the payment may fail. You will be notified so you can take the necessary action. You can also view your Auto Debit permissions and related transactions in the Permission & Auto Debit section of your app.

question: Emulator
answer: What is an Emulator? An emulator is a software program that allows you to run programmes or applications designed for a different system (such as a computer) on your current device (such as a phone). Emulators are commonly used to run video games or mobile apps on a computer. Why is it dangerous to use our app on an emulator? Using a financial app on an emulator can be risky because emulators are often less secure than real phones. Even though the TNG eWallet app may be encrypted, there is still a risk that your login credentials or other financial data could be intercepted by malicious software running on the emulator. Here are some of the risks of using an emulator with financial apps: - Security vulnerabilities: Emulators may have security flaws that hackers can exploit to gain access to your financial information. - Malware: Malware could be hidden on the emulator and may steal your financial data when you use a financial app. - Increased risk of interception: Since emulators run on your computer, there is a higher risk that your login credentials or other financial data could be intercepted by other programmes running on the same device. To protect your financial information, our app is designed to be used only on real phones or tablets, not on emulators. To use it safely, please install the app on a supported mobile device. By following these steps and tips, you can better protect your financial information while using our app.

question: How do I link the enhanced Touch 'n Go (TNG) card I have purchased into Touch 'n Go eWallet?
answer: To be able to enjoy the full benefits of the Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled cards, please ensure you meet the following prerequisites: - Users' Touch 'n Go eWallet account needs to be eKYC verified - Users need to have an NFC compatible device with minimum Operating Software requirement of iOS 13 (Apple) and Android 4.4 (Android & other models). Users need to ensure their device meets the minimum OS and it is installed in their devices to ensure the reload via eWallet works as per designed. Some model of phones purchased from different countries may cause issues to the NFC functionality. Please check with your mobile device's manufacturer prior to attempting to use the enhanced TNG card with your mobile device - Users need to update their Touch 'n Go eWallet to app version 1.7.72 or above to enjoy all the supplementary in-app features Once you have ensured you meet all the prerequisites, you can link your enhanced TNG card following the below steps: Step 1: Tap on TNG Card icon on the home screen Step 2: Click on Add Card button or '+' button on top right Step 2a: Verify your Touch n' Go eWallet account if you have not done so by completing the eKYC If your phone has NFC capability: Step 3: Click on the Scan Now or button Step 4: Place your enhanced TNG card behind your phone and ensure proper surface contact. For iPhones, scan on the top part of phone's back beside the camera, whereas for Android, scan at the middle of the phone's back. This process may require some trial and error depending on your device. Step 5: Once successful, your 10-digit Serial Number will be automatically populated. Verify the 10-digit Serial Number populated in-app is as per printed on your card. Step 6: Fill in the Preferred Card Name field. If you were to omit the field, a system default name will be assigned to your linked card. Step 7: Click on Add button and you are ready to use your enhanced TNG card Step 8: Enter your 6-digit TNG eWallet PIN Note you can only link up to 15 TNG cards in your TNG eWallet If your phone is NOT NFC enabled (note that you would not be able to do reload via eWallet if your phone has NFC capability disabled or lacks NFC capability) Step 3: Manually key in your 10-digit Card Serial Number Step 4: Fill in the Preferred Card Name field. If you were to omit the field, a system default name will be assigned to your linked card. Step 5: Click on Add button and you are ready to use your TNG card. Step 6: Enter your 6-digit Touch 'n Go eWallet PIN Note you can only link up to 15 TNG cards in your Touch 'n Go eWallet

question: [Android] Why I can't register to Touch 'n Go eWallet account?
answer: Mobile Phone Requirements: To register an account with us, please ensure your mobile phone meets the following requirements: - Mobile Operating System: Android version 5.0 or above. - Device Status: Your device should not be Jailbroken or Rooted. - Latest TNG eWallet App version: Please ensure you have the latest version of the Touch 'n Go eWallet app installed If your device meets the above requirements, but you still can't register an account with us, please consider the following scenarios. 1. Mobile or ID Number Already Registered: Your mobile number or ID number (MyKad/Passport) may already be registered to an existing Touch 'n Go eWallet account. This could be because your mobile number was previously used by another eWallet account owner, or someone accidentally entered your ID number during their registration process. 2. Previous Account with Same Mobile or ID Number: If you have previously registered an account with the same mobile number or ID number and can't recall your 6-digit PIN number, please follow the "Forgot PIN" steps. For more details, refer to our article here. 3. Changed Mobile Number and Can't Login: Please reach out to us via Chatbot on the TNG eWallet apps. 4. Country Not Listed: If your country is currently not listed, we apologize for the inconvenience. Rest assured that we are actively working to include users from your country in our app. 5. Unsupported Mobile Number: Please note that Touch 'n Go eWallet can only be used with Malaysian (+60) and Singaporean (+65) mobile numbers. We hope the above information helps you with the registration of Touch 'n Go eWallet account. If you need further assistance, please reach out to us via Chatbot on the TNG eWallet apps.
