question: What are the eWallet limits and usage restrictions?
answer: TNG eWallet Types - Balance & Transaction Limits FAQ Q1: What eWallet types are available? A1: There are three eWallet types on TNG eWallet: - Lite eWallet - UNHCR/Tourist eWallet - Premium eWallet Each type has its own maximum balance and usage limits. Q2: What's the maximum balance for each eWallet type? A2: This is the maximum amount you can hold in your TNG eWallet at any time: - Lite eWallet: up to RM200 - UNHCR/Tourist eWallet: up to RM5,000 - Premium eWallet: up to RM20,000 Once you reach your maximum balance, you won't be able to receive additional money until you reduce your balance. Q3: What is my monthly transaction limit? A3: Your monthly transaction limit is the total amount you can spend or transfer within a calendar month: - Lite eWallet: up to RM2,000/month - UNHCR/Tourist eWallet: up to RM5,000/month - Premium eWallet: up to RM120,000/month Transportation transactions (e.g. RFID/PayDirect) are not included in this monthly limit. Q4: Is there an annual transaction limit? A4: Yes. This is your total usage limit across any 12-month period: - Lite eWallet: up to RM24,000/year - UNHCR/Tourist eWallet: up to RM60,000/year - Premium eWallet: up to RM600,000/year All TNG eWallet transactions, including payments, transfers, and transportation, count toward this limit. Q5: Can I transfer money out with my TNG eWallet type? A5: - Lite eWallet: cannot transfer money out - UNHCR/Tourist eWallet: can transfer money out - Premium eWallet: can transfer money out Q6: Can I receive money into my eWallet? A6: - Lite eWallet: can receive money - UNHCR/Tourist eWallet: can receive money - Premium eWallet: can receive money Q7: Does transportation count toward my eWallet limits? A7: There's no monthly limit on transportation transactions, but they are included in your annual limit. Q8: What happens if I reach my balance limit? A8: If you reach your maximum balance: - You won't be able to receive any further money - You can still make payments (all types) or transfer money out (UNHCR/Tourist and Premium eWallet only - Lite eWallet cannot transfer out at any time) - You'll need to reduce your balance (e.g. by spending or transferring out, where applicable) before you can receive more money Refer to the table below for a better overview: Feature Lite UNHCR/Tourist Premium Balance Limit RM200 RM5,000 RM20,000 Monthly Limit RM2,000 RM5,000 RM120,000 Annual Limit RM24,000 RM60,000 RM600,000 Transfer Out Not allowed Allowed Allowed Transfer In Allowed Allowed Allowed Transportation No monthly limit No monthly limit No monthly limit

question: Malicious Activity
answer: What is harmful activity? Harmful activities may include: - Injection behaviour: Injecting malicious code into an app or programme. This code could be used to steal your financial information, take control of your device, or perform other harmful actions. - Injection framework: A software framework used to inject malicious code into apps or programmes. - Memory tampering: Modifying the contents of your device's memory. This could be done to steal data, install malware, or damage your device. - Debugging behaviour: The act of debugging an app or programme. While debuggers are commonly used to find and fix bugs, they can also be used to exploit security vulnerabilities. - Telecom fraud event: An attempt to fraudulently use your telecommunications services. This could include unauthorised calls or texts, or using your data plan to access premium content. Why is it dangerous to use our app when harmful activities are detected? If your device has been compromised by harmful activities, it is unsafe to use any financial apps on it, including ours. Malicious apps could potentially steal your financial information, such as credit card numbers, login credentials, and banking history. How to keep your phone safe Here are some tips: - Only download apps from trusted sources, such as the Google Play Store. - Be careful with app permissions. Don't grant apps more permissions than they need. - Keep your device's software up to date. This includes the operating system as well as any security apps you have installed. - Consider using a mobile security app. This can help protect your device from malware and other security threats. - Scan your device for malware. There are many antivirus and anti-malware apps available. You can use one of these to scan your device. - Consider resetting your device to factory settings. This will erase all your data and settings, so be sure to back up your device beforehand. By following these steps and tips, you can better protect your financial information while using our app.

question: What are the exclusions under Travel Delay for SafeTrip?
answer: SafeTrip will not pay for any claim in respect of the following : - Failure of the Insured Person to check in according to the itinerary supplied to him/her; - Failure of the Insured Person to obtain written confirmation from the common carrier of their handling agents of the number of hours delayed and the reason for such delay; - Strike, riot or industrial action publicly known to be existing on the date of purchasing the policy; - The late arrival of the Insured Person at the airport or port; - Any delay, reschedule or cancellation by the common carrier which was notified to the Insured Person at least 24 hours prior to the original departure time of the trip; - Any additional expenses incurred if any part of the trip is cancelled, deferred or postponed; - Less than 2 consecutive hours of delay. question: How do I use Touch 'n Go RFID for petrol?
answer: Using Touch 'n Go RFID for petrol is fast and easy. Follow these simple steps below: - Activate Touch 'n Go RFID for petrol via the Shell icon in your Touch 'n Go eWallet. - Drive to participating Shell stations enabled with Touch 'n Go RFID for petrol. - Park at designated bays to pump petrol with Touch 'n Go RFID, face your vehicle towards the Touch 'n Go RFID detector above the bay. - Wait for the Touch 'n Go RFID reader and camera to detect your vehicle; designated by an LCD screen by the side of the car. - Once successful, your Touch 'n Go eWallet will automatically deduct your preauthorised amount and you can begin fuelling. - Any unutilised amount from your preauthorised amount will be refunded to your Touch 'n Go eWallet account. Note: Customers need to have an active Touch 'n Go RFID tag first, before the "RFID Fuelling" function can be enabled in the Touch 'n Go eWallet app.

question: What is the difference between Rapid Bulanan and My50 Pass for Malaysians?

question: What are the exclusions under Missed Travel Connection for SafeTrip?
answer: SafeTrip will not pay for any claim in respect of the following: - Failure of the Insured Person to check in according to the itinerary supplied to him/her; - Failure to obtain written confirmation from the common carrier or their handling agents showing the original scheduled departure time and the actual departure time of the delayed incoming common carrier towards the transfer point; - Strike, riot or industrial action publicly known which commenced or was announced before the departure; - The late arrival of the Insured Person at the airport or port; - Any additional expenses incurred such as repurchase of new ticket and additional accommodation charges; - Any missed travel connection of a chartered common carrier; - There is an alternative onward common carrier made available to the Insured Person within 6 hours from the actual arrival time of the Insured Person at the transfer point. Note: The list is not exhaustive. Kindly refer to the policy contract here for the full list of exclusions applicable to Missed Travel Connection.

question: What is Post-Departure Cover in SafeTrip?
answer: SafeTrip allows you to buy a policy even after you have started your trip and departed from Malaysia of no later than 11:59pm (Malaysia time) the following day. Post-Departure Cover will provide you all benefits under SafeTrip (except Travel Cancellation), which is only applicable for International Plan. Kindly note that the travel start and end dates as selected and declared by you during your purchase must match with your travel tickets (e.g. airline ticket/ flight itinerary/ boarding pass). The details will be verified upon claim. A waiting period of up to 11:59pm (Malaysia time) the day following your purchase of the policy applies. No benefits are eligible for claim during the waiting period. For example, you commenced your trip to China on 1 July 2025 for the period of 1-5 July 2025. On 2 July 2025, you realise you do not have any travel insurance and decide to buy SafeTrip. Your coverage period will start from the date of purchase, i.e. from 2 July and ends on 5 July 2025. However, a waiting period applies from the actual time of purchase on 2 July until 11:59pm on 3 July 2025. You are only eligible for any benefits under this policy from 12:00am (Malaysia time) on 4 July 2025.

question: What considerations should I make prior to accepting a loan?
answer: Before accepting a personal loan, it's important to carefully evaluate the following: - Interest/Profit Rates & Fees: Ensure the interest rate and any associated fees are affordable and clearly understood. - Payment Terms: Consider the loan / financing's payment schedule and whether it fits your monthly budget. - Total Loan / Financing Cost: Calculate the total cost of the loan / financing, including principal, interest/profit, and any fees, to understand the full financial commitment. - Your Financial Situation: Assess your ability to pay the loan / financing without compromising essential living expenses or savings. - Loan / Financing Purpose: Ensure the loan / financing is being used for a necessary or productive purpose that will improve your financial situation. Making an informed decision will help you manage your loan / financing responsibly.

question: How do I check if my mobile device's Operating Software meets the minimum requirement to run Near Field Communication (NFC) and the updated Touch 'n Go eWallet app?

Users need to ensure their device meets the minimum OS and it is installed in their devices prior to attempting to reload via eWallet. For iPhone users, you can validate your iOS version of your device by doing the following: Step 1: Locate and select the "Settings" app. Step 2: Once in the "Settings" app, tap "General" Step 3: Proceed to tap "About" and note the "Software Version" Step 4: If your iOS version has not been updated, tap "Software Update" under "General" and check for available updates to install. Click "Download and Install" to proceed For Android users, you can validate your OS version of your device by doing the following: Step 1: Locate and select the "Settings" app. Step 2: Once in the "Settings" app, tap "About Phone" or "About Device" Step 3: Proceed to tap "Android Version" and note your version information displayed Step 4: If your OS version has not been updated, check the "Software Update" page for instructions to complete the OS update Some brand/ model of phones purchased from different countries may cause issues to the NFC functionality/ NFC is not supported. Please check with your mobile device's manufacturer prior to attempting to use the enhanced TNG card with your mobile device.

question: Where can the EZ-Link x Touch 'n Go Motoring Card be used?
answer: This card is catered for Singapore registered vehicles travelling between Singapore and Malaysia. In Singapore, the EZ-Link x Touch 'n Go Motoring Card can be used to make payments for carpark fees, Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) and checkpoint toll charges. question: Can I submit an Unauthorised Transaction Report if I was tricked into making the transaction?
answer: We're very sorry if you've experienced a scam. It can be a painful and confusing experience. However, there is a difference between unauthorised transactions and scams. - An unauthorised transaction means someone accessed your eWallet and made a transaction without your knowledge or approval. - A scam means you were misled or tricked into approving the transaction yourself, for example by clicking on a fake link or talking to a scammer. Example of a scam: You made a payment to a seller because you believe he is genuine but did not receive the goods or services you paid for. If the investigation shows that you approved the transaction, even if you were tricked, it's not considered unauthorised and not eligible for a refund. You can still report scam cases to us using our Chatbot. You should also call NSRC at 997 immediately (within 24 hours) to get further help. To learn more about the scenarios that are excluded from our Unauthorised Transactions Report Policy, please refer to our Terms & Conditions.

question: What does Lifestyle Assistance Allowance Benefit cover?
answer: Lifestyle Assistance Allowance Benefit provides a monthly cash allowance for home nursing care, hospice care, palliative care and home cleaning services in the event of any inconveniences upon diagnosis of the covered critical illnesses, provided that you survive for at least 15 days from the diagnosis. You are allowed to claim for this benefit within 365 days following the approval date of the Advanced Stage Critical Illness Benefit. question: What is 'Any One Disability'?

question: [Account Management] What do I need to do if I forgot my 6-digit PIN or my account has been suspended?

question: What is 'Any One Disability'?
answer: 'Any One Disability' means that if 2 or more confinements are due to the same or related disability, or to any complications arising from it, such confinements shall be regarded as 1 confinement if each of them is not separated by more than 90 days from the paid or payable confinement which immediately occurred before this. question: Multiboxing
answer: What is multiboxing? Multiboxing means having multiple instances of our app open at the same time. Why is it dangerous to use our app with multiboxing enabled? Using our app with multiboxing enabled can be dangerous for a few reasons: Increased risk of unauthorised access: If one of your instances of the app is compromised by malware or a hacker, it could give the attacker access to your financial information in all of the other instances of the app as well. Data leakage: With multiboxing, there is a higher chance of your sensitive information being accidentally exposed. How to prevent using our app with multiboxing Phone settings: If you have enabled the dual app feature on your phone, you can disable it through the settings. Typically, this can be found under the 'Apps' or 'Advanced' section of the settings menu. Uninstall third-party cloning apps: If you are using a third-party app to clone your banking app, uninstalling the cloning app will disable the additional instances. By following these steps and tips, you can better protect your financial information when you use our app.

Multiple failed attempt of PIN reload which result to account locked - Please retry after 72 hours 4. You have reached max wallet limit - for more info please refer to article Are they any limitations for wallet usage? - Please utilize some of your balance and retry reload 5. You have reached the monthly limit of RM8,000 - Please utilize balance of the reload PINs in the following calendar month 6. The reload PIN has expired - You may refer to expiry date printed on the Reload PIN receipt, located below the PIN number. Sample Reload PIN receipt 7. Invalid PIN number - been used by other user or error in PIN number - Please refer to the merchant where you purchased the reload PIN or the organization that you received the PIN number 8. Unable to proceed - The function to reload eWallet using TNG eWallet Reload PIN and/or Credit Card may have been disabled due to a breach of the User Terms and Conditions. - For more info please refer to the article under the section Suspicious activities via TNG eWallet Reload PIN and Credit Card Reload

question: Why does the reader fail to detect my Touch 'n Go RFID tag?
answer: There could be many reasons why the reader fails to detect your Touch 'n Go RFID tag. question: I have enabled Quick Payment feature in my eWallet. When my eWallet does not have enough balance to pay for my petrol amount, will the payment be deducted from my saved bank card?

question: How can I opt out of paying for petrol with Touch 'n Go RFID?

question: My mobile connection is weak at the station; can I still pump petrol with Touch 'n Go RFID?
answer: Yes, you can pump petrol with Touch 'n Go RFID even if your mobile connection is weak. All you need is sufficient balance in your Touch 'n Go eWallet for the preauthorised amount. However, you may not receive any immediate push notification on your mobile phone when refuelling is completed due to the poor network connectivity.

question: What do I need to do if I forgot my 6-digit PIN or my account has been suspended ?
answer: Important Note! In certain scenarios, if your account has been suspended due to allowable 6-digit PIN attempts during login or exceeding allowable security questions attempts, please be patient and allow 24 hours before attempting again. If you are no longer logged-in: 1. Open the TNG eWallet app, click on 6-digit PIN and enter your Registered Mobile Number. 2. Tap Forgot your PIN? 3. Enter your Registered Mobile Number. Then enter the One-Tme Password (OTP sent to your Registered Mobile Number 4. Verified accounts Scan your face. For unverified account, you will be asked to enter your registered ID number or security question. 5. Once completed, enter a new 6-digit PIN and you're done! A message will appear once your 6-digit PIN has been successfully updated. If you are still logged-in: 1. Open the TNG eWallet app and tap Profile. Then tap Security. 2. Tap Change 6-digit PIN. Then enter Current 6-digit PIN. 3. Enter New 6-digit PIN. A message will appear once your 6-digit PIN has been successfully updated. If you are still logged-in (Forgot your current 6-digit PIN) 1. Open the TNG eWallet app and tap Profile. Then tap Security. 2. Tap Change 6-digit PIN. Select Forgot your PIN? 3. For Verified accounts Scan your face. For Unverified account, you will be asked to enter your registered ID number or security question. 4. Once completed, enter a new 6-digit PIN. A message will appear once your 6-digit PIN has been successfully updated. We hope the above information helps. If you need further assistance, feel free to contact us via Chatbot.

question: How are the interest/profit rates and fees calculated?
answer: The interest/profit rates defer by banks, check information between all banks: Bank Name Information Alliance Bank CashFirst The interest/profit rate depends on your financial profile, like your credit record, repayment habits, and loan / financing duration (Risk-based pricing). question: How do I know if I'm earning from my gold investment?

The "You Sell" price is the current market rate when you sell your gold, while the"Average Buy Price" is the average value of gold that you've purchased to date. Referring to the example below: If your Average Buy Price is RM232 per gram and the "You Sell" price today is RM243 per gram, you're making a profit of RM10 per gram. This simple comparison helps you easily track your investment performance and make informed decisions about selling your gold.

question: How does convenience fee work?
answer: - Credit card Convenience fee shall apply when user use credit card to perform manual reload, quick payment and auto reload regardless of the amount. Touch 'n Go eWallet will calculate the convenience fee based on the reload amount. The following information will be shown on the reload page: - Reload Amount eg. RM200 - Convenience Fee per the reload amount eg. 1% of RM200 = RM2 - Total Charge, which is the sum of a + b = RM202 Should you choose to proceed, the Total Charge will be charged to your credit card, and the reload amount (eg. RM200) will be credited into your Touch 'n Go eWallet account. - Reload PIN When you top up with Reload PINs, you can choose whether your balance is transferable or non-transferable. - If you choose transferable, a 1% fee will apply. - If you choose non-transferable, there's no fee. The non-transferable balance can be used for most payments, except for the following: - Transfer - DuitNow Transfer - GO+ - GOinvest - GOremit - ATM withdrawal via Touch 'n Go eWallet Visa card - JomPAY However, in the event, your Transferable balance is insufficient for the following use cases, your Non-Transferable balance can still be utilised and converted to transferable but are subjected to the 1% convenience fee: - Transfer - DuitNow Transfer Sample scenario: User A has RM50 in his transferable balance and RM200 in his non-transferrable balance, but he wishes to transfer RM120 to User B. However, User A only has RM50 in his transferable balance leaving him RM70 short. User A can convert RM70 from his non-transferable balance to make up for the remaining amount but will need to pay a 1% convenience fee. See this calculation breakdown: - Overall eWallet Balance is Transferable balance + non-transferable balance = RM250 - Transfer amount requested = RM120 - Transferable Balance = RM50 - Shortfall amount to convert from non-transferable balance = RM70 - Convenience fee for the amount taken from their non-transferable balance is 1% of RM70 = RM0.70 - Total Converted: RM70.70 (d + e) Should User A choose to proceed, the Total Converted will be deducted from their non-transferable balance and the intended transfer amount of RM120 will be credited into User B's eWallet account. User A's eWallet balance is now RM0 (transferable balance) and RM129.30 (non-transferable balance)

question: What are the exclusions of all benefits under Section B: Medical for SafeTrip?

question: Can I purchase more than one SafeTrip policy?

question: How can I claim for Loss or Damage of Baggage and Personal Effects under SafeTrip?

AIA will reimburse for the loss, damage or repair of the Insured Person's baggage and personal effects occurred during the trip due to theft, attempted theft, robbery, attempted robbery, or the negligence of the common carrier or hotel, less any wear and tear, depreciation or any compensation paid by the common carrier or hotel.

question: What is 'Reasonable and Customary Charges'?

Such charges when incurred, taking into consideration similar or comparable treatment, services or supplies to individual of the same gender and of comparable age of similar sickness, disease or injury and in accordance with accepted medical standards and practice could not have been omitted without adversely affecting your medical condition.

question: How do I determine the sum insured for SafeHome?
answer: On Building: You must ensure that your property is adequately insured at all times considering the cost of rebuilding your property (excluding the cost of land) taking into account any renovation and enhancement made to your property, otherwise you will need to bear a proportional share of the loss if you are under-insured, i.e. your sum insured is less than the rebuilding cost at the time of loss. You may use the Building Cost Calculator (BCC) by Persatuan Insurans Am Malaysia (PIAM) embedded in the SafeHome quotation to get the estimated rebuilding cost of your property to estimate your sum insured. You do not need to declare each item/article that you want to insure specifically, however, the payout of each item/article is limited to 5% of the total content coverage amount.

question: How do I purchase Reload PIN for Corporate gift / Giveaway?
answer: Thank you for your interest in purchasing Touch 'n Go eWallet reload PIN. How do I purchase reload PINs for corporate gifts / giveaways? You may reach out to us via email at cfmssupport@tngdigital.com.my or submit a request via https://www.touchngo.com.my/business/credit-disbursement/reload-pin/ What are reload PINs and how can they be used as corporate gifts / giveaways? Reload PINs are unique codes that convert to credit or funds for your Touch 'n Go eWallet, offering versatile options for corporate use such as staff incentives, customer rewards, and contest prizes. Are there any restrictions on who can purchase reload PINs for corporate purposes? We offer reload PINs to companies that have registered with our service. To register your business, please email cfmssupport@tngdigital.com.my What reload PIN denominations are available for corporate gifts / giveaways? Available denominations start from RM1 and our biggest at RM8,000. You may request up to 15 different denominations per order at no charge. There will only be a handling fee if you request for more than 15 denominations or to change denominations once the reload PINs have been generated. How do I bulk purchase reload PINs for corporate purposes? Please reach out to us via email at cfmssupport@tngdigital.com.my or submit a request via our website at https://www.touchngo.com.my/business/credit-disbursement/reload-pin/ What is the validity of reload PINs? By default, reload PINs are valid for 6 months once generated. You may request for shorter validity period by specifying the desired date in the Purchase Order form. Can we request to extend the expiry date for reload PINs after purchase? If you wish to extend the expiry date for reload PINs after purchase, please email your request to cfmssupport@tngdigital.com.my. Please note that extension requests can only be made once and must be submitted at least 30 days before the expiry date. Upon approval, the expiry date can be extended for an additional 3 months. For requests made less than 30 days before the expiry date, you will be subjected to a handling fee. Additionally, any requests submitted less than 7 working days before the expiry date will not be entertained. Is there a handling fee when purchasing reload PINs? Handling fees are applicable under the following conditions: Condition Rate Purchase order with more than 15 reload PIN denominations RM100 per order Request to change denomination after reload PINs have been generated RM100 or 3% of the purchase amount, whichever is higher Request to extend expiry dates of the reload PINs made less than 30 days before expiry date RM100 or 3% of the purchase amount, whichever is higher Is there a minimum or maximum quantity required when purchasing reload PINs for corporate gifts / giveaways? The minimum order quantity is RM3,000. There is no maximum limit for orders. What are the accepted payment methods for corporate orders of reload PINs? We accept payment via bank transfer and cheques. How long does it take to process and receive reload PINs purchased for corporate use? Registration of new accounts typically takes around 7 to 12 working days. For businesses registered as of April 2023, a re-verification process is required, which takes approximately 5 working days. This shorter duration is because their information is already in our system. The order processing and PIN delivery require approximately 5 working days. Are bulk discounts available for purchasing reload PINs for corporate gifts / giveaways? Unfortunately, we do not offer bulk discounts. The price of reload PINs is based on the required credit value. What support or assistance is available if I encounter any issues with my purchase of reload PINs for corporate use? If you encounter any issues, you can reach out to the support team at TNG Digital via email at cfmssupport@tngdigital.com Can I request a refund or exchange for unused reload PINs purchased for corporate purposes? All reload PINs sold are final and non-refundable.

question: Why there is no PIN authentication when I reload or auto reload my Touch 'n Go eWallet account using my saved debit card or credit card?
answer: Firstly, your authentication details are being stored encrypted as per industry standards. User privacy and security is of the utmost importance to us. We are compliant to BNM requirement on the secrecy provision under Section 133 of the Financial Services Act 2013 and Personal Data Protection Act 2010. To enable Auto reload or Reload using favourite debit/credit card, the user undergoes 3DS validation upon first-time card binding. This is sufficient to validate that the card binding is done by the cardholder. For subsequent transactions, there will be no more 3DS validation as part of our effort to provide a better customer experience. We have highlighted these mechanics to BNM and we did not receive any objection from BNM to proceed.

question: What is NOT considered an unauthorised transaction?
answer: We want to support you, but there are cases where a transaction is not considered unauthorised and will not be eligible for refund. These include: - Transaction did not happen on TNG eWallet - You shared your eWallet login or OTP with someone else - Scam or phishing transactions where you authorised the payment - Negligence or fraud on your part during investigation - Transactions made during events beyond our control such as natural disasters, war, terrorist attacks, or civil unrest - Technical issues you were aware of during the transaction (e.g., hacking attempts, bank system upgrades, or telco downtime) - Legal or regulatory reasons prevent us from issuing a refund - Use of a rooted/jailbroken phone or unofficial app versions - You authorised someone to use your bank card to reload a TNG eWallet account - You transferred funds by mistake, including scam-related transfers - Device infected with malware or suspicious APK files - Transactions that you have authorised for recurring payments with merchants such as auto debit (e.g., Apple, TikTok, HK iReader) or bill payments (e.g., water bills, mobile bills). You can find more information from What Is Auto Debit? and What is auto payment? We work hard to protect your account, but your action and caution also play a big role in keeping your eWallet safe.

question: Why is the gold price in my app static?
answer: Gold prices may appear static for a few reasons: - Our gold prices are updated in real-time based on global market rates. At times, market movements may be minimal, resulting in prices staying the same for extended periods. - Gold trading is subject to global market hours. During weekends or public holidays when markets are closed, prices typically remain static until trading resumes. - Scheduled system maintenance may also temporarily delay price updates.

question: What is Shariah-compliant investments?
answer: Shariah-compliant investments are investment based on the principles of Islamic finance. The guiding principles of Shariah-compliant investment dictates the investments must not involve any elements of Riba (usury), Gharar (ambiguity) and Maysir (gambling). question: What do you mean by 'Double Indemnity' for accidents?
answer: For Domestic Plan: - If you suffer death as a result of an accident, AIA will pay your Nominee or the Estate RM100,000. - If you suffer accidental death on public conveyance during National Public Holidays, AIA will pay your Nominee or the Estate RM200,000 (double of RM100k). - If you suffer permanent disability as a result of an accident, AIA will pay you according to the Schedule of Indemnities up to RM100,000. - If you suffer permanent loss of hearing (one ear) as a result of an accident on National Public Holiday, AIA will pay you RM100,000 (RM100,000 x 50% x double). - If you suffer permanent total disability and loss of hearing (one ear) as a result of an accident on National Public Holiday, AIA will pay you RM200,000 [RM100,000 x max(100% and 50%) x double]. Note: - Death/dismemberment on Public Conveyance and National Public Holidays cannot be claim at the same time. - AIA is only liable for the greatest compensation of dismemberment. - Amount of Cover varies by Insured Person's entry age, please refer to the Table of Benefit for more details.

question: What is 'Medically Necessary'?
answer: 'Medically Necessary' shall mean a medical service which is: a) consistent with the diagnosis and customary medical treatment for a covered disability; and b) in accordance with standards of good medical practice, consistent with current standard of professional medical care, and proven medical benefits; and c) not for the convenience of you or the physician, and unable to be reasonably rendered out of hospital (if admitted as an in-patient); and d) not of an experimental, investigational or research nature, preventive or screening nature; and e) for which the charges are fair and considered reasonable and customary charges for the disability.

question: Private Space
answer: What is a private space? A private space is a feature on some Android devices that allows users to create a hidden or isolated area within their phone. This space can be used to run apps, store files, and maintain a separate environment. It is sometimes referred to as "Secure Folder," "Second Space," or similar, depending on the device manufacturer (e.g. Samsung, Xiaomi). Why is it dangerous to run our app in a private space? Using our app in a private space can introduce serious security risks. These spaces may bypass standard security checks or run apps in a concealed environment, which could compromise the safety of your financial information. Here's why it's risky: - Obscured system integrity: Private spaces can hide the real state of the device, making it harder to detect if the system has been tampered with or compromised. - Increased risk of app cloning or spoofing: Attackers may use private spaces to run modified or fake versions of our app in an attempt to steal login credentials or sensitive data. - Limited monitoring and protection: Security tools and monitoring services may not work properly in private spaces, reducing our ability to detect threats or harmful activity. To protect your financial information, our app cannot be used in a private space. Please switch back to the main device space to continue. How to exit private space The steps may vary depending on your phone brand and OS version. Here are some general guidelines: - Samsung Secure Folder: Exit the Secure Folder and launch the app from your main screen. - Xiaomi Second Space: Go to Settings > Special Features > Second Space, then switch back to your primary space. - Other brands: Look for options such as Private Space, Dual Apps, or App Lock, and ensure you are operating in the main user profile. Avoid using features that separate or clone your main environment unless absolutely necessary. Do not run financial apps in hidden, cloned, or sandboxed spaces.

question: What does the coverage amount 10 times or 20 times of TNG eWallet account balance refer to? (for 'Death due to Accident' and 'Accidental Death due to Road Traffic Accident or in Public Conveyance' benefits)?
answer: If the event of your death due to accident, AIA will pay your Nominee/Estate based on your TNG eWallet account balance (eWallet & GO+ balance in total) valued as at the 1st of the month in which the incident happened. The payout will be doubled if your death is due to road traffic accident or travelling in public conveyance. For Basic Plan: - Benefit payout is 10 times of your TNG eWallet balance, up to a maximum payout of RM25,000. - Example: Certificate is effective on 20 August 2023, and your eWallet account balance is RM2,000. Accident happens on 30 October 2023, and your account balance as at 1 October 2023 is RM 2,700. Therefore, the amount payable by AIA will be RM25,000 [min of (RM2,700 x 10 times) and RM25,000]. - If such accidental death is arising from road traffic accident or travelling in public conveyance, the total amount payable by AIA will be RM50,000 (double of RM25,000). For Pro Plan: - Benefit payout is 20 times of your TNG eWallet balance, up to a maximum payout of RM50,000. - Example: Certificate is effective on 20 August 2023, your eWallet account balance is RM 2,000. Accident happens on 30 October 2023, and your account balance as at 1 October 2023 is RM2,000. Therefore, the amount payable by AIA will be RM40,000 [min of (RM2,000 x 20 times) and RM50,000]. - If such accidental death is arising from road traffic accident or travelling in public conveyance, the total amount payable by AIA will be RM80,000 (double of RM40,000).

question: What are open-system toll?

question: Insecure WiFi NetWork
answer: What is an insecure Wi-Fi network? An insecure Wi-Fi network is typically an open network, such as public Wi-Fi, or one that uses outdated encryption methods, for example, WEP. These networks do not protect your data effectively and can expose your personal information to potential risks. Why is it unsafe to use an insecure Wi-Fi network? Insecure Wi-Fi networks can allow attackers to intercept your data, monitor your activity, or carry out attacks to steal sensitive information such as passwords or financial details. What kind of information is at risk? Your passwords, banking details, personal information, and any data transmitted over an insecure Wi-Fi network can be accessed by attackers. This includes your eWallet account and transaction details. How can I tell if a Wi-Fi network is secure? A secure Wi-Fi network is usually password-protected and uses modern encryption methods such as WPA2 or WPA3. Avoid networks that are open (no password required) or use outdated encryption protocols like WEP. What should I do if I'm connected to an insecure Wi-Fi network? We recommend switching to a secure Wi-Fi network or using your mobile data to protect your information. You can also use a VPN for added security. By following these steps and tips, you can better protect your financial information while using our app.

answer: SafeTrip will not pay for any claim of Pet Care: Veterinary Expenses in respect of the following: - Each claim amount is RM100 and below; - Pet is not staying at a licensed pet boarding facility during the Insured Person's trip; - Pet boarding of more than one (1) pet; - Pre-existing conditions of your pet; - Further treatment for your pet or consulting another veterinary specialist as second opinion for the same accidental bodily injury or sickness; - Routine or preventive treatment including and not limited to the cost of any pet food and/or supplements, shampoo, routine bathing, preventative vaccinations, spaying, castration, routine removal of dew claws, killing and controlling fleas, treating round worms and tapeworms, ticks, mites, grooming and nail clipping or any complications arising from these treatments; - Costs not supported by receipts or invoices from any veterinarian or where the receipts or invoices do not show full details of the cost incurred. AIA will not pay for any claim of Pet Care: Daily Allowance for Pet Boarding in respect of the following: - Pet is not staying at a licensed pet boarding facility during the Insured Person's trip; - Pet boarding of more than one (1) pet; - Extension of stay at pet boarding facility for reasons other than hospitalization of the Insured Person or Travel Delay. Note: The list is not exhaustive. Kindly refer to the policy contract here for the full list of exclusions applicable to Rider 3: Pet Care.

question: What are the documents required to support a SafeTrip claim?

Note: The list is not exhaustive. Kindly refer to policy contract here for full list of claims supporting documents required for each benefit.

question: What is not covered under 'Loss of Personal Belongings due to Theft' benefit?
answer: Personal Belongings refer to personal items regularly worn or carried on the Insured for his/her personal use, for example watch, wallet, purse, mobile phone, bag, or other valuables. Theft means the act of removing the goods from the possession of another without the owner's consent by taking and/or carrying away with the intention to steal or deprive the owner permanently of his property. For 'Loss of Personal Belongings due to Theft', the benefit shall not be payable for: - Loss due to any fraudulent, dishonest or criminal act by the Insured, persons known to the Insured or Insured's family members, whether acting alone or collusion with others; - Loss that are caused by any events other than theft, such as fire, water, normal wear and tear, manufacturing defects, vermin, insects, cleaning or repairs, or similar events; - Intentional or malicious acts or gross negligence or carelessness of the Insured; - Mislaying, misplacing or mysterious disappearance of Insured' personal belongings; - Loss of securities, obligations, deeds, bonds, bills of exchange, promissory notes, or documents of any kind, stamps, coins or paper money, cheques, currency notes, bank notes manuscripts, books of account or other business books, or computer systems records; - Transportation tickets or other similar items that were also lost; - Contraband or illegal goods; - Pick-pocketing. question: Malware Shielding
answer: What is malware shielding? Malware shielding is a security feature in TNG eWallet that automatically checks your phone for known malware based on our security database. What is malware? Malware is a malicious application designed to take control of a user's phone and steal sensitive information. Applications downloaded from unofficial sources may contain malware or harmful modifications. Why is malware dangerous? It can: - Take control of your phone - Steal your personal details - Make unauthorised transactions from your eWallet account - Access and steal banking information stored on your device What can you do? - Only download apps from official sources, such as the Google Play Store or Huawei AppGallery - Uninstall any applications flagged as malware by TNG eWallet's Malware Shielding feature - Remove apps that were not downloaded from official sources

question: What is tax identification number (TIN)?
answer: A TIN is a taxpayer's income tax number assigned by LHDN Malaysia. It is generated through: - Automatic registration (e.g., through monthly tax deduction) - Automatic registration of newly incorporated companies (local or foreign) - Online at e-Daftar - Manual registration at the nearest HASiL Branch Check your TIN on the front page of your income tax return or through MyTax Portal at https://mytax.hasil.gov.my under the "e-Daftar" menu. For more details, read this article by LHDN: https://www.hasil.gov.my/media/1iblexbc/malaysia-tin.pdf

question: What is 'Reasonable and Customary Charges'?
answer: 'Reasonable And Customary Charges' shall mean charges for medical care which is medically necessary shall be considered reasonable and customary to the extent that it does not exceed the general level of charges being made by others of similar standing within Malaysia. Such charges when incurred, taking into consideration similar or comparable treatment, services or supplies to individual of the same gender and of comparable age of similar sickness, disease or injury and in accordance with accepted medical standards and practice could not have been omitted without adversely affecting your medical condition.

question: What are the major exclusions under CI Insure?
answer: CI Insure does not cover: - Any illness or surgery other than a diagnosis of a critical illness covered under the policy; - Critical illness of which the signs and symptoms is manifested prior to or within the waiting period; - Any critical illness diagnosed due, directly or indirectly, to a congenital defect or disease which has manifested or was diagnosed before the Insured Person attains seventeen (17) years of age last birthday; - Any pre-existing conditions prior to the issue date or effective date of reinstatement of the certificate of insurance, whichever is later; - Critical illness in the presence of any AIDS or HIV. AIA reserve the right to require the Insured Person to undergo a blood test for HIV as a condition precedent to any acceptance of any claim. - Any of the covered critical illness which is caused by suicide or intentional self-injury; - Any of the covered critical illness resulting directly from alcohol or drugs abuse; - If the Insured Person did not survive for at least fifteen (15) days after the diagnosis of a covered critical illness. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission; - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or - Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc. Refer to the Policy Wording here for the full exclusions under the Critical Illness plan.

question: Is TNG eWallet's Unauthorised Transaction Report the same as Perbadanan Insurans Deposit Malaysia (PIDM) protection?
answer: No. PIDM protects your bank deposits (like savings and fixed deposit) in case a bank closes down. It does not cover fraud or unauthorised transactions. TNG eWallet's Unauthorised Transaction Report is our own way of protecting you if someone uses your eWallet without your permission. Rest assured, we also follow Bank Negara Malaysia's (BNM) rules. All your eWallet balances are stored safely in trustee accounts, managed by licensed banks, and cannot be used for anything else except transactions that you approve. This means your money is kept secure and not used for business purposes. Because of this setup, even if an eWallet company shuts down, your funds are still protected and can be returned to you. Learn how your eWallet funds are secured.

question: What is 'Medically Necessary'?
answer: 'Medically Necessary' shall mean a medical service which is: - consistent with the diagnosis and customary medical treatment for a covered disability; and - in accordance with standards of good medical practice, consistent with current standard of professional medical care, and proven medical benefits; and - not for the convenience of you or the physician, and unable to be reasonably rendered out of hospital (if admitted as an in-patient); and - not of an experimental, investigational or research nature, preventive or screening nature; and - for which the charges are fair and considered reasonable and customary charges for the disability.

question: There is an exclusion on "Pre-Existing Condition". What does this mean?
answer: This means that CI Insure does not cover any illnesses, disabilities or conditions prior to the issue date or effective date of reinstatement of the certificate of insurance, whichever is later, and that you have reasonable knowledge of this pre-existing condition. Pre-existing condition is referring to the condition(s) only when you are first covered and shall not be applicable after the first year of coverage. However, if there is a break in continuity of the insurance coverage after the first year of coverage, the pre-existing condition shall apply again.

question: What are the activities covered as Adventurous and Winter Sports under SafeTrip?
answer: Adventurous and Winter Sports includes: - Abseiling; - Bungee jumping; - Sky diving accompanied by a certified instructor; - Helicopter riders for sightseeing; - Hot air ballooning; - Water sports - Jet skiing, rowing, yatching, parasailing, surfing, windsurfing (boardsailing); - Mountaineering at mountains below the height of 4,100 metres above sea level necessitating the use of ropes and other climbing equipment, and with licensed guide(s); - Rock climbing necessitating the use of ropes and other climbing equipment; - Skiing or snowboarding all within official approved areas of a ski resort; - Canoeing or white water rafting with a qualified guide and up to Grade 3 (of International Scale of River Difficulty); or - Underwater activities involving artificial breathing apparatus for diving up to a maximum depth of thirty (30) metres with a qualified diving instructor and with recognised diving certification. question: What is not covered under 'Unauthorised Debit/Credit Card Spending due to Theft' benefit?

For 'Unauthorised Debit/Credit Card Spending due to Theft', the benefit shall not be payable for: - Any financial loss incurred by the Insured which can be recovered or compensated by card issuing bank or other sources as determined at the company's rights; - Loss due to any fraudulent, dishonest or criminal act by the Insured, persons known to the Insured or Insured's family members, whether acting alone or collusion with others; - Intentional or malicious acts, gross negligence or carelessness of the Insured; - Mislaying, misplacing, mysterious disappearance or pick-pocketing of Insured's debit/ credit card; - Any loss in connection with supplementary card(s) or supplementary cardholder(s). question: What happens if I have an outstanding SOS Balance of RM50, but I only reload RM30? Will I still be able to use SOS Balance?

For example: - Outstanding SOS Balance: RM50 - Reload amount: RM30 - Transactions: RM15, RM10, RM15 In this case, RM15 (first transaction) and RM10 (second transaction) will be deducted. The remaining RM5 cannot cover the next transaction (RM15), so it stays in your balance. The outstanding SOS Balance is reduced to RM15. - After 24 hours: SOS Balance, including eWallet payment features, will not be available until the full outstanding amount is paid. To avoid disruptions, we recommend settling the full outstanding amount promptly.

question: Can I transfer the VEP RFID tag of my previous vehicle to my new vehicle? Can one VEP RFID tag be used for more than one vehicle?

question: What are the exclusions under Insure360 (Medical)?
answer: Insure360 (Medical) does not cover: - Pre-existing condition; - Any medical or physical abnormalities existing at the time of birth, as well as neo-natal physical abnormalities developing within six (6) months from the time of birth. - Any disability caused by self-destruction, intentional self-inflicted injuries, willful exposure to danger or any attempt of self-destruction while sane or insane; - Any disability caused by war, declared or undeclared, strikes, riots, civil war, revolution or any warlike operations; - Service in the armed forces in time of declared or undeclared war or while under orders for warlike operations or restoration of public order; - Any violation or attempted violation of the law or resistance to arrest; - Pregnancy, miscarriage or childbirth; - Mental or nervous disorders, treatment of alcoholism, or drug abuse or any other complications arising from it or any drug accident not prescribed by a doctor; - Elective/plastic/cosmetic surgery, circumcision (except circumcision due to infection), eye examination/elective surgery for visual impairments due to nearsightedness, farsightedness or astigmatism or radial keratotomy; all corrective glasses, contact lenses and intraocular lens (except monofocal intraocular lenses in cataract surgery) or the use or acquisition of external prosthetic appliances or devices and prescriptions; - Any form of dental care or surgery including the replacement of natural teeth, placement of denture and prosthetic services such as bridges and crowns or their replacement; - Hospitalisation primarily for investigatory purposes, diagnosis, x-ray examination, general physical or medical examinations, not incidental to treatment or diagnosis of a covered disability or any treatment which is not medically necessary and any preventive treatments, preventive medicines or examinations carried out by a physician, vitamins/food supplements and treatments specifically for weight reduction or gain; - Any treatment or investigation which is not medically necessary, or convalescence, custodial or rest care; - Any specified illness, medical or physical conditions arising within the waiting period for covered injury; - Ionizing radiation or contamination by radioactivity from any nuclear fuel or nuclear waste from process of nuclear fission or from any nuclear weapon material; or - Expenses incurred for donation of any body parts or organ by the Insured Person and acquisition of the organ including all costs incurred by the donor during organ transplant and its complications. AIA will only reimburse the reasonable and customary charges incurred on major organ/bone marrow transplant surgery for the Insured Person being the recipient, limited to once per lifetime; or - Overseas treatment if Insured Person resides or travels outside Malaysia (excluding Singapore and Brunei) for more than 90 consecutive days. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents; - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission; - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or - Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc. Refer to the Policy Wording here for the full exclusions under the Medical plan.

question: Is gold investment principally protected?

It involves buying and selling gold based on daily prevailing gold prices. While this allows you to benefit from gold price fluctuations, TNG Digital does not guarantee any earnings. question: Is gold investment protected by Perbadanan Insurans Deposit Malaysia (PIDM)?
answer: PIDM primarily protects depositors by insuring deposits in member banks, such as savings and fixed accounts, up to a certain limit. However, it does not cover investments like gold, unit trust, stocks, bonds, or any other non-deposit products. This means that while your bank deposits are safeguarded against the unlikely scenario of your bank winding down, all investments carry risks associated with market fluctuations and are not eligible for PIDM protection. It's important to be aware of these distinctions when considering your investment options!

question: What are the exclusions under Med Insure?
answer: Med Insure does not cover: - Pre-existing condition; - Any medical or physical abnormalities existing at the time of birth, as well as neo-natal physical abnormalities developing within six (6) months from the time of birth. - Any disability caused by self-destruction, intentional self-inflicted injuries, willful exposure to danger or any attempt of self-destruction while sane or insane; - Any disability caused by war, declared or undeclared, strikes, riots, civil war, revolution or any warlike operations; - Service in the armed forces in time of declared or undeclared war or while under orders for warlike operations or restoration of public order; - Any violation or attempted violation of the law or resistance to arrest; - Pregnancy, miscarriage or childbirth; - Mental or nervous disorders, treatment of alcoholism, or drug abuse or any other complications arising from it or any drug accident not prescribed by a doctor; - Elective/plastic/cosmetic surgery, circumcision (except circumcision due to infection), eye examination/elective surgery for visual impairments due to nearsightedness, farsightedness or astigmatism or radial keratotomy; all corrective glasses, contact lenses and intraocular lens (except monofocal intraocular lenses in cataract surgery) or the use or acquisition of external prosthetic appliances or devices and prescriptions; - Any form of dental care or surgery including the replacement of natural teeth, placement of denture and prosthetic services such as bridges and crowns or their replacement; - Hospitalisation primarily for investigatory purposes, diagnosis, x-ray examination, general physical or medical examinations, not incidental to treatment or diagnosis of a covered disability or any treatment which is not medically necessary and any preventive treatments, preventive medicines or examinations carried out by a physician, vitamins/food supplements and treatments specifically for weight reduction or gain; - Any treatment or investigation which is not medically necessary, or convalescence, custodial or rest care; - Any specified illness, medical or physical conditions arising within the waiting period for covered injury; - Ionizing radiation or contamination by radioactivity from any nuclear fuel or nuclear waste from process of nuclear fission or from any nuclear weapon material; or - Expenses incurred for donation of any body parts or organ by the Insured Person and acquisition of the organ including all costs incurred by the donor during organ transplant and its complications. AIA will only reimburse the reasonable and customary charges incurred on major organ/bone marrow transplant surgery for the Insured Person being the recipient, limited to once per lifetime; or - Overseas treatment if Insured Person resides or travels outside Malaysia (excluding Singapore and Brunei) for more than 90 consecutive days. The following conditions are excluded for coverage under the PMCM service: - Medical emergencies; - Accidents; - Urgent or life-threatening situations, such as ICU (Intensive Care Unit) admission; - Daily or common issues, such as colds, flu, fever, occasional rash etc.; - Long term chronic diseases management such as chronic hepatitis, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc. (however, any complications of chronic diseases shall be covered); or - Mental health conditions such as anorexia/bulimia, mental health-related sleeping disorder, anxiety, depression etc. Refer to the Policy Wording here for the full exclusions under the Medical plan.

question: Can payments be made in cash?
answer: Road Charge payment can only be done via your Touch 'n Go ewallet app, which you have installed when you collect your VEP RFID tag.

question: Do I need to display receipts on the car?
answer: No more paper receipts. The local authorities will use your vehicle number to check the validity of the booking. You do not need to put any paper receipts on your vehicle.

question: How do I set up Price Alert?
answer: Step 1: Access the e-Mas Dashboard within GOfinance on your eWallet. Step 2: Scroll down to "Get gold price alerts" and tap on "Set up now" Step 3: Choose "Buying Price" or "Selling Price" Step 4: Click on "Add price alert" Step 5: Enter your preferred buying or selling price, then click on "Add price alert" Step 6: You'de done! You will receive a notification from TNG eWallet once the gold price hits your preferred price set.

question: It says my Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card is expiring soon - can I still use it?
answer: Unfortunately, no. If your Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card is set to expire within the next 60 days, you won't be able to use it to buy a pass. Please use another valid Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card.

question: Why is my application rejected?
answer: Please contact CIMB hotline +603-6204 7788 to learn more about your application

Thank you for your patience & support with A+ Rewards.

question: Other than Singapore registered vehicles, does any other foreign registered vehicles be imposed with Road charge?
answer: All foreign vehicles (vehicles owned by individuals, companies or organizations for private usage) will be charged RM20 when entering Malaysia.

question: Can I see these transactions in the 'Transaction History' of the app?
answer: Yes. We will display all 'Parking' related payments in the 'Transaction History' of the app. You can view more detailed information in the 'Receipt' section by selecting the 'Parking' icon from the home screen.

question: How do I update/edit/delete the price alert that I have set up?
answer: Step 1: Access the e-Mas Dashboard within GOfinance on your eWallet. Step 2: Scroll down to "Get gold price alerts" and tap on "Set up now" Step 3: Tap on the price alert that you have set up. Step 4: Edit your preferred buying or selling price, then click on "Update price alert". Alternatively, you can also tap on "Delete price alert" to delete it. Step 5: You'de done!

question: I got an error after scanning my card - what should I do?
answer: If something goes wrong after the second card scan: - Try scanning again - if it works, your pass will activate - If it fails, don't worry - you'll be automatically refunded and can try again If you exited the app midway, just open Travel Pass, scan your card again, and check that the pass was properly linked.

question: If my ASB Financing application is rejected, can I apply again?
answer: Yes, you may reapply, but your new application is subject to CIMB's review and approval.

question: TNG eWallet Reload PIN: Why I can't use my Reload PIN? It states 'Invalid Reload PIN'.

Invalid Reload PIN": We believe the TnGD team can support you the best. Please reach out to us via Live Chat on the TNG eWallet apps, click here. We hope your issue will be resolved at the earliest. Thank you for supporting A+ Rewards!

question: Will the Road Charge be waived on certain days?
answer: The road charge is imposed on a daily basis upon each entry to Malaysia unless stated or declared by the Goverment of Malaysia.

question: Can I extend my booking from the app?
answer: Absolutely Yes. We will send you a reminder before your booking expires to avoid any discomfort to you. You can extend your booking as per the parking site rules. To ensure timely delivery of these alert messages, please enable the notification for the eWallet.

question: What should I do if my payment goes through, but the card scan fails?
answer: If your payment is successful but the second card scan fails and your Rapid Bulanan Pass cannot be activated, don't worry - the system will automatically refund the payment to your eWallet within 3-5 business days. - Before attempting the second scan, please wait at least 60 seconds after the first scan to ensure the system has enough time to process your request. - Once your refund is reflected in your eWallet, you can try the process again. - If the refund does not appear after 5 business days, please contact TNG eWallet Customer Support for further assistance.

question: Can I view my ASB Financing details through TNG eWallet app?
answer: You can track your financing details, including total financing amount, monthly instalments, takaful single contributions, financing duration, and financing rate through the ASB Financing dashboard as shown.

question: Can I transfer my gold investment balance on e-Mas to my family and friends?
answer: Yes, you can transfer your available gold investment balance (with a minimum 0.1 gram) to your family and friends who have a TNG eWallet account.

question: I haven't used my voucher. Why is it showing no status under 'Invalid' section now?
answer: If your voucher redemption was unsuccessful due to reasons like failed payment, cancelled order etc. - Don't worry! Your voucher should still be usable. For example: Kindly give a cool-off period of 20 minutes before re-using it. Then, repeat the order and you should be able to make use of the voucher again. If you need further assistance, A+ Rewards are happy to look into this further for you. Please submit a ticket to us by following the steps in this article: https://support.tngdigital.com.my/hc/en-my/articles/4407437809561-I-have-submitted-support-ticket-for-A-Rewards-how-do-i-track-it

question: How much is the VEP RFID tag?
answer: RM10 (excluding delivery and service charges).

question: Will I be charged if my booking fails?
answer: No. If the parking booking fails for any reason, we will ensure that your eWallet balance is not affected. In a very unlikely situation, if you notice a booking charge for an unsuccessful booking, we will resolve this automatically within 1 day. In case of any discrepancy, please reach out to us via Live Chat on the TNG eWallet apps, click here.

question: Can I transfer my Rapid Bulanan Pass on the TNG eWallet to another card?
answer: No. Once linked, the Rapid Bulanan Pass is permanently tied to that Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card. It cannot be transferred or shared.

question: Are there any charges for late payment on my ASB Financing?
answer: If there is any overdue and/or late payment, the ta'widh (compensation) rate of one per centum (1%) per annum will be charged on such late payment. For further information you may refer here.

question: What is the maximum gold investment value on e-Mas that I can transfer?
answer: You can transfer your gold investment on e-Mas up to a value of RM9,999.99 per transaction, based on the current gold buy price in gram units.

question: I haven't used my voucher. Why is it showing 'Redeemed' under 'Invalid' section now?
answer: If your voucher redemption was unsuccessful due to reasons like failed payment, cancelled order by merchant etc. - Don't worry! Your voucher should still be usable. For example: Kindly give a cool-off period of 20 minutes before re-using it. Then, repeat the order and you should be able to make use of the voucher again. If you need further assistance, A+ Rewards are happy to look into this further for you. Please submit a ticket to us by following the steps in this article: https://support.tngdigital.com.my/hc/en-my/articles/4407437809561-I-have-submitted-support-ticket-for-A-Rewards-how-do-i-track-it

question: How can I collect my VEP RFID tag?
answer: The VEP RFID tag will be delivered via postage. The applicant will be contacted through email for confirmation on the postage arrangement.

question: Can I transfer my Rapid Bulanan Pass purchased on the TNG eWallet to someone else?
answer: No. The Rapid Bulanan Pass purchased on the TNG eWallet is non-transferable and is meant to be used solely by the individual who activated it.

question: Could I perform early settlement on my ASB Financing?
answer: Yes, you could perform early settlement on your ASB Financing. Please contact CIMB hotline at +603-6204 7788 directly for guidance on the early settlement process. You may refer here for further information.

question: Can I refund or reverse my successful e-Mas gold transfer?
answer: No, once your e-Mas gold transfer is successful, refunds or reversals are not permitted.

question: How do I use my TNG eWallet Reload PIN?
answer: It's simple! Follow the below steps to reload your PIN to your TNG's balance: STEP 1: Purchase voucher on Alipay+ Rewards. Launch your Touch 'n Go eWallet app and tap "+ Reload". STEP 2: Tap on "eWallet Balance". STEP 3: Tap on "Reload PIN". STEP 4: "Enter the 10-digit Touch 'n Go eWallet Reload PIN and tap "Reload Now".

question: How to register for VEP?
answer: The owner or representative appointed by the owner of foreign registered vehicle entering Malaysia are required to register online via RTD's official website at https://vep.jpj.gov.my (Please ensure that all information declared are complete and accurate to obtain your confirmation slip that will be emailed to you)

question: Can I cancel a booking?
answer: No. Once you have booked a parking site it is considered that you have found and occupied a parking site. It is recommended that you do a booking after you have found a vacant site to park.

question: Can I continue using the Rapid Bulanan Pass if I change phones?
answer: Yes. Your pass is stored on your card, not your phone. As long as you log into your same personal TNG eWallet account, you can use a different phone without issue.

question: How do I pay my monthly instalments?
answer: You would require to make your payment for the monthly instalments directly to the CIMB financing account.

question: I can't find the code to use my A+ voucher. Why?
answer: Another way to use your voucher is to pay the merchant with your Touch 'n Go eWallet directly. The matching voucher with the highest value (or nearer to expiry) will be automatically applied! For example, in Taobao: STEP 1: Purchase voucher on Alipay+ Rewards, click 'Redeem' and go to Taobao. STEP 2: Make Payment using Touch 'n Go eWallet on Taobao. STEP 3: Check your discount before confirm payment on Touch 'n Go eWallet STEP 4: Go back to Touch 'n Go eWallet and check your discount on 'Transaction History' For example, in Foodpanda: STEP 1: Purchase voucher on Alipay+ Rewards, click 'Redeem' and go to foodpanda APP or website. STEP 2: Order on the foodpanda APP or website and pay with Touch 'n Go eWallet. STEP 3: Can't see the discount details? Don't worry! We'll slash off the amount for you once the payment is made. STEP 4: Go back to Touch 'n Go eWallet and check your discount on 'Transaction History'.

question: Can I enter Malaysia without obtaining my VEP RFID Tag?
answer: Yes, All Singapore-registered vehicles without a VEP may still enter Malaysia as usual after 1st Oct 2024. VEP enforcement will be implemented in phases. However, vehicle-owners entering Malaysia may receive reminders at the Bangunan Sultan Iskandar Customs, Immigration and Quarantine (CIQ) Complex in Johor Bahru and Sultan Abu Bakar CIQ Complex at the Second Link to immediately register, install and activate their VEP and radio frequency identification (RFID) tags. They will also be issued warnings on exiting Malaysia, if the tags are not installed. "Please be reminded that warning notices will be issued to owners of Singapore-registered private vehicles without VEPs before they leave Malaysia,"

question: Can I convert my digital gold value into physical gold?
answer: Currently, you cannot convert your digital gold value into physical gold. However, you may still sell your gold the current gold value based on latest market rate. We're continuously working on enhancing our products and services to allow more redemption options in the future. We appreciate your understanding as we strive to improve your gold investment experience!

question: What should I do if I have been given a summon incorrectly?
answer: If you feel the summon is incorrect, please follow the below steps: 1) Check if the Date/Time of the payment is before the Date/Time of the summon issued. 2) Check the vehicle number on the summon and the vehicle number in your payment details in the 'Receipt' section. 3) If both the above details are correct then you can write to us here and share your registered mobile number and an image of the summon issued. Please note the timelines and process as follow: After verification, we pass your concerns to the parking operator appointed by the council to investigate the same. We will respond to you between 3 to 7 working days about the update from the parking operator.

question: What should I do if I can't enter the station even though I have a valid Rapid Bulanan Pass?
answer: If you're unable to enter the station despite having a valid Rapid Bulanan Pass, please approach the station counter staff for immediate assistance. They will help verify your pass and, if the issue is due to a technical error, guide you on the next steps. For further assistance, you may also contact the Touch 'n Go Customer Service Centre via the hotline listed on our official Touch 'n Go website.

question: Is my personal information safe when applying for ASB Financing?
answer: Yes, we take data security very seriously. All personal information submitted through the ASB Financing application is encrypted and stored in accordance with industry-leading security standards. We follow strict privacy protocols to ensure your data remains secure.

question: What is the purity of the gold that I am purchasing from e-Mas?
answer: e-Mas is in the form of digital gold denominated in Malaysian Ringgit which allows you to purchase 99.9% pure gold commodity without the hassle of keeping the physical gold.

question: Does Foreign vehicle need to register before entering Malaysia?
answer: All categories of vehicles covering private vehicle (both individual and company owned), commercial vehicle and embassy / goverment vehicles that wish to enter Malaysia are required to register online via RTD's official website at https://vep.jpj.gov.my

question: I have accidentally entered an incorrect vehicle number and my eWallet balance has been deducted. Am I entitled for a refund?
answer: Refund will not be allowed if you have transacted for street parking using an incorrect vehicle number. Therefore, kindly ensure all details are correct before proceeding with payment.

question: Will my Rapid Bulanan Pass still work if I lose my internet connection?
answer: Yes! Once your Rapid Bulanan Pass is successfully linked to your Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card via Travel Pass, you don't need to stay connected to the internet to use it at the gates. Just tap your linked Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card at the gates.

question: Who should I contact if I need help with my ASB Financing application on TNG eWallet?
answer: If you're experiencing issues such as: - Issues with your eWallet's 6-digit PIN, - Issues with submitting your ASB Financing application you may reach out to us via our Chatbot daily including public holidays.

question: Can I use my Touch 'n Go Charm for Rapid Bulanan Pass?
answer: Yes! Rapid Bulanan Pass passes can also be linked to Touch 'n Go Charms that have Enhanced NFC capabilities - functionally the same as an Enhanced Touch 'n Go Card, just with more style.

question: What is GTFT?
answer: Group Term Financing Takaful (GTFT) is offered to ASB financing customers of CIMB Islamic Bank Berhad. This is a single contribution plan which provides death and total and permanent disability (TPD) coverage. In the event of death or TPD during the coverage period, the reducing takaful benefit will be payable to offset against the outstanding financing balance. For further information, may refer here.

question: Is the e-Mas digital gold investment Shariah-compliant?
answer: e-Mas is currently available in digital gold format only hence is not Shariah-compliant. One of the requirements for Shariah-compliant gold investment is that the product needs to be fully allocated physical gold. We understand the importance of Shariah compliance and we're continuously working on enhancing our products and services in the future.

question: Who is eligible for GTFT?
answer: Applicants who are at age 18 to 59 years old.

question: How long does disbursement take upon financing approval?
answer: CIMB Bank will disburse the financing amount into the ASB fund within 5 working days. You may contact CIMB hotline for further enquiries if funds have not been disbursed after 5 working days.

question: What is the promo code/ referral code in CarInsure?
answer: The promo code/ referral code is mainly used for CarInsure promotional campaigns by TNG eWallet. Users can enter a promo code/ referral code into the provided space to enjoy more benefits if and when there are promotional CarInsure campaigns running.

question: Is there a way I could apply for ASB Financing on behalf of my dependent or trusted circle?
answer: No, ASB Financing applications must be submitted by the eligible applicant. Applications cannot be made on behalf of dependents or any third party, including family members or individuals within your trusted circle. Each application is subject to individual eligibility, assessment, and approval based on the applicant's own financial profile and requirements.
